- Documentazione strategica: creare e mantenere robusta documentazione di processo e guida dell'utente per supportare un'organizzazione di scala.

La tua storia: - Formazione: Bachelor.s o Master.s laurea in Contabilità e Finanza. - Esperienza: 4+ anni di esperienza pratica in un contesto aziendale su larga scala o internazionale con un focus sugli IFRS e preferibilmente CAPEX. - Conoscenza: Solida comprensione degli IFRS, con specifica esperienza pratica negli IAS 16 e 16. Dovresti essere a tuo agio navigando in contratti di leasing complessi e determinando il corretto trattamento contabile per diverse classi di attività globali in autonomia.

- Comunicazione efficace: Capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione matrice, comunicando efficacemente concetti finanziari complessi agli stakeholder a tutti i livelli. - Tech Savvy: Sei un utente potente di MS Excel e Google Workspace. L'esperienza con Dynamics 365 è un plus. - Toolkit moderno: Fa 1ster con strumenti che guidano l'automazione e sfruttano l'AI per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro finanziari. - Mindset: Una mentalità pratica con la capacità di adattarsi ad un ambiente in continua evoluzione. - Soft Skills: Eccezionali capacità analitiche e competenza aziendale in inglese.

Incontriamo il Team: unisciti a un team di finanza internazionale che funge sia dalla spina dorsale che dal navigatore avanzato del nostro motoscafo. Formiamo le migliori pratiche domani pensando in modo diverso, agendo in modo cross-funzionale e sfruttando uno stack tecnologico all'avanguardia.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

In Short:
Are you the hands-on finance enthusiast we are seeking? We are looking for a process-oriented and numbers-driven team player to take ownership of our group-wide CAPEX. You will act as the financial architect of our global expansion, working at the intersection of Controlling, Retail, and Office Expansion teams. With your proven experience in accounting and a high affinity for modern cloud-based tools, you will take our CAPEX accounting to the next level.

Your Mission:
- Financial Integrity PPE: Act as the subject matter expert for the lifecycle of all fixed assets. This includes determining initial recognition, identifying subsequent expenditures that should be capitalized vs. expensed, and managing complex depreciation models and impairment testing.
- Financial Integrity IFRS 16: Lead the accounting for the global lease portfolio. This involves ensuring the accurate calculation of Right-of-Use assets and lease liabilities, managing lease modifications (extensions, terminations, or rent concessions), and ensuring all disclosures meet the latest IFRS standards.
- Operational Excellence: Oversee daily operations, including additions, disposals, depreciation, and re-measurements.
- Global Connectivity: Act as the primary contact for all CAPEX-related requests, bridging the gap between global standards and local needs.
- External Partner Management & Mentorship: Act as the primary point of oversight and quality control for our outsourced accounting provider. You will be responsible for reviewing their deliverables, and mentoring their team members to ensure alignment with our global standards and quality requirements.
- Reporting & Compliance: Ensure accurate disclosure in our consolidated IFRS Financial Statements and oversee internal SOX controls.
- Process Innovation: Actively challenge and automate global processes using our digital toolkit.
- Strategic Documentation: Create and maintain robust process documentation and user guidance to support a scaling organization.

Your Story:
- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting and Finance.
- Experience: 4+ years of practical experience within a large-scale or international corporate environment with a focus on IFRS and preferably CAPEX.
- Knowledge: Solid understanding of IFRS, with specific, hands-on experience in IAS 16 and IFRS 16. You should be comfortable navigating complex lease contracts and determining the correct accounting treatment for diverse global asset classes in autonomy.
- Effective Communication: Ability to navigate a matrix organization, effectively communicating complex financial concepts to stakeholders at all levels.
- Tech Savvy: You are a power user of MS Excel and Google Workspace. Experience with Dynamics 365 is a plus.
- Modern Toolkit: Familiarity with tools that drive automation and leverage AI to optimize financial workflows.
- Mindset: A hands-on mentality with the ability to adapt to a constantly changing environment.
- Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical skills and business proficiency in English.

Meet The Team:
Join an international finance team that acts as both the backbone and the advanced navigator of our speedboat. We constantly challenge the status quo to handle rapid growth. We shape tomorrow’s best practices by thinking differently, acting cross-functionally, and leveraging a cutting-edge tech stack.

What We Offer:
- A dynamic environment ranked as a "fastest-growing sports company" where your work directly impacts our global footprint.
- A culture that fosters excellence and potential.
- This role offers deep exposure to strategic planning and technical knowledge growth.
- The chance to build something incredible with a collaborative, high-energy global community where you can truly thrive.

Contact
If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

Désignation des marchandises

En bref : Êtes-vous le passionné de finance que nous recherchons? Nous recherchons un team player orienté processus et numérique pour prendre en main notre CAPEX à l'échelle du groupe. Vous agirez comme architecte financier de notre expansion mondiale, travaillant à l'intersection des équipes de Controlling, Retail et Office Expansion. Avec votre expérience de la comptabilité éprouvée et une grande affinité pour les outils modernes basés sur le cloud, vous allez porter notre CAPEX comptable au niveau suivant.

Votre mission : - Intégrité financière PPE : Agir comme expert en la matière pour le cycle de vie de tous les immobilisations, notamment déterminer la comptabilisation initiale, identifier les dépenses subséquentes qui devraient être capitalisées par rapport aux dépenses passées en charges, et gérer des modèles d'amortissement complexes et des tests de dépréciation. - Intégrité financière IFRS 16 : Diriger la comptabilisation du portefeuille de contrats de location globaux.

Il s'agit de veiller à ce que les actifs et les passifs liés au droit d'utilisation soient correctement calculés et que les modifications apportées au bail (reprises, résiliations ou concessions de loyer) soient gérées de façon à ce que toutes les informations soient conformes aux normes IFRS les plus récentes. - Excellence opérationnelle : Surveiller les opérations quotidiennes, y compris les ajouts, les cessions, les amortissements et les réévaluations. - Connectivité mondiale : agir comme premier contact pour toutes les demandes liées au CAPEX, comblant l'écart entre les normes mondiales et les besoins locaux.

- Gestion externe des partenaires et mentorat : agir comme principal point de contrôle et de contrôle de la qualité pour notre fournisseur de services comptables externalisés. Vous serez responsable de l'examen de leurs produits livrables et de l'encadrement des membres de leur équipe pour assurer l'alignement sur nos normes mondiales et nos exigences de qualité. - Rapports et conformité : assurer la divulgation exacte dans nos états financiers IFRS consolidés et superviser les contrôles internes SOX. - Innovation en processus : Définer activement et automatiser les processus mondiaux en utilisant notre boîte à outils numérique.

- Documentation stratégique : Créer et maintenir une documentation solide sur les processus et des conseils aux utilisateurs pour appuyer une organisation de mise à l'échelle.

Votre histoire : - Formation : Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en comptabilité et finance. - Expérience : 4 ans et plus d'expérience pratique dans un environnement d'entreprise à grande échelle ou international, avec un accent sur les IFRS et de préférence CAPEX. - Connaissance : Une bonne compréhension des IFRS, avec une expérience pratique spécifique dans IAS 16 et IFRS 16. Vous devriez être à l'aise de naviguer des contrats de location complexes et de déterminer le traitement comptable correct pour diverses classes d'actifs mondiales en autonomie.

- Communication efficace : Capacité de naviguer dans une organisation matricielle, de communiquer efficacement des concepts financiers complexes aux intervenants à tous les niveaux. - Tech Savvy : Vous êtes un utilisateur puissant de MS Excel et Google Workspace. L'expérience avec Dynamics 365 est un atout. - Modern Toolkit : Familiarité avec les outils qui conduisent à l'automatisation et à la valorisation de l'IA pour optimiser les flux financiers. - Mindset : Une mentalité pratique avec la capacité d'adaptation à un environnement en constante évolution. - Soft Skills : Compétences analytiques exceptionnelles et compétences en gestion en anglais.

Rencontrez l'équipe : rejoignez une équipe financière internationale qui agit à la fois comme l'épine dorsale et le navigateur avancé de notre bateau à moteur. Nous défions constamment le statu quo pour gérer la croissance rapide.

Ce que nous offrons : - Un environnement dynamique classé comme une « entreprise sportive en pleine croissance » où votre travail a une incidence directe sur notre empreinte mondiale. - Une culture qui favorise l'excellence et le potentiel. - Ce rôle offre une exposition profonde à la planification stratégique et à la croissance des connaissances techniques. - La chance de construire quelque chose d'incroyable avec une communauté mondiale collaborative et à haute énergie où vous pouvez vraiment prospérer.

Contact Si vous êtes poussé à porter le niveau suivant, curieux de l'opportunité et voulez faire partie de notre équipe en pleine croissance envoyez-nous votre candidature, et rejoignez l'ONiverse!

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Footwear Design
jobs.description:
In short

We are excited to offer the position of Senior Specialist – Footwear Design Performance (Team Sports) within our Design team. In this role, you will contribute to the creation of next-generation performance footwear for team sports, translating athlete insights, biomechanical data and advanced technologies into innovative design solutions.

You will operate in a fast-paced environment where the full design process — from concept exploration to production briefing — is driven by performance, precision and speed. Working at the intersection of sport science, computational design, AI-enabled workflows and advanced manufacturing, you will help shape the future of performance footwear within the Team Sports category

Your Mission:

• You will be an integral part of the Performance Footwear Team Sports vertical, contributing to the development of high-performance products built for elite athletes.

• You will own projects across the full design process — from initial research and concept creation through final commercialization.

• You will translate athlete insights, biomechanical analysis and sport-specific movement patterns into meaningful design solutions that elevate performance on the field.

• You will develop concepts, mockups, visuals, and high-quality 2D and 3D assets, supporting rapid iteration and clear communication across teams.

• You will leverage advanced digital workflows including 3D design, computational tools and AI-driven ideation to accelerate concept exploration and innovation.

• You will collaborate closely with sports engineering, biomechanics and testing teams to validate and refine performance hypotheses.

• You will work closely with our development partners in Vietnam, traveling two to four times per year to finalize prototypes and bring concepts to production.

• You will contribute to shaping On’s design vision and creative culture, pushing the boundaries of performance footwear within the Team Sports category.

Your Story:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or a related field.

• Proven experience in performance footwear design (5+ years), preferably within team sports or sport performance categories.

• Strong understanding of athlete needs, movement patterns and performance requirements within team sports.

• Expert skills in sketching and storytelling, combined with strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.

• Advanced knowledge of 3D design tools such as Maya, ZBrush, Blender, Rhino or similar platforms.

• Experience with AI-enabled creative tools, generative design workflows, and computational approaches to design exploration.

• Understanding of footwear construction, materials and industrial manufacturing processes.

• Hands-on mindset with the ability to build physical mockups and proof-of-concept prototypes.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to clearly articulate design ideas within cross-functional teams.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Your Team:

As part of the On Design team, our mission is to disrupt the performance footwear landscape through innovative, athlete-driven design. By combining design excellence, engineering precision and emerging digital tools, we translate athlete needs into high-performance products that push the boundaries of sport.

Working at the intersection of design, innovation, development, sport science and testing, we create footwear that delivers performance without compromise — merging functional excellence with progressive design.

titleByLocale.it: Senior Specialista - Color Designer Performance Footwear

titleByLocale.de: Senior Spezialist - Color Designer Performance Footwear
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Spécialiste - Color Designer Performance Footwear

jobs.description:
In short:

Color has the power to shape our thoughts, moods, and emotions, influencing us both physiologically and psychologically. As a Senior Color Designer for Performance at On, you play a pivotal role in redefining the brand's identity through a disruptive, top-of-the-line color strategy. This is not a role for someone who just "colors within the lines"—we are looking for a visionary who creates the color blocking that completely changes product architecture and shifts how the brand reads on the track, road, and court. You will craft compelling, elite color stories that resonate with high-performance athletes, align with brand values, and drive the future of our fast-paced performance categories.

Your Mission:

• Disruptive Color Blocking & Creation: Lead the creation of innovative color blocking strategies that alter product perception, maximize visual impact, and redefine how performance products read on and off the road, track, and court.

• Elite Performance Contextualization: Strategize and execute consumer-focused color work specifically tailored to the elite performance world.

• Independent Project Management: Act as an autonomous force, efficiently managing workloads through a rapid, fast-paced environment.

• Out-of-the-Box Narrative Building: Develop highly creative narratives that push boundaries while maintaining a connection to the overarching CD color umbrella, utilizing advanced renders and dynamic visual communication to bring these concepts to life.

• Cross-Functional Synergy (Apparel HT2): Deeply collaborate with the Apparel Color Design team to constantly check, co-create, and lock in Head-to-Toe (HT2) integration for our elite performance gear, ensuring a unified brand statement.

• Cross-Functional Influence (Inline Footwear): Act as the "lightning strike" for the Inline Performance Footwear team; be highly proactive and vocal in sharing these collaborative insights and elite concepts, ensuring the energy successfully trickles down to influence and shape the commercial footwear area.

• Digital & Physical Execution: High-level execution of color CADs, PLM data management, and the continuous building of a cutting-edge digital and physical inspiration library rooted in contemporary art, culture, and sports fashion.

• Strategic Stakeholder Presentation: Present complex color proposals, concepts, and emotional narratives with high-fidelity renders and clear visual communication to gain immediate buy-in from internal leadership and external partners.

Your Story:

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Design, Color Sciences, Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in the footwear industry, with a proven track record specifically within high-performance footwear.

• A portfolio that demonstrates "out-of-the-box" thinking, complex color-blocking expertise, and an innate understanding of how color interacts with movement.

• Demonstrated ability to work completely independently, self-manage stress, and make critical design decisions under tight deadlines.

• Deep technical knowledge of color processes across technical, performance-driven materials.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and 3D visualization programs.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); any additional languages are a plus.

Your Team:

Our Color Team plays a pivotal role in shaping the visual identity and aesthetic appeal of our products across all categories. Comprising talented professionals with diverse backgrounds, our team collaborates seamlessly to deliver innovative and trend-setting designs that resonate with our consumers and elevate our brand presence in the market. In essence, our Color Team serves as the creative powerhouse pulling together past, present, and future perspectives to drive the visual experience of our products. Through a collaborative and multidisciplinary approach, we craft compelling color design solutions that captivate consumers, differentiate our brand, and inspire lasting connections in the competitive marketplace.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)

titleByLocale.it: Senior Specialista Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)
titleByLocale.en: Senior Specialist Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)
titleByLocale.de: Senior Spezialist Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Spécialiste Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)

jobs.description:
In short:

We are seeking a passionate Senior Specialist Accounting to join our EMEA Accounting team for an 9-month maternity leave coverage (ideally from September to the end of May). In this temporary role, your primary mission will be to maintain continuity and excellence in our core accounting operations across our EMEA entities. While your main focus will be on keeping the daily wheels turning in our fast-paced environment, your strong systems affinity will also help support our ongoing process improvements. Join our forward-thinking team and help us navigate this exciting phase of our growth journey!

Your Mission:

● Core Accounting Operations: Ensure proper financial accounting as well as the timely and compliant monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing & reporting processes for all EMEA entities, in accordance with Group accounting policies (IFRS) and local GAAP

● Statutory Compliance: Manage local statutory account filings across all entities in collaboration with external service providers

● Internal Controls: Conduct internal controls in accordance with Group requirements in a Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls environment

● Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner internally with cross-functional teams to keep systems aligned and ensure day-to-day accounting and finance requirements are met

● Process & Business Continuity: Support the adaptation of accounting processes to align with business changes (such as new Marketplaces), and identify baseline opportunities for automation and operational streamlining where feasible

● Ad Hoc Support: Contribute to exciting ad hoc and project tasks in an emerging environment as needed

Your Story:

● Minimum 4 years of experience in accounting or broader Finance in an agile and fast-paced environment.

● Proven ability to step in quickly, take ownership of multiple financial matters simultaneously, and maintain operational stability in a dynamic setting.

● Experience and ability to identify operational improvement opportunities and provide solutions to streamline processes.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and keep core processes running smoothly.

● An outstanding communicator and collaborator with the ability to quickly build trust and influence a wide range of stakeholders.

● Highly tech-literate with strong general systems skills; proficient in navigating major ERP systems (ideally MS Dynamics 365 F&O) and comfortable leveraging tools that drive automation and leverage AI to optimize financial workflows

Your Team:

Join a finance team that acts as both the backbone and the advanced navigator of our speedboat. We constantly challenge the status quo to handle rapid growth. We shape tomorrow’s best practices by thinking differently, acting cross-functionally, and leveraging a cutting-edge tech stack.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Pattern Engineer
jobs.description:
In short:

We are seeking an internationally seasoned, highly specialized Senior Lead - Pattern Engineer to spearhead the technical lifecycle of our global product lines from concept to production. This strategic leadership role requires an elite mastery of both digital and manual pattern architecture, combined with a proven track record of managing garment engineers while working closely with Design, Technical Design, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will directly lead, manage, and scale our internal team of pattern engineers. This position acts as the definitive global technical authority for pattern engineering - architecting scalable fitting systems, optimizing cross-functional 2D/3D workflows, and driving the professional growth of their direct reports to reduce development timelines and ensure flawless global fit consistency.

Your Mission:

• Lead, manage, and evaluate a dedicated internal team of Pattern Engineers.

• Design and execute internal training on advanced fitting techniques, complex pattern adjustments, and Gerber Accumark instruction.

• Manage team workflow distribution and capacity against dynamic seasonal product creation calendars.

• Establish global pattern standards and technical production standards relative to fit and quality benchmarks.

• Spearhead high-profile franchise updates and complex special projects, translating technical sketches into scalable, production-ready patterns.

• Implement and maintain robust systems for fitting processes, digital pattern management, and PLM pipelines to improve sample approval rates.

• Lead high-level fit sessions on live models, acting as the ultimate cross-functional expert between Design, Sourcing, and Materials.

• Drive the integration of 2D digital pattern making with 3D prototyping software (CLO/Browzwear) to optimize fabric efficiency.

Your Story:

• A minimum of 10–12+ years of progressive experience in pattern engineering and technical apparel design within premier global brands.international vendor communication. Knowledge of a Swiss national language (German, French, or Italian) is considered a strong asset.

• A degree in Apparel Design, Pattern Engineering, or a related field. Prior experience acting as an industry instructor or academic specialist in CAD/Pattern software is highly preferred.

• Proven track record of direct people management and supervisory experience, having previously led a team of pattern engineers, patternmakers, or technical designers in a brand environment.

• Expert-level proficiency in industry-leading CAD systems (specifically Gerber Accumark Explorer/Design & Marker Making or Lectra), PLM software, and Adobe Illustrator. High proficiency in 3D apparel simulation tools (CLO 3D or Browzwear) is required.

• Deep expertise in the unique physical properties of technical, performance, stretch-woven, and multi-category fabrics (including experience in complex categories like performance bottoms and custom structured garments).

• Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with a proven track record of driving process improvements, managing team performance, and presenting technical solutions to senior leadership.

• Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required as the primary language for global cross-functional collaboration and

Your Team:

In this role, you will collaborate with the Development, Design, Materials, Sourcing, suppliers, and Product Management teams to translate the product design intent and style vision into a consistent fit, quality, and execution level by leading the team responsible for our product’s technical specifications on fit, sizing, and commercialization requirements.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve:

Siamo alla ricerca di un leader senior altamente specializzato a livello internazionale - Pattern Engineer per testare il ciclo di vita tecnico delle nostre linee di prodotto globali dal concetto alla produzione. Questo ruolo di leadership strategica richiede una padronanza d'élite sia dell'architettura digitale che manuale del modello, unitamente a un comprovato record di traccia di gestione degli ingegneri del capo mentre si lavora a stretto contatto con Design, Design Tecnico e fornitori.

Il candidato di successo porterà direttamente, gestire e scalare il nostro team interno di ingegneri di pattern. Questa posizione agisce come l'autorità tecnica globale definitiva per l'ingegneria dei modelli - l'archiviazione di sistemi di montaggio scalabili, l'ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro 2D/3D interfunzionali e la crescita professionale dei loro rapporti diretti per ridurre i tempi di sviluppo e garantire una perfetta consistenza globale.

La vostra missione:

• Guidare, gestire e valutare un team interno dedicato di Pattern Engineers.

• Progettare ed eseguire la formazione interna su tecniche di montaggio avanzate, regolazioni complesse del modello e istruzioni Gerber Accumark.

• Gestisci la distribuzione del flusso di lavoro del team e la capacità contro i calendari di creazione dinamica dei prodotti stagionali.

• Stabilire standard di pattern globali e standard di produzione tecnica relativi a parametri di misura e qualità.

• Aggiornamenti di franchising di alto profilo e progetti speciali complessi, traducendo schizzi tecnici in modelli scalabili e pronti alla produzione.

• Implementare e mantenere sistemi robusti per i processi di montaggio, la gestione dei modelli digitali e le tubazioni PLM per migliorare i tassi di approvazione del campione.

• Condurre sessioni di vestibilità di alto livello su modelli dal vivo, agendo come l'ultimo esperto interfunzionale tra Design, Sourcing e Materiali.

• Guidare l'integrazione di modelli digitali 2D con software di prototipazione 3D (CLO/Browzwear) per ottimizzare l'efficienza del tessuto.

La tua storia:

• Un minimo di 10–12+ anni di esperienza progressiva nell'ingegneria del modello e nel design dell'abbigliamento tecnico all'interno di marchi leader globali. comunicazione di fornitori internazionali. La conoscenza di una lingua nazionale svizzera (tedesco, francese o italiano) è considerata un bene forte.

• Una laurea in Apparel Design, Pattern Engineering, o un campo correlato. L'esperienza precedente che funge da istruttore di settore o specialista accademico nel software CAD/Pattern è molto preferita.

• Provato record di gestione delle persone dirette e esperienza di supervisione, avendo precedentemente guidato un team di ingegneri di pattern, modellisti, o progettisti tecnici in un ambiente di marca.

• La competenza a livello di esperti nei sistemi CAD leader del settore (in particolare Gerber Accumark Explorer/Design & Marker Making o Lectra), software PLM e Adobe Illustrator. È necessaria un'elevata competenza negli strumenti di simulazione dell'abbigliamento 3D (CLO 3D o Browzwear).

• Profonda competenza nelle proprietà fisiche uniche di tessuti tecnici, performanti, tessuti elasticizzati e multi-categoria (compresa l'esperienza in categorie complesse come i fondali delle prestazioni e i capi strutturati personalizzati).

• Competenze di leadership interfunzionali eccezionali con un comprovato record di miglioramento del processo di guida, gestione delle prestazioni del team, e presentando soluzioni tecniche alla leadership senior.

• La piena fluidità professionale in inglese (scritto e parlato) è richiesta come lingua primaria per la collaborazione interfunzionale globale e

Il vostro team:

In questo ruolo, collaborerai con i team Development, Design, Materials, Sourcing, Fornitori e Product Management per tradurre l’intento di progettazione del prodotto e la visione di stile in un livello coerente di vestibilità, qualità e esecuzione, portando il team responsabile delle specifiche tecniche del nostro prodotto su misura, dimensionamento e requisiti di commercializzazione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In short:

We are seeking an internationally seasoned, highly specialized Senior Lead - Pattern Engineer to spearhead the technical lifecycle of our global product lines from concept to production. This strategic leadership role requires an elite mastery of both digital and manual pattern architecture, combined with a proven track record of managing garment engineers while working closely with Design, Technical Design, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will directly lead, manage, and scale our internal team of pattern engineers. This position acts as the definitive global technical authority for pattern engineering - architecting scalable fitting systems, optimizing cross-functional 2D/3D workflows, and driving the professional growth of their direct reports to reduce development timelines and ensure flawless global fit consistency.

Your Mission:

• Lead, manage, and evaluate a dedicated internal team of Pattern Engineers.

• Design and execute internal training on advanced fitting techniques, complex pattern adjustments, and Gerber Accumark instruction.

• Manage team workflow distribution and capacity against dynamic seasonal product creation calendars.

• Establish global pattern standards and technical production standards relative to fit and quality benchmarks.

• Spearhead high-profile franchise updates and complex special projects, translating technical sketches into scalable, production-ready patterns.

• Implement and maintain robust systems for fitting processes, digital pattern management, and PLM pipelines to improve sample approval rates.

• Lead high-level fit sessions on live models, acting as the ultimate cross-functional expert between Design, Sourcing, and Materials.

• Drive the integration of 2D digital pattern making with 3D prototyping software (CLO/Browzwear) to optimize fabric efficiency.

Your Story:

• A minimum of 10–12+ years of progressive experience in pattern engineering and technical apparel design within premier global brands.international vendor communication. Knowledge of a Swiss national language (German, French, or Italian) is considered a strong asset.

• A degree in Apparel Design, Pattern Engineering, or a related field. Prior experience acting as an industry instructor or academic specialist in CAD/Pattern software is highly preferred.

• Proven track record of direct people management and supervisory experience, having previously led a team of pattern engineers, patternmakers, or technical designers in a brand environment.

• Expert-level proficiency in industry-leading CAD systems (specifically Gerber Accumark Explorer/Design & Marker Making or Lectra), PLM software, and Adobe Illustrator. High proficiency in 3D apparel simulation tools (CLO 3D or Browzwear) is required.

• Deep expertise in the unique physical properties of technical, performance, stretch-woven, and multi-category fabrics (including experience in complex categories like performance bottoms and custom structured garments).

• Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with a proven track record of driving process improvements, managing team performance, and presenting technical solutions to senior leadership.

• Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required as the primary language for global cross-functional collaboration and

Your Team:

In this role, you will collaborate with the Development, Design, Materials, Sourcing, suppliers, and Product Management teams to translate the product design intent and style vision into a consistent fit, quality, and execution level by leading the team responsible for our product’s technical specifications on fit, sizing, and commercialization requirements.

• Verwalten Sie die Verteilung und Kapazität des Teamworkflows anhand dynamischer saisonaler Produkterstellungskalender.

• Tiefes Know-how in den einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von technischen, Performance-, Stretch-Woven- und Multi-Kategorie-Stoffen (einschließlich Erfahrung in komplexen Kategorien wie Performance-Boden und kundenspezifische strukturierte Kleidungsstücke).

• Volle professionelle Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) sind als primäre Sprache für die globale funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit erforderlich.

Bref:

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Senior Lead - Pattern Engineer expérimenté et hautement spécialisé à l'échelle internationale pour diriger le cycle de vie technique de nos gammes de produits mondiales du concept à la production. Ce rôle de leadership stratégique exige une maîtrise d'élite de l'architecture numérique et manuelle, combinée à une expérience éprouvée de la gestion des ingénieurs de vêtements tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec Design, Technical Design et fournisseurs.

Le candidat retenu dirigera, gérera et mettra à l'échelle directement notre équipe interne d'ingénieurs de modèles. Cette position est l'autorité technique mondiale définitive pour l'ingénierie de modèles - l'architecture de systèmes d'ajustement évolutives, l'optimisation des flux de travail 2D/3D interfonctionnels, et l'impulsion de la croissance professionnelle de leurs rapports directs pour réduire les délais de développement et assurer une cohérence d'ajustement mondial impeccable.

Votre mission :

• Diriger, gérer et évaluer une équipe interne dédiée d'ingénieurs modèles.

• Concevoir et exécuter une formation interne sur les techniques d'ajustement avancées, les réglages complexes des motifs et l'instruction Gerber Accumark.

• Gérer la distribution et la capacité des workflows d'équipe en fonction des calendriers de création de produits saisonniers dynamiques.

• Établir des normes de configuration mondiales et des normes techniques de production en fonction des critères d'adéquation et de qualité.

• Des mises à jour de franchise haut de gamme Spearhead et des projets spéciaux complexes, traduisant des croquis techniques en modèles évolutifs et prêts à la production.

• Mettre en place et maintenir des systèmes robustes pour les processus d'ajustement, la gestion numérique des modèles et les pipelines de PLM afin d'améliorer les taux d'approbation des échantillons.

• Diriger des séances d'ajustement de haut niveau sur des modèles en direct, agissant comme l'expert interfonctionnel ultime entre la conception, l'approvisionnement et les matériaux.

• Conduisez l'intégration de la fabrication numérique 2D avec le logiciel de prototypage 3D (CLO/Browzwear) pour optimiser l'efficacité des tissus.

Votre histoire :

• Un minimum de 10 à 12 ans d'expérience progressive dans l'ingénierie de motifs et la conception de vêtements techniques au sein de grandes marques mondiales. communication internationale des fournisseurs. La connaissance d'une langue nationale suisse (allemand, français ou italien) est considérée comme un atout important.

• Diplôme en conception de vêtements, en génie des motifs ou dans un domaine connexe. L'expérience antérieure en tant qu'instructeur de l'industrie ou spécialiste universitaire dans les logiciels CAO/Pattern est hautement préférée.

• Expérience éprouvée de la gestion directe des personnes et de la supervision, ayant auparavant dirigé une équipe d'ingénieurs de modèles, de concepteurs de modèles ou de concepteurs techniques dans un environnement de marque.

• Compétence de niveau expert dans les systèmes CAO de pointe de l'industrie (notamment Gerber Accumark Explorer/Design & Marker Making ou Lectra), les logiciels PLM et Adobe Illustrator. Une compétence élevée en outils de simulation de vêtements 3D (CLO 3D ou Browzwear) est requise.

• Expertise approfondie dans les propriétés physiques uniques des tissus techniques, de performance, stretch-tissé et multi-catégories (y compris l'expérience dans des catégories complexes comme les bas de performance et les vêtements structurés sur mesure).

• Compétences exceptionnelles en leadership interfonctionnel avec une expérience éprouvée d'amélioration des processus de conduite, de gestion du rendement de l'équipe et de présentation de solutions techniques aux cadres supérieurs.

• Une maîtrise professionnelle complète de l'anglais (écrit et parlé) est requise comme langue principale pour la collaboration internationale et

Votre équipe :

Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez avec les équipes Développement, Conception, Matériaux, Sourcing, Fournisseurs et Gestion des Produits pour traduire l'intention de conception des produits et la vision de style en un niveau d'ajustement, de qualité et d'exécution cohérent en dirigeant l'équipe responsable de nos spécifications techniques sur l'ajustement, le dimensionnement et la commercialisation.

jobs.description:
In short:

On is looking for a pragmatic, business-minded lawyer to join our Intellectual Property Team as Senior Lead, Intellectual Property & Brand Protection Counsel. In this role, you will play a critical role in proactively protecting On’s trademarks, designs, and innovations. You will thrive here if you can independently manage complex matters, anticipate issues before they escalate, and provide clear, practical advice in a fast-moving global business.

Your Mission:

• Advise global and regional teams on a broad range of intellectual property matters, including brand protection, anticounterfeiting, and enforcement.

• Lead global brand protection and anti-counterfeiting investigations and actions efficiently and aligned with business objectives.

• Develop and implement enforcement strategies.

• Partner with cross-functional teams and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholder groups, conduct trainings and raise IP awareness.

• Build scalable processes, playbooks, and guidelines and drive practical solutions that reflect both global priorities and regional requirements.

• Support strategic IP projects as needed.

Your Story:

• Law degree and 7+ years of legal experience, including in-house experience.

• Experience at a global consumer-facing brand is preferred.

• Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance legal risk and business objectives.

• Excellent negotiation, communication (Fluent English) and analytical skills.

• Ability to provide clear, practical advice in high-pressure, fast-moving environments.

• Collaborative style and strong relationship-building skills across diverse teams and stakeholders.

• Process-minded and curious, with a track record of improving how legal work gets done.

• Comfortable operating independently, prioritizing effectively and working across unfamiliar legal or business issues.

Your Team:

Being part of the On Legal Team means working as an entrepreneurial, solutions-oriented partner to the business. We move quickly, think commercially, and work closely across regions and functions to help On grow responsibly. You will have autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to shape intellectual property at On.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Last Engineer
jobs.description:
In Short

At On, the secret to our signature cloud-like sensation starts from the inside out. The last is the very foundation of our footwear, dictating fit, performance, and aesthetic. We are seeking a visionary Senior Lead Last Engineer to pioneer the creation, optimization, and management of our footwear lasts across all product categories.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between biomechanics, design, and manufacturing. You will serve as the central authority on all last-related topics, ensuring our performance running, fashion, and lifestyle shoes deliver the ultimate fit and experience for our global community.

Key Responsibilities

• Standardization & Consolidation: Establish clear standards and best practices for all new last creations. Champion the implementation of these guidelines across internal teams and suppliers to strategically consolidate and optimize our existing last library.

• Last Creation & Internal Consulting: Lead the hands-on creation of new lasts while acting as the primary technical consultant for Design, Development, and Innovation teams regarding last grading, selection, and fit optimization for new and existing projects.

• Supplier Relationship Management: Build and manage strong, collaborative relationships with external last suppliers and manufacturers to ensure quality, precision, and timely delivery.

• Library Management: Own and meticulously maintain our comprehensive digital and physical last libraries, ensuring all data is accurate, organized, and easily accessible to cross-functional teams.

• Sourcing & Production Support: Partner with the Sourcing and Manufacturing teams to resolve technical last challenges, streamline production processes, and provide expert guidance on last-related topics at the factory level.

• Process Innovation: Continuously evaluate and improve our last development workflows, integrating the latest 3D modeling technologies and fit-data insights.

Requirements

• Comprehensive Last Modeling Expertise: 8 years+ hands-on experience in last engineering across both high-performance running and fashion/lifestyle footwear. You must possess a deep understanding of dynamic fit, foot anatomy, and biomechanics, while also knowing how to balance complex aesthetic requirements with commercial fit standards.

• Program & Library Management: Proven experience managing comprehensive last development programs for a sports or performance footwear brand. Must possess exceptional organizational skills to build, consolidate, and seamlessly manage extensive digital and physical last libraries while juggling multiple development calendars from concept to mass production.

• Manufacturing Equipment Operation: Practical ability to utilize physical last manufacturing and digitizing equipment, specifically 3D scanners and milling machines, to create, reverse-engineer, and modify physical models.

• Technical & CAD Proficiency: Advanced skills in 3D CAD software relevant to last design and modification (e.g., Romans CAD, Rhino, or similar footwear-specific engineering tools).

• Industry Knowledge: Extensive understanding of footwear manufacturing processes, tooling, and grading principles.

• Project Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage extensive digital and physical libraries and juggle multiple development calendars simultaneously.

• Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and external suppliers.

About the Team

The Footwear Engineering team is a highly specialized collective of Pattern Engineers, Tooling Engineers, and Last Engineers who hold the keys to the ultimate fit, feel, and ride of every On shoe. Rooted in our proud heritage of meticulous Swiss engineering, we obsess over every millimeter and material to craft the absolute best performance products for elite athletes and everyday consumers alike. We are the critical bridge between radical design and physical reality, working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment where data-driven precision fuels our relentless dedication to human movement.

• Supplier Relationship Management: Build and manage strong, collaborative relationships with external last suppliers and manufacturers to ensure quality, precision, and timely delivery.

• Process Innovation: Continuously evaluate and improve our last development workflows, integrating the latest 3D modeling technologies and fit-data insights.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Footwear Testing
jobs.description:
In short:

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We’re responsible for ensuring every On product meets the highest quality standards and delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight. Through rigorous testing and validation, only products that truly perform make it to market.

As a Footwear Testing Senior Lead you will be responsible for validating footwear products from development through to market and driving excellence and leading the team in the Running category. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, Product Strategy and Sports Science to ensure excellence in fit, comfort, durability, and performance.

Your Mission:

• Lead a high-performing team of Specialists, fostering a culture of growth and exploration while elevating existing, successful workflows.

• Serve as a senior point of contact for internal stakeholders in the Run category, providing guidance and alignment on testing projects.

• Collaborate closely with key stakeholders to identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, owning end to end processes for assigned projects

• Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, fit, comfort, and performance, taking charge of high-complexity testing programs.

• Lead qualitative and quantitative footwear testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs.

• Build and maintain strategic partnerships to integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.

• Translate complex testing data into powerful insights and clear reports that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization.

• Ensure testing timelines are efficient and seamlessly integrated into the fast-moving Product Creation calendars.

• Expand and cultivate a diverse tester network to support project timelines and enhance community engagement.

• Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate & high-quality data integrity.

• As a leader you will significantly contribute to team goals and process improvements.

Your Story:

• 8+ years of experience in footwear testing or a closely related role within the footwear industry

• A strong passion for run culture and performance running footwear.

• Proven leadership experience, with a passion for building high-performance teams

• Ability to influence cross-functional team effectiveness through partnership & advisory

• Excellent communication skills and confidence in working with cross-functional stakeholders.

• A detail-oriented, creative, and solutions-focused mindset.

• Flexibility to work outside standard hours when necessary.

• Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint & capable of adapting to internal databases

• Analysis expertise with complex data and analysis methods

• Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Your Team:

We’re a team responsible for making sure that the products for On represent the highest quality & performance standards. We have a lot of responsibility to meet the needs and demands of our customers. So we analyse, test and validate our products in the most comprehensive manner. Only products that pass our rigorous tests ever go to market.

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve:

Test del prodotto è la voce dell'atleta e del consumatore su On. Siamo responsabili di garantire ogni Su prodotto soddisfa i più elevati standard di qualità e offre un'esperienza premium e ad alte prestazioni combinando rigore scientifico con intuizione nel mondo reale. Attraverso test rigorosi e validazione, solo i prodotti che realmente eseguono lo rendono al mercato.

Come Footwear Testing Senior Lead sarai responsabile della validazione dei prodotti per calzature dallo sviluppo fino al mercato e alla guida dell'eccellenza e della guida del team nella categoria Running. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente collaborativo veloce e agire come partner chiave in Design, Sviluppo, Materiali, Strategia del Prodotto e Scienza dello Sport per garantire l'eccellenza in forma, comfort, durata e prestazioni.

La vostra missione:

• Condurre un team di specialisti altamente performanti, promuovendo una cultura di crescita e di esplorazione, aumentando i flussi di lavoro esistenti e di successo.

• Servire come punto di contatto senior per gli stakeholder interni nella categoria Run, fornendo orientamento e allineamento sui progetti di test.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con le principali parti interessate per identificare i requisiti di prova basati su brief di prodotto e consumatori target, possedere processi finali per i progetti assegnati

• Definire ed eseguire rigorose strategie di test tra durata, vestibilità, comfort e prestazioni, assumendo la carica di programmi di test ad alta complessità.

• Condurre test qualitativi e quantitativi di calzature, studi di percezione e validazione del mondo reale per garantire che i prodotti riflettano le esigenze dell'atleta e del consumatore autentico.

• Costruire e mantenere partnership strategiche per integrare le conoscenze dei consumatori, le competenze scientifiche e l'analisi delle prestazioni nelle valutazioni standardizzate e basate su prove.

• Traduci dati di test complessi in potenti intuizioni e report chiari che consentono un processo decisionale sicuro ed elevare l'eccellenza del prodotto in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Assicurarsi che i tempi di prova siano efficienti e integrati senza soluzione di continuità nei calendari di creazione del prodotto in rapida evoluzione.

• Espandere e coltivare una rete di tester diversificata per supportare i tempi del progetto e migliorare il coinvolgimento della comunità.

• Lavorare senza soluzione di continuità con sistemi di test e database per garantire l'integrità dei dati accurata e di alta qualità.

• Come leader contribuirai in modo significativo agli obiettivi del team e ai miglioramenti del processo.

La tua storia:

• 8+ anni di esperienza nel test delle calzature o un ruolo strettamente correlato nell'industria calzaturiera

• Una forte passione per la cultura di corsa e le calzature da corsa.

• Provata esperienza di leadership, con la passione per la costruzione di team ad alte prestazioni

• Capacità di influenzare l'efficacia del team attraverso partnership e consulenza

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e fiducia nel lavorare con gli stakeholder interfunzionali.

• Una mentalità orientata al dettaglio, creativa e orientata alle soluzioni.

• Flessibilità di lavorare al di fuori delle ore standard quando necessario.

• Proficienza in Excel e PowerPoint & in grado di adattarsi ai database interni

• Competenze di analisi con metodi di analisi e dati complessi

• Fluente in inglese (scritto e parlato).

Il vostro team:

Siamo un team responsabile per assicurarci che i prodotti per On rappresentino i più alti standard di qualità e prestazioni. Abbiamo un sacco di responsabilità per soddisfare le esigenze e le richieste dei nostri clienti. Analizziamo, testiamo e valutiamo i nostri prodotti nel modo più completo. Solo i prodotti che superano i nostri rigorosi test vanno al mercato.

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurzum:

Product Testing ist die Stimme des Athleten und des Verbrauchers bei On. Wir sind dafür verantwortlich, dass jeder On product erfüllt die höchsten Qualitätsstandards und bietet eine erstklassige, leistungsstarke Erfahrung, indem es wissenschaftliche Strenge mit realen Erkenntnissen kombiniert. Durch strenge Tests und Validierungen kommen nur Produkte auf den Markt, die wirklich funktionieren.

Als Senior Lead für den Schuhtest bist du dafür verantwortlich, Schuhprodukte von der Entwicklung bis zum Markt zu validieren und Exzellenz zu fördern und das Team in der Kategorie Running zu führen. Sie arbeiten in einer schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Umgebung und fungieren als wichtiger Partner für Design, Entwicklung, Materialien, Produktstrategie und Sportwissenschaft, um hervorragende Passform, Komfort, Langlebigkeit und Leistung zu gewährleisten.

Ihre Mission:

• Führen Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team von Spezialisten, das eine Kultur des Wachstums und der Erkundung fördert und gleichzeitig bestehende, erfolgreiche Workflows verbessert.

• Dienen Sie als leitender Ansprechpartner für interne Stakeholder in der Run-Kategorie und bieten Sie Orientierung und Ausrichtung auf Testprojekte.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen Stakeholdern, um Testanforderungen basierend auf Produktbriefings und Zielverbrauchern zu identifizieren und Ende-zu-Ende-Prozesse für zugewiesene Projekte zu besitzen

• Definieren und führen Sie strenge Teststrategien für Haltbarkeit, Passform, Komfort und Leistung aus und übernehmen Sie hochkomplexe Testprogramme.

• Führen Sie qualitative und quantitative Schuhtests, Wahrnehmungsstudien und Validierungen in der realen Welt durch, um sicherzustellen, dass Produkte authentische Bedürfnisse von Sportlern und Verbrauchern widerspiegeln.

• Aufbau und Pflege strategischer Partnerschaften zur Integration von Verbraucherinformationen, wissenschaftlicher Expertise und Leistungsanalyse in standardisierte, evidenzbasierte Produktbewertungen.

• Übersetzen Sie komplexe Testdaten in leistungsstarke Erkenntnisse und klare Berichte, die eine sichere Entscheidungsfindung ermöglichen und die Produktexzellenz im gesamten Unternehmen erhöhen.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Testzeiten effizient und nahtlos in die schnelllebigen Produkterstellungskalender integriert sind.

• Erweitern und pflegen Sie ein vielfältiges Testernetzwerk, um die Projektzeitpläne zu unterstützen und das Engagement der Community zu verbessern.

• Arbeiten Sie nahtlos mit Testsystemen und Datenbanken, um eine genaue und qualitativ hochwertige Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten.

• Als Führungskraft tragen Sie wesentlich zu Teamzielen und Prozessverbesserungen bei.

Deine Geschichte:

• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Schuhprüfung oder eine eng verwandte Rolle in der Schuhindustrie

• Eine starke Leidenschaft für Laufkultur und Performance Laufschuhe.

• Bewährte Führungserfahrung mit Leidenschaft für den Aufbau von Hochleistungsteams

• Fähigkeit, die funktionsübergreifende Teameffektivität durch Partnerschaft und Beratung zu beeinflussen

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Vertrauen in die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern.

• Eine detailorientierte, kreative und lösungsorientierte Denkweise.

• Flexibilität, um bei Bedarf außerhalb der Standardstunden zu arbeiten.

• Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint & in der Lage, sich an interne Datenbanken anzupassen

• Analysekompetenz mit komplexen Daten und Analysemethoden

• fließend Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen).

Ihr Team:

Wir sind ein Team, das dafür verantwortlich ist, dass die Produkte für On die höchsten Qualitäts- und Leistungsstandards erfüllen. Wir haben eine große Verantwortung, die Bedürfnisse und Anforderungen unserer Kunden zu erfüllen. Daher analysieren, testen und validieren wir unsere Produkte auf umfassendste Weise. Nur Produkte, die unsere strengen Tests bestehen, kommen jemals auf den Markt.

On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten eine Umgebung, die den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln - aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovieren. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz kombiniert eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zu persönlicher Selbstfürsorge für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jede Person von ihrem Zweck geleitet wird.

On ist ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber. Wir sind bestrebt, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Rekrutierung, Förderung und Bindung frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref:

Le test produit est la voix de l'athlète et du consommateur chez On. Nous sommes responsables d'assurer chaque Sur le produit répond aux normes de qualité les plus élevées et offre une expérience premium et haute performance en combinant la rigueur scientifique avec la vision du monde réel. Grâce à des tests rigoureux et à la validation, seuls les produits qui réalisent réellement le sont sur le marché.

En tant que responsable principal des tests de chaussures, vous serez responsable de la validation des produits de chaussures, du développement jusqu'à l'excellence sur le marché et la conduite, ainsi que de la direction de l'équipe dans la catégorie Courses. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif et rapide et agirez comme un partenaire clé dans la conception, le développement, les matériaux, la stratégie de produit et la science du sport pour assurer l'excellence dans l'ajustement, le confort, la durabilité et la performance.

Votre mission :

• Diriger une équipe de spécialistes hautement performante, favoriser une culture de croissance et d'exploration tout en augmentant les flux de travail existants et fructueux.

• Servir de point de contact principal pour les intervenants internes de la catégorie Run, en fournissant des conseils et de l'harmonisation sur les projets d'essai.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les principaux intervenants pour déterminer les exigences en matière d'essais en fonction des mémoires produits et des consommateurs cibles, en tenant compte des processus de fin de projet assignés

• Définir et exécuter des stratégies d'essai rigoureuses à travers la durabilité, l'ajustement, le confort et la performance, en prenant en charge des programmes d'essai haute complexité.

• Essais qualitatifs et quantitatifs de chaussures de plomb, études de perception et validation du monde réel pour s'assurer que les produits reflètent les besoins authentiques des athlètes et des consommateurs.

• Établir et maintenir des partenariats stratégiques pour intégrer les connaissances des consommateurs, l'expertise scientifique et l'analyse du rendement dans des évaluations normalisées de produits fondées sur des données probantes.

• Traduire des données d'essais complexes en renseignements puissants et en rapports clairs qui permettent de prendre des décisions confiantes et d'améliorer l'excellence des produits dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

• S'assurer que les calendriers d'essais sont efficaces et intégrés de façon transparente dans les calendriers de création de produits en mouvement rapide.

• Élargir et cultiver un réseau diversifié de testeurs pour appuyer les échéanciers des projets et améliorer l'engagement communautaire.

• Travailler en toute transparence avec les systèmes d'essai et les bases de données afin d'assurer l'intégrité exacte et de haute qualité des données.

• En tant que leader, vous contribuerez de façon significative aux objectifs de l'équipe et aux améliorations des processus.

Votre histoire :

• 8+ ans d'expérience dans les essais de chaussures ou un rôle étroitement lié dans l'industrie de la chaussure

• Une forte passion pour la culture de run et les chaussures de run performance.

• Expérience de leadership éprouvée, avec une passion pour la construction d'équipes de haute performance

• Capacité d'influencer l'efficacité des équipes interfonctionnelles par le biais de partenariats et de conseils

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Footwear Developer
jobs.description:
In short

Based at our Zurich HQ, you will be the driving force behind delivering the most premium sports products in the industry, championing groundbreaking creation and fearlessly challenging traditional processes to achieve it. In this role, you will seamlessly connect the granular with the strategic—acting as a hands-on technical master of the details while serving as the high-level strategic consultant for On’s most critical category. By ensuring perfect alignment between design vision and manufacturing feasibility, you will set the standard for footwear creation. You will provide the technical governance, cross-functional leadership, and visionary support necessary to implement elite performance standards and protect product integrity.

The Senior Lead Development role will report to the Head of Innovation Footwear, supporting the wider global footwear department.

Please Read Before Applying:
To ensure a smooth and efficient recruitment process, we kindly ask all applicants to submit their CV in English, as this is the working language of our company.

Your Mission

• Technical Stewardship: Act as the primary technical advisor during the briefing and design phases to ensure performance running concepts are aligned with global manufacturing capabilities.

• Strategic Synchronization: Facilitate technical alignment between Zurich-based Design/Product Management and the Asia-based execution teams, ensuring that the "performance soul" of the category is preserved across all franchises.

• Process Enablement: Support the evolution of development standards by identifying technical bottlenecks and advising on best practices that improve category-wide efficiency.

• Advisory & Escalation Support: Serve as the senior technical point of contact for Asia-based development partners, providing guidance on complex technical hurdles and supporting the resolution of high-level production escalations.

• Performance Quality Assurance: Support the validation of fit, feel, and durability standards, ensuring that category-wide technical benchmarks are consistently met across different factory partners.

• Knowledge Facilitation: Foster a culture of technical excellence by mentoring the broader development team and translating complex innovation breakthroughs into actionable development frameworks.

Your Story

• Experience: 8–12+ years in footwear development. A background rooted in high-performance footwear and technical complexity is preferred.

• Passionate product builder: You love to build product that makes athletes better, obsessing over the details and the athlete.

• Influential Leadership: Proven ability to influence product direction and technical outcomes through partnership and advisory, rather than direct line management or project ownership.

• Systemic Thinking: A deep understanding of how performance tooling, materials, and construction impact the global supply chain and product lifecycle.

• Collaborative Bridge: Exceptional at navigating HQ and regional dynamics, acting as a "technical translator" between creative vision and factory execution.

• Strategic Judgment: Highly skilled at evaluating technical trade-offs and providing recommendations that balance innovation with commercial scalability.

• Consultative Communication: A trusted voice capable of guiding stakeholders toward technically sound decisions while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.

Attributes of a successful candidate:

• The Technical Advisor: You don't need to hold the pen on every tech pack, but you are the person everyone consults when a design pushes the boundaries of physics.

• The Strategic Partner: You focus on the "how" and "why," ensuring the category’s technical roadmap is robust and scalable.

• The Alignment Specialist: You thrive in the space between teams, ensuring that no technical detail is "lost in translation" between Zurich and our global manufacturing partners.

• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written.

Your Team

You will join the Zurich-based Footwear Development team, serving as a senior pillar of expertise. A high-performance collective of engineers, developers, and makers who serve as the technical heart of the brand.

In Zurich, our team acts as the primary link between Biomechanical Research, Material Science, Design, and Sourcing, ensuring that every innovation is grounded in technical reality before it reaches the athlete.

Our mission is to relentlessly elevate the performance and technical attributes of our footwear. We don't just facilitate product creation; we engineer the "ride." As part of the vertical, you will be surrounded by specialists who are obsessed with creating the best fitting, performing and desirable products in the market.

We pride ourselves on a culture of technical rigor and "Swiss Engineering," where we challenge the status quo to solve the most complex biomechanical hurdles in the industry. Your role within this team is to ensure that as our category expands, our technical standards and the performance "soul" of our footwear remain uncompromised.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Footwear Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Lead Footwear Developer

In short:

As the Senior Lead Footwear Developer for Performance Running, you serve as the strategic technical consultant for our most critical product category. Based in our Zurich HQ, your role is to ensure high-level alignment between design intent and manufacturing feasibility. Rather than managing the granular execution of every product, you provide the technical governance and cross-functional support necessary to maintain performance integrity as the category scales.

The Senior Lead Development role will report to the Senior Lead Run Footwear Development on the Performance Run team supporting global footwear.

Your Mission:

• Technical Stewardship: Act as the primary technical advisor during the briefing and design phases to ensure performance running concepts are aligned with global manufacturing capabilities.

• Strategic Synchronization: Facilitate technical alignment between Zurich-based Design/Product Management and the Asia-based execution teams, ensuring that the "performance soul" of the category is preserved across all franchises.

• Process Enablement: Support the evolution of development standards by identifying technical bottlenecks and advising on best practices that improve category-wide efficiency.

• Advisory & Escalation Support: Serve as the senior technical point of contact for Asia-based development partners, providing guidance on complex technical hurdles and supporting the resolution of high-level production escalations.

• Performance Quality Assurance: Support the validation of fit, feel, and durability standards, ensuring that category-wide technical benchmarks are consistently met across different factory partners.

• Knowledge Facilitation: Foster a culture of technical excellence by mentoring the broader development team and translating complex innovation breakthroughs into actionable development frameworks.

Your Story:

• Experience: 8–12 years in footwear development, with a background rooted in high-performance running and technical complexity.

• Influential Leadership: Proven ability to influence product direction and technical outcomes through partnership and advisory, rather than direct line management or project ownership.

• Systemic Thinking: A deep understanding of how performance tooling, materials, and construction impact the global supply chain and product lifecycle.

• Collaborative Bridge: Exceptional at navigating HQ and regional dynamics, acting as a "technical translator" between creative vision and factory execution.

• Strategic Judgment: Highly skilled at evaluating technical trade-offs and providing recommendations that balance innovation with commercial scalability.

• Consultative Communication: A trusted voice capable of guiding stakeholders toward technically sound decisions while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.

Attributes of a successful candidate:

• The Technical Advisor: You don't need to hold the pen on every tech pack, but you are the person everyone consults when a design pushes the boundaries of physics.

• The Strategic Partner: You focus on the "how" and "why," ensuring the category’s technical roadmap is robust and scalable.

• The Alignment Specialist: You thrive in the space between teams, ensuring that no technical detail is "lost in translation" between Zurich and our global manufacturing partners.

Your Team:

You will join the Zurich-based Footwear Development team, serving as a senior pillar of expertise for the Performance Running category. A high-performance collective of engineers, developers, and makers who serve as the technical heart of the brand. In Zurich, our team acts as the primary link between Biomechanical Research, Material Science, Design , and Sourcing, ensuring that every innovation is grounded in technical reality before it reaches the athlete.

Our mission is to relentlessly elevate the performance and technical attributes of our running footwear. We don't just facilitate product creation; we engineer the "ride." As part of the Performance Run vertical, you will be surrounded by specialists who are obsessed with creating the best fitting, performing and desirable running product in the market. We pride ourselves on a culture of technical rigor and "Swiss Engineering," where we challenge the status quo to solve the most complex biomechanical hurdles in the industry. Your role within this team is to ensure that as our category expands, our technical standards and the performance "soul" of our run footwear remain uncompromised.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.description:
Senior Lead - Expansion Management (6-months maternity cover)

At a Glance:

This role supports On's continued global expansion by harmonising regional and channel efforts, ensuring efficient

planning and competency build-up for effective market expansion across all channels. The role initially focuses on

Distributor Markets and Showroom roll-out, with a broader expansion view on commercial expansion readiness.

Your Team:

You will be joining the Global Commercial Programs & Market Expansion team - the command centre behind some of our most critical and high-impact strategic initiatives. This is where strategy turns into action and where we push ideas all the way to the finish line.

Operating at the intersection of Commercial Strategy, Sales, Product, GTM, Tech, and regional markets, the team drives the programs that shape how we operate, scale our business, and unlock new growth opportunities. We take complex challenges, bring clarity and structure, and turn them into tangible results.

While anchored within the broader Commercial Operations setup, the team operates with a strong strategy and business development mindset, focusing on translating strategic priorities into execution that drives premium growth and commercial impact.

Think of us as the team that bridges strategy and execution, aligning the right people, making sharp decisions, and turning ambition into measurable business results.

If you’re energized by shaping direction, solving complex challenges, and driving real impact, you found your team!

Your Mission:

• Develop and execute comprehensive commercial operational readiness plans for new market launches and expansion missions, defining ownership and timelines across key milestones and relevant workstreams

• Identify and mitigate potential commercial operational risks and challenges specific to channel and regional expansions, ensuring proactive problem-solving

• Lead the establishment of standard operating procedures, guidelines, and templates for commercial agreements and subsequent contract management in collaboration with regional stakeholders

• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, product, etc.) to ensure alignment on commercial operational requirements and seamless GTM execution in line with regional expansion plans

• Serve as the central point of contact for all commercial operational readiness inquiries, facilitating effective communication and coordination across diverse teams

• Support regional Commercial teams in distribution partner onboarding and offboarding processes, adapting global tools and processes to local market realities

• Identify and map resource requirements (personnel, technology, budget) for commercial capability build-up in partnership with regional and global stakeholders to ensure clarity of roles and responsibilities

• Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of commercial market expansion activities, monitor progress, and drive continuous improvement through regular reporting to stakeholders

Your Story:

• You have 8+ years of relevant project management experience, preferably in the Sports industry or global retail

• You are experienced in market-focused roles - experience outside Europe is a strong plus

• You have an ability to translate strategic goals into actionable commercial plans

• You have an understanding of global market dynamics and regional nuances

• You have a strong understanding of commercial operations processes and systems (GTM, CRM, ERP, etc.)

• You have an exceptional ability to build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships

• You have excellent communication and influencing skills

• You have experience working in global matrix organisations

What we offer:

A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles and challenges.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Exhibiton Programming
jobs.description:
In short

We are establishing our first-ever public cultural destination and dedicated exhibition space at our Zurich HQ, launching early 2027. We are looking for a visionary, globally-connected Senior Lead Exhibition Programming & Curation to shape and build this new cultural landmark from the ground up.

As an exceptional cross-disciplinary curator and autonomous project leader, you will design and orchestrate a living ecosystem that sits at the intersection of design, innovation, and art. Operating as the strategic engine of this space, you will maintain a continuous, highly dynamic calendar of exhibitions, artist-in-residence programs, and discursive events. You will ensure the space remains a continuously populated, world-class inspiration hub that seamlessly bridges public cultural engagement with dynamic internal workshops, co-creation sessions, and cross-disciplinary inspiration for our product teams.

Your mission

• Establish the Curatorial Vision: Define and execute a holistic, multi-disciplinary exhibition and event strategy that builds brand equity and long-term cultural legitimacy. You will develop overarching annual narratives that thread contemporary art, cinema, design, movement, and technology into an expansive, accessible public dialogue.

• Bridge worlds: Act as the vital link between external creative communities, global cultural institutions, and our internal product teams. You will design public-facing cultural moments while simultaneously programming the space as an internal sandbox for design workshops, co-creation sessions, and cross-disciplinary inspiration.

• Orchestrate the Artist-in-Residence Program: Head the strategic definition and curation of the Artist-in-Residence Program. You will invite established international talent and launch open calls for young creative communities, empowering residents to populate the space with their networks while embedding them into our technological research environment.

• Maintain Continuous Programming & Occupancy: Direct a rolling, continuous calendar of exhibitions, public community events, and internal activations. You will maximize the space's utility and inspiration potential year-round, ensuring it stays dynamically utilized and seamlessly adapted to changing programming needs.

• Operational Excellence: Manage and maintain full oversight of the programming budget, resource allocation, vendor contracts, and artist fees. You will source and supervise external technical teams, art handlers, and operational logistics, ensuring the exhibition infrastructure functions at a high-performance, premium scale.

Your story

• Cultural & Cross-Disciplinary Expert: You bring a deep background (10-12+ years) in curating and producing contemporary art exhibitions, residencies, or cultural programming, backed by an active global network.

• Strategic & Para-Curatorial Thinker: You excel at shifting ideas into alternative, highly desirable formats (talks, dinners, workshops) to build deep community engagement rather than just static showcases.

• Autonomous and Agile Self-Starter: You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments and are comfortable running a solo operation. You are equally skilled at driving long-term curatorial strategy and managing the practical realities of complex, multi-year timelines, international artist logistics, and external vendor networks without waiting for a predefined playbook.

• Collaboration-Minded Thinker: You understand how to align a cultural calendar with corporate realities. You possess the diplomacy to manage internal stakeholders, ensuring the space effortlessly transitions between public exhibition mode and internal team alignment/workshop mode.

• Inspirational Storyteller: You can translate complex artistic, technological, or design concepts into highly compelling copy, editorial initiatives, or physical media that resonate with a global fan base.

About the team

You will report directly to the Chief of Staff (CoS) of Design, sitting at the heart of a vibrant and diverse Design Studio that drives On’s disruptive product design across footwear, apparel, and accessories. We are a team that values creativity, curiosity, and collaboration, and we are looking for someone who shares our passion for turning the "why" of our past into the "what's next" of our future.
