descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Istituiamo la nostra prima destinazione culturale pubblica e lo spazio espositivo dedicato al nostro quartier generale di Zurigo, lanciando all'inizio del 2027. Stiamo cercando un visionario, globalmente collegato Senior Lead Exhibition Programming & Curation per modellare e costruire questo nuovo punto di riferimento culturale da zero.

Come eccezionale curatore interdisciplinare e responsabile del progetto autonomo, disegna e orchestra un ecosistema vivente che siede all'intersezione del design, dell'innovazione e dell'arte. Operando come motore strategico di questo spazio, si manterrà un calendario continuo e altamente dinamico di mostre, programmi di artista-in-residenza e eventi discorrevoli. Garantirai che lo spazio rimanga un hub di ispirazione di livello mondiale continuamente popolato che collega senza soluzione di continuità l'impegno culturale pubblico con workshop interni dinamici, sessioni di co-creazione e ispirazione interdisciplinare per i nostri team di prodotti.

La tua missione

• Stabilire la Visione Curatoriale: Definire ed eseguire una strategia espositiva e di eventi olistica e multidisciplinare che costruisce l'equità del marchio e la legittimità culturale a lungo termine. Svilupperai narrazioni annue che infilano arte contemporanea, cinema, design, movimento e tecnologia in un ampio e accessibile dialogo pubblico.

• Mondi di bridge: agire come il legame vitale tra comunità creative esterne, istituzioni culturali globali e le nostre squadre di prodotti interni. Progetterai momenti culturali pubblici, programmando allo stesso tempo lo spazio come sandbox interno per workshop di progettazione, sessioni di co-creazione e ispirazione interdisciplinare.

• Orchestrare il programma Artist-in-Residence: dirigere la definizione strategica e la cura del programma Artist-in-Residence. Invitate i talenti internazionali consolidati e lanciate bande aperte per le giovani comunità creative, consentendo ai residenti di popolare lo spazio con le loro reti, integrandoli nel nostro ambiente di ricerca tecnologica.

• Mantenere la programmazione continua e occupazione: Dirigere un calendario continuo di mostre, eventi della comunità pubblica e attivazioni interne. Potrai massimizzare l'utilità dello spazio e l'ispirazione potenziale tutto l'anno, assicurando che rimanga dinamicamente utilizzato e perfettamente adattato alle mutevoli esigenze di programmazione.

• Eccellenza Operativa: Gestisci e mantieni la completa supervisione del budget di programmazione, dell'allocazione delle risorse, dei contratti dei fornitori e delle tasse dell'artista. La fonte e la supervisione di team tecnici esterni, gestori d'arte e logistica operativa, assicurando le funzioni dell'infrastruttura espositiva in scala premium e ad alte prestazioni.

La tua storia

• Esperto culturale e interdisciplinare: Si porta un background profondo (10-12 anni) nella cura e produzione di mostre d'arte contemporanea, residenze, o programmazione culturale, sostenuta da una rete globale attiva.

• Strategic & Para-Curatorial Thinker: Si eccelle a cambiare idee in formati alternativi e altamente desiderabili (tasse, cene, workshop) per costruire un profondo impegno comunitario piuttosto che solo vetrine statiche.

• Autonomo e Agile Self-Starter: si prospera in ambienti veloci, ad alta crescita e sono confortevoli eseguire un'operazione da solo. Siete altrettanto abili nel guidare la strategia curatoriale a lungo termine e gestire le realtà pratiche di tempi complessi, pluriennali, la logistica di artisti internazionali e le reti di fornitori esterni senza aspettare un playbook predefinito.

• Collaborazione-Minded Thinker: Si capisce come allineare un calendario culturale con realtà aziendali. Possiedi la diplomazia per gestire le parti interessate interne, assicurando lo spazio senza sforzo transizioni tra la modalità mostra pubblica e la modalità allineamento/officina interna del team.

• Inspirational Storyteller: È possibile tradurre concetti artistici, tecnologici o di design complessi in copia altamente convincente, iniziative editoriali, o media fisici che risonano con una base di fan globale.

Informazioni sulla squadra

Ti riferirai direttamente al Capo di Stato Maggiore (CoS) del Design, seduto al cuore di un vibrante e diversificato Design Studio che guida Il design di prodotto dirompente su calzature, abbigliamento e accessori. Siamo un team che valorizza creatività, curiosità e collaborazione, e stiamo cercando qualcuno che condivide la nostra passione per trasformare il "perché" del nostro passato nel "ciò che è il prossimo" del nostro futuro.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gesagt

Wir gründen unsere erste öffentliche Kulturdestination und einen eigenen Ausstellungsraum in unserem Hauptsitz in Zürich, der Anfang 2027 startet. Wir suchen eine visionäre, global vernetzte Senior Lead Exhibition Programming & Curation, um dieses neue kulturelle Wahrzeichen von Grund auf zu gestalten und aufzubauen.

Als außergewöhnlicher interdisziplinärer Kurator und autonomer Projektleiter entwerfen und orchestrieren Sie ein lebendiges Ökosystem, das an der Schnittstelle von Design, Innovation und Kunst liegt. Als strategischer Motor dieses Raumes werden Sie einen kontinuierlichen, hochdynamischen Kalender mit Ausstellungen, Artist-in-Residence-Programmen und diskursiven Veranstaltungen pflegen. Sie stellen sicher, dass der Raum ein kontinuierlich bevölkerter, erstklassiger Inspirationsknotenpunkt bleibt, der das öffentliche kulturelle Engagement nahtlos mit dynamischen internen Workshops, Co-Creation-Sitzungen und disziplinübergreifender Inspiration für unsere Produktteams verbindet.

Deine Mission

• Etablieren Sie die kuratorische Vision: Definieren und implementieren Sie eine ganzheitliche, multidisziplinäre Ausstellungs- und Veranstaltungsstrategie, die Markenwert und langfristige kulturelle Legitimität schafft. Sie werden übergreifende jährliche Erzählungen entwickeln, die zeitgenössische Kunst, Kino, Design, Bewegung und Technologie in einen breiten, zugänglichen öffentlichen Dialog einbinden.

• Brückenwelten: Handeln Sie als wichtige Verbindung zwischen externen Kreativgemeinschaften, globalen Kulturinstitutionen und unseren internen Produktteams. Sie entwerfen öffentlichkeitswirksame kulturelle Momente und programmieren gleichzeitig den Raum als interne Sandbox für Design-Workshops, Co-Creation-Sessions und disziplinübergreifende Inspiration.

• Orchestrieren Sie das Artist-in-Residence-Programm: Leiten Sie die strategische Definition und Kuration des Artist-in-Residence-Programms. Sie werden etablierte internationale Talente einladen und offene Aufrufe für junge kreative Gemeinschaften starten, die es den Bewohnern ermöglichen, den Raum mit ihren Netzwerken zu bevölkern und sie in unsere technologische Forschungsumgebung einzubetten.

• Continuous Programming & Occupancy: Führen Sie einen fortlaufenden, kontinuierlichen Kalender mit Ausstellungen, öffentlichen Community-Events und internen Aktivierungen. Sie werden den Nutzen und das Inspirationspotenzial des Raums das ganze Jahr über maximieren und sicherstellen, dass er dynamisch genutzt und nahtlos an wechselnde Programmieranforderungen angepasst wird.

• Operational Excellence: Verwalten und pflegen Sie die volle Aufsicht über das Programmbudget, die Ressourcenzuweisung, Anbieterverträge und Künstlergebühren. Sie beschaffen und beaufsichtigen externe technische Teams, Kunsthandler und die Betriebslogistik, um die Funktionen der Ausstellungsinfrastruktur in einem leistungsstarken Premium-Skala sicherzustellen.

Deine Geschichte

• Cultural & Cross-Disciplinary Expert: Sie haben einen tiefen Hintergrund (10-12+ Jahre) in der Kuratierung und Produktion von Ausstellungen zeitgenössischer Kunst, Residenzen oder kulturellen Programmen, unterstützt von einem aktiven globalen Netzwerk.

• Strategischer und parakuratorischer Denker: Sie zeichnen sich dadurch aus, dass Sie Ideen in alternative, höchst wünschenswerte Formate (Gespräche, Abendessen, Workshops) verschieben, um ein tiefes Community-Engagement aufzubauen, anstatt nur statische Showcases.

• Autonomer und agiler Selbststarter: Du gedeihst in schnelllebigen, wachstumsstarken Umgebungen und betreibst einen Solo-Betrieb. Sie sind ebenso geschickt darin, eine langfristige kuratorische Strategie voranzutreiben und die praktischen Realitäten komplexer, mehrjähriger Zeitpläne, internationaler Künstlerlogistik und externer Anbieternetzwerke zu verwalten, ohne auf ein vordefiniertes Playbook zu warten.

• Collaboration-Minded Thinker: Sie verstehen, wie man einen kulturellen Kalender mit den Unternehmensrealitäten in Einklang bringt. Sie verfügen über die Diplomatie, um interne Stakeholder zu verwalten und den mühelosen Übergang zwischen dem öffentlichen Ausstellungsmodus und dem internen Team-Alignment / Workshop-Modus sicherzustellen.

• Inspirierender Storyteller: Sie können komplexe künstlerische, technologische oder Designkonzepte in höchst überzeugende Kopien, redaktionelle Initiativen oder physische Medien übersetzen, die bei einer globalen Fangemeinde ankommen.

Über das Team

Sie werden direkt an den Chief of Staff (CoS) of Design berichten, der im Herzen eines lebendigen und vielfältigen Designstudios sitzt, das fährt On’s disruptives Produktdesign für Schuhe, Bekleidung und Accessoires. Wir sind ein Team, das Kreativität, Neugier und Zusammenarbeit schätzt, und wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Leidenschaft teilt, das "Warum" unserer Vergangenheit in das "Was kommt als nächstes" unserer Zukunft zu verwandeln.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

Nous établissons notre toute première destination culturelle publique et notre espace d'exposition dédié au siège de Zurich, le lancement début 2027. Nous sommes à la recherche d'une programmation et d'une curation des expositions seniors visionnaires et connectées à l'échelle mondiale pour façonner et construire ce nouveau repère culturel.

En tant que conservateur interdisciplinaire exceptionnel et chef de projet autonome, vous concevrez et orchestrerez un écosystème vivant qui se trouve à l'intersection du design, de l'innovation et de l'art. En tant que moteur stratégique de cet espace, vous conserverez un calendrier d'expositions continu et très dynamique, des programmes d'artistes en résidence et des événements discursifs. Vous veillerez à ce que l'espace demeure un pôle d'inspiration de classe mondiale, toujours peuplé, qui relie parfaitement l'engagement culturel public avec des ateliers internes dynamiques, des séances de co-création et une inspiration transdisciplinaire pour nos équipes de produits.

Votre mission

• Établir la vision curatoriale : Définir et exécuter une stratégie globale d'exposition et d'événement multidisciplinaire qui renforce l'équité de la marque et la légitimité culturelle à long terme. Vous développerez des récits annuels qui insèrent l'art contemporain, le cinéma, le design, le mouvement et la technologie dans un vaste dialogue public accessible.

• Les mondes de ponts : agir comme le lien vital entre les communautés créatives externes, les institutions culturelles mondiales et nos équipes internes de produits. Vous concevrez des moments culturels publics tout en programmant simultanément l'espace comme un bac à sable interne pour des ateliers de design, des séances de co-création et une inspiration multidisciplinaire.

• Ordonner le programme d'artiste en résidence : Diriger la définition stratégique et la curation du programme d'artiste en résidence. Vous inviterez des talents internationaux établis et lancerez des appels ouverts pour de jeunes communautés créatives, donnant aux résidents la possibilité de peupler l'espace avec leurs réseaux tout en les intégrant dans notre environnement de recherche technologique.

• Maintenir la programmation et l'occupation continues : Diriger un calendrier continu des expositions, des événements communautaires publics et des activations internes. Vous maximiserez le potentiel d'utilité et d'inspiration de l'espace tout au long de l'année, en veillant à ce qu'il demeure utilisé dynamiquement et parfaitement adapté aux besoins changeants de programmation.

• Excellence opérationnelle : Gérer et maintenir la surveillance complète du budget de programmation, de l'affectation des ressources, des contrats de fournisseurs et des droits d'artiste. Vous allez fournir et superviser des équipes techniques externes, des gestionnaires d'art et de la logistique opérationnelle, assurant les fonctions de l'infrastructure d'exposition à une échelle haute performance.

Votre histoire

• Expert culturel et interdisciplinaire: Vous apportez un fond profond (10-12+ ans) dans la préparation et la production d'expositions d'art contemporain, de résidences, ou de programmation culturelle, soutenu par un réseau mondial actif.

• Strategic & Para-Curatorial Thinker: Vous excellez à transformer des idées en formats alternatifs et hautement souhaitables (parles, dîners, ateliers) pour construire un engagement communautaire profond plutôt que des vitrines statiques.

• Auto-démarrage autonome et agile : Vous vous développez dans des environnements rapides et à forte croissance et vous êtes à l'aise avec une opération en solo. Vous êtes tout aussi habiles à conduire une stratégie curatoriale à long terme et à gérer les réalités pratiques des délais complexes et pluriannuels, de la logistique artistique internationale et des réseaux de fournisseurs externes sans attendre un playbook prédéfini.

• Le penseur de la collaboration : Vous comprenez comment aligner un calendrier culturel sur les réalités de l'entreprise. Vous possédez la diplomatie pour gérer les intervenants internes, assurant sans effort les transitions entre le mode d'exposition public et le mode d'alignement/atelier interne de l'équipe.

• Storyteller Inspirationnel: Vous pouvez traduire des concepts artistiques, technologiques ou de conception complexes en copies hautement convaincantes, en initiatives éditoriales ou en médias physiques qui résonnent avec une base de fans mondiale.

À propos de l'équipe

Vous ferez directement rapport au Chef de Cabinet (CoS) de Design, assis au cœur d'un Studio de Design vibrant et diversifié qui conduit Sur la conception de produits perturbateurs à travers les chaussures, les vêtements et les accessoires. Nous sommes une équipe qui valorise la créativité, la curiosité et la collaboration, et nous cherchons quelqu'un qui partage notre passion pour faire du « pourquoi » de notre passé le « prochain » de notre avenir.

jobs.description:
In Short:
At On, we believe that building diverse teams and fostering an inclusive work environment is key to achieving our mission to ignite the human spirit through movement. As we continue to evolve our approach, we are looking for a passionate D&I Lead to own our regional strategy, drive inclusion initiatives, and champion a culture of equity and belonging.

Your Team:
You will be a key member of the global Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging (DEIB) and Social Impact team, reporting directly to the Director of DEIB & Social Impact. You will work in close partnership with business leaders, the Talent Team, and employees across On to bring our D&I vision to life.

Your Mission:

• Regional Strategy & Ownership: Own and execute the D&I strategy for the EMEA region, ensuring alignment with our global goals while effectively tailoring programs to meet local needs and regulatory requirements.

• Inclusion Group Management: Serve as the primary lead and advocate for our global Inclusion Groups. You will provide guidance, structure, and support to ensure they are empowered to foster community and contribute meaningfully to our inclusive culture.

• Diversity Hiring Support: Partner closely with the Talent Acquisition teams to design, implement, and measure diversity hiring initiatives. You will help manage community partnerships and talent acquisition events focused on building diverse talent pipelines.

• Inclusive Leadership Training & Coaching: Supporting On’s leaders with coaching and training to bring inclusion and allyship to life with strong inclusive leadership skills.

• Internal Consulting: Act as the dedicated D&I subject matter expert and consultant for leaders and teams. You will develop and provide resources, toolkits, and best practices to embed inclusive behaviors and processes.

• Data & Reporting: Establish and maintain metrics to measure the effectiveness of specific D&I initiatives. You will be responsible for analyzing data, reporting on progress to leadership, and making data-driven recommendations for future action.

• Impact Storytelling: Own regional insights, data, and stories to the Diversity and Inclusion section of On’s annual Impact Progress Report.

Your Story:
In addition to a specific passion for fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment, we hope you’ll also bring:

• 7-10+ years of experience in the diversity and inclusion field, with a proven track record of leading D&I initiatives across the EMEA region. Exposure to the US market is a plus.

• Demonstrated experience in managing, scaling, or providing direct support to employee resource groups (ERGs) or inclusion groups.

• A strong background in partnering with recruitment teams to develop and implement successful diversity hiring programs.

• Deep understanding of the unique cultural nuances, challenges, and legal landscapes related to D&I in various countries across EMEA, APAC & Americas.

• Leading with data: you know how to use metrics and insights to drive leader accountability and measure the impact of your initiatives.

• A collaborative mindset: you excel at leading cross-functional projects and navigating ambiguity to achieve shared goals.

• Self-motivated: you are a self-starter skilled at proactively developing ideas, gaining stakeholder buy-in, and executing with a hands-on approach.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve:
In On, crediamo che costruire squadre diverse e promuovere un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo sia la chiave per raggiungere la nostra missione di accendere lo spirito umano attraverso il movimento. Mentre continuiamo a evolvere il nostro approccio, stiamo cercando un appassionato D&I Lead per possedere la nostra strategia regionale, promuovere iniziative di inclusione e sostenere una cultura dell'equità e dell'appartenenza.

Il vostro team:
Sarai un membro chiave del team globale Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging (DEIB) e Social Impact, riportando direttamente al Direttore del DEIB & Social Impact. Potrai lavorare in stretta collaborazione con i leader aziendali, il Talent Team e i dipendenti attraverso On per portare la nostra visione D&I alla vita.

La vostra missione:

• Strategia e ProprietÃ Regionale: ProprietÃ ed esecuzione della strategia D&I per la regione EMEA, garantendo l'allineamento con i nostri obiettivi globali, adattando efficacemente i programmi per soddisfare le esigenze locali e i requisiti normativi.

• Inclusion Group Management: Servire come leader primario e sostenere i nostri gruppi di inclusione globali. Potrai fornire guida, struttura e supporto per garantire che siano abilitati a promuovere la comunità e contribuire in modo significativo alla nostra cultura inclusiva.

• Supporto per l'assunzione di diversità: collaborare strettamente con i team Talent Acquisition per progettare, implementare e misurare le iniziative di assunzione della diversità. Potrai aiutare a gestire partnership comunitarie e eventi di acquisizione di talenti focalizzati sulla costruzione di diverse pipeline di talento.

• Inclusive Leadership Training & Coaching: Sostenere i leader On con coaching e formazione per portare inclusione e alleato alla vita con forti competenze di leadership inclusiva.

• Consulenza Interna: Atto come il soggetto dedicato D&I esperto e consulente per leader e team. Potrai sviluppare e fornire risorse, toolkit e le migliori pratiche per incorporare comportamenti e processi inclusi.

• Data & Reporting: Stabilire e mantenere metriche per misurare l'efficacia di specifiche iniziative D&I. Sarete responsabili dell'analisi dei dati, del reporting sui progressi verso la leadership, e del fare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per l'azione futura.

• Impact Storytelling: Possedere informazioni regionali, dati e storie alla sezione Diversità e inclusione del Rapporto annuale Impact Progress.

La tua storia:
Oltre ad una specifica passione per la promozione di un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed equo, speriamo che porti anche:

• 7-10 anni di esperienza nel campo della diversità e dell'inclusione, con una comprovata traccia di importanti iniziative D&I nella regione EMEA. L'esposizione al mercato americano è un vantaggio.

• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione, scaling o nel supporto diretto ai gruppi di risorse dei dipendenti (ERG) o ai gruppi di inclusione.

• Uno sfondo forte nel collaborare con i team di reclutamento per sviluppare e implementare programmi di assunzione di diversità di successo.

• Profonda comprensione delle sfumature culturali, delle sfide e dei paesaggi legali legati alla D&I in vari paesi di EMEA, APAC & Americas.

• Guidando con i dati: si sa come utilizzare metriche e intuizioni per guidare la responsabilità leader e misurare l'impatto delle vostre iniziative.

• Una mentalità collaborativa: eccellete nei principali progetti interfunzionali e navigate ambiguità per raggiungere obiettivi condivisi.

• Self-motivated: sei un auto-starter esperto a sviluppare proattivamente idee, acquisendo stakeholder buy-in, eseguendo con un approccio hands-on.

Bei On glauben wir, dass der Aufbau verschiedener Teams und die Förderung einer integrativen Arbeitsumgebung der Schlüssel zur Erreichung unserer Mission ist, den menschlichen Geist durch Bewegung zu entzünden. Während wir unseren Ansatz weiterentwickeln, suchen wir nach einem leidenschaftlichen D & I Lead, um unsere regionale Strategie zu besitzen, Inklusionsinitiativen voranzutreiben und eine Kultur der Gerechtigkeit und Zugehörigkeit zu fördern.

Ihr Team:
Sie werden ein wichtiges Mitglied des globalen Teams für Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging (DEIB) und Social Impact sein und direkt an den Direktor von DEIB & Social Impact berichten. Sie arbeiten in enger Partnerschaft mit Führungskräften, dem Talentteam und Mitarbeitern von On zusammen, um unsere D & I-Vision zum Leben zu erwecken.

Ihre Mission:

• Regional Strategy & Ownership: Eigene und Umsetzung der D&I-Strategie für die EMEA-Region, um die Ausrichtung auf unsere globalen Ziele sicherzustellen und gleichzeitig Programme effektiv auf die lokalen Bedürfnisse und regulatorischen Anforderungen abzustimmen.

• Inclusion Group Management: Diene als primärer Leiter und Anwalt für unsere globalen Inclusion Groups. Sie bieten Anleitung, Struktur und Unterstützung, um sicherzustellen, dass sie in die Lage versetzt werden, die Gemeinschaft zu fördern und einen sinnvollen Beitrag zu unserer integrativen Kultur zu leisten.

• Diversity Hiring Support: Arbeiten Sie eng mit den Talent Acquisition Teams zusammen, um Initiativen zur Einstellung von Diversität zu entwerfen, umzusetzen und zu messen. Sie helfen bei der Verwaltung von Community-Partnerschaften und Talentakquisitionsveranstaltungen, die sich auf den Aufbau verschiedener Talent-Pipelines konzentrieren.

• Inclusive Leadership Training & Coaching: Unterstützung der Führungskräfte von On mit Coaching und Training, um Inklusion und Allianz mit starken inklusiven Führungsqualitäten zum Leben zu erwecken.

• Interne Beratung: Handeln Sie als engagierter D&I-Experte und Berater für Führungskräfte und Teams. Sie werden Ressourcen, Toolkits und Best Practices entwickeln und bereitstellen, um integrative Verhaltensweisen und Prozesse einzubetten.

• Impact Storytelling: Eigene regionale Erkenntnisse, Daten und Geschichten im Bereich Diversity und Inklusion des jährlichen Impact Progress Report von On.

Neben einer besonderen Leidenschaft für die Förderung eines integrativen und gerechten Arbeitsumfelds hoffen wir, dass Sie auch Folgendes mitbringen:

• 7-10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Diversität und Inklusion mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz führender D & I-Initiativen in der EMEA-Region. Die Exposition gegenüber dem US-Markt ist ein Plus.

• Ein starker Hintergrund in der Partnerschaft mit Rekrutierungsteams, um erfolgreiche Diversity-Einstellungsprogramme zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.

• Tiefes Verständnis der einzigartigen kulturellen Nuancen, Herausforderungen und rechtlichen Landschaften im Zusammenhang mit D & I in verschiedenen Ländern in EMEA, APAC und Amerika.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En bref:
À On, nous croyons que la création d'équipes diversifiées et la promotion d'un milieu de travail inclusif sont essentielles pour atteindre notre mission d'enflammer l'esprit humain par le mouvement. Au fur et à mesure que nous continuons d'évoluer notre approche, nous cherchons un chef de file passionné en matière de D et I pour sa propre stratégie régionale, ses initiatives d'inclusion et sa promotion d'une culture d'équité et d'appartenance.

Votre équipe :
Vous serez un membre clé de l'équipe mondiale Diversité, équité, inclusion et appartenance (DEIB) et Impact social, relevant directement du directeur de DEIB & Impact social. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les chefs d'entreprise, l'équipe Talent et les employés de partout dans le monde pour donner vie à notre vision D&I.

Votre mission :

• Stratégie régionale et propriété : Posséder et exécuter la stratégie D&I pour la région de l'EMEA, en assurant l'alignement avec nos objectifs mondiaux tout en adaptant efficacement les programmes pour répondre aux besoins locaux et aux exigences réglementaires.

• Gestion des groupes d'inclusion : servir de chef de file et de défenseur de nos groupes d'inclusion mondiaux. Vous fournirez des conseils, une structure et un soutien pour s'assurer qu'ils sont habilités à favoriser la collectivité et à contribuer de façon significative à notre culture inclusive.

• Soutien à l'embauche en matière de diversité : S'associer étroitement aux équipes d'acquisition de talents pour concevoir, mettre en oeuvre et mesurer des initiatives d'embauche en matière de diversité. Vous aiderez à gérer les partenariats communautaires et les événements d'acquisition de talents axés sur la création de divers pipelines de talents.

• Formation et coaching en leadership inclusifs : Soutenir les leaders avec l'encadrement et la formation pour faire vivre l'inclusion et l'alliage avec de solides compétences en leadership inclusif.

• Conseils internes : agir en tant qu'expert et consultant spécialisé en D et I pour les dirigeants et les équipes. Vous développerez et fournirez des ressources, des outils et des pratiques exemplaires pour intégrer des comportements et des processus inclusifs.

• Données et rapports : Établir et maintenir des mesures pour mesurer l'efficacité de certaines initiatives de D et I. Vous serez responsable de l'analyse des données, de l'établissement de rapports sur les progrès accomplis à l'intention des dirigeants et de l'élaboration de recommandations fondées sur les données en vue d'une action future.

• Récapitulatif de l'impact : propres perspectives, données et histoires régionales à la section Diversité et inclusion du rapport annuel d'étape de l'impact.

Votre histoire :
En plus d'une passion spécifique pour la promotion d'un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable, nous espérons que vous apporterez également:

• 7-10 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la diversité et de l'inclusion, avec une expérience éprouvée des initiatives de D&I de premier plan dans la région de l'EMEA. L'exposition au marché américain est un plus.

• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion, la mise à l'échelle ou le soutien direct aux groupes de ressources des employés (GER) ou aux groupes d'inclusion.

• Une solide expérience en partenariat avec des équipes de recrutement pour élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des programmes d'embauche pour la diversité.

• Compréhension approfondie des nuances culturelles uniques, des défis et des paysages juridiques liés au D&I dans divers pays de l'EMEA, de l'APAC et des Amériques.

• Diriger avec les données : vous savez utiliser les mesures et les idées pour stimuler la responsabilisation des leaders et mesurer l'impact de vos initiatives.

• Un état d'esprit collaboratif : vous excellez à diriger des projets interfonctionnels et à naviguer dans l'ambiguïté pour atteindre des objectifs communs.

• Automotivé : vous êtes un auto-démarrant qualifié pour développer des idées proactives, obtenir l'adhésion des intervenants et exécuter avec une approche pratique.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Distributor Operations
jobs.description:
As the Senior Lead - Distributor Operations, EMEA, you will define and execute the operational strategy for premium footwear, apparel, and accessories across distribution networks in the Region. You will balance complex supply chain execution with deep collaborative partnership, bridging local regional logistics with global operational standards. Reporting to the Head of Regional Supply Chain on the EMEA team, you will guide a dedicated team to elevate orderbook management and drive process scalability that supports sustainable commercial growth across the region.

Your Mission

• Lead the end-to-end long-term strategy for omni-channel customer service and regional supply chain operations for distributor networks across EMEA

• Define and optimize distributor compliance initiatives, driving customer-centric value-added services, packaging standards, and localized labeling requirements

• Establish and document clear standard operating procedures across regional sales operations, compliance, and product supply to build a resilient operational foundation

• Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and Logistics teams to streamline product flow, enhance supply visibility, and increase delivery efficiency

• Leverage business intelligence reporting tools to analyze shipment data, proactively escalating supply chain risks and implementing data-informed mitigation strategies

• Represent the EMEA region in global system testing, ERP enhancements, and organizational program initiatives to scale internal capabilities

• Build a collaborative and psychologically safe team culture focused on operational excellence, providing continuous mentorship and clear pathways for talent development

• Act as a change agent by leading and innovating the design and implementation of optimized ways of working to elevate distributor operations to a best-in-class standard

Your Story

• You bring 8+ years of functional experience in operations, logistics, or supply chain management within a premium omnichannel consumer goods brand

• You bring 2+ years of direct people leadership experience guiding operational teams and managing regional or distributor-focused service delivery

• Proven expertise operating within a high-growth environment, navigating complex distribution networks and regional compliance landscapes across EMEA

• Advanced systems capability including intermediate Excel modeling, automated reporting insights, and deep familiarity with ERP systems such as Microsoft D365

• Professional fluency in English with the ability to articulate complex operational problems concisely to both technical execution teams and senior leadership

• Exceptional problem-solving capability rooted in data analysis and root-cause mapping, with an approach that treats operational setbacks as learning opportunities

• Mobility and flexibility to align schedules and co-create workflows across international matrix environments, partnering with peers across Americas and APAC

Your Team

The EMEA Regional Supply Chain team is responsible for supporting, elevating, and improving the operational accountabilities for our distributor partners. We balance data-driven precision with commercial creativity, acting as the critical conduit between global strategy and regional execution. Moving at a dynamic pace, we work collaboratively to navigate supply chain complexities, establish scalable infrastructure, and ensure every touchpoint reflects our brand standard of excellence. We celebrate regional diversity, solve complex problems as a cohesive sports team, and are dedicated to delivering an exceptional experience to our fans and partners.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Copy
jobs.description:
In short:

At On, we believe in the power of storytelling. Whether it's celebrating the achievements of our athletes, the passions of our communities, or the innovation behind our products – our stories captivate and inspire. Our Creative Studio is at the heart of it all, shaping campaigns that leave a lasting impact.

We’re looking for a highly experienced storyteller to craft copy and to concept industry-leading creative across our global campaigns. As Senior Copy Lead, you’ll work closely with Creative Directors and Art Directors to deliver impactful concepts and stories across channels. The ideal candidate is an expert conceptual storyteller with a deep understanding of channel best practices and leadership experience.

You strive for creative excellence in every brief, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You enter the creative process with foresight, identifying potential issues before they arise. You have a love of craft, and immerse yourself in global subcultures. You confidently navigate the creative journey from beginning to end: from strategic foundations, moving through significant conceptual development and production, and culminating in the final rollout.

The Senior Copy Lead - Running will report to the Head of Creative - Running in the Creative Studio.

Your Mission:

• Partner with Art Director to concept and execute innovative campaigns across all channels, bringing big ideas to life from briefs big and small.

• Confidently and articulately present creative ideas based on strategy and insights.

• Deliver concepts, films, OOH, and 360 campaigns with obsessive craft on ambitious timelines.

• Uphold and evolve On's distinctive voice, ensuring it remains fearless and unconventional.

• Lead creative in the Run category to success, fostering a sense of bravery and dedication within your team, ensuring they are motivated, inspired, and consistently delivering bold, original and inventive concepts and distinctive tones of voice for campaigns and projects.

• Manage multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously, making sound creative decisions independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Exemplify leadership in creative, championing the On Spirits, and actively contributing to company culture and events.

Your Story:

• A dynamic, experienced copywriter with 6+ years of experience as a creative championing big ideas on global advertising and/or marketing campaigns, brand side or at an agency.

• A passionate storyteller with a portfolio spanning film scripts, manifestos, OOH, and disruptive activations.

• Deep understanding of global digital user journeys and how to leverage touchpoints to drive meaningful action.

• Experience challenging the status quo and navigating complex stakeholder environments to deliver commercial results.

• Comfortable leading high-impact initiatives that significantly influence the business and brand trajectory.

• You know how to lead and inspire within your team, identify underlying issues and root causes, and seek solutions to problems.

• You have a deep love for, and experience in, culture, fashion, and performance sports.

Your Team:

On’s Brand Studio is an award-winning internal studio aiming to challenge world-leading creative agencies. At our core, we tell compelling stories and bring experiences to life. We channel the energy and global nature of the brand into our daily work and you can help us continue our fantastic run of successes. If you’re bursting with original ideas and have the drive and experience to see them realized, this is the team for you.

What We Offer:

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

• Deliver concepts, films, OOH, and 360 campaigns with obsessive craft on ambitious timelines.
• Uphold and evolve On's distinctive voice, ensuring it remains fearless and unconventional.
• Lead creative in the Run category to success, fostering a sense of bravery and dedication within your team, ensuring they are motivated, inspired, and consistently delivering bold, original and inventive concepts and distinctive tones of voice for campaigns and projects.
• Manage multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously, making sound creative decisions independently in a fast-paced environment.
• Exemplify leadership in creative, championing the On Spirits, and actively contributing to company culture and events. Your Story:
• A dynamic, experienced copywriter with 6+ years of experience as a creative championing big ideas on global advertising and/or marketing campaigns, brand side or at an agency.
• A passionate storyteller with a portfolio spanning film scripts, manifestos, OOH, and disruptive activations.
• Deep understanding of global digital user journeys and how to leverage touchpoints to drive meaningful action.
• Experience challenging the status quo and navigating complex stakeholder environments to deliver commercial results.
• Comfortable leading high-impact initiatives that significantly influence the business and brand trajectory.
• You know how to lead and inspire within your team, identify underlying issues and root causes, and seek solutions to problems.
• You have a deep love for, and experience in, culture, fashion, and performance sports. Your Team: On’s Brand Studio is an award-winning internal studio aiming to challenge world-leading creative agencies. At our core, we tell compelling stories and bring experiences to life. We channel the energy and global nature of the brand into our daily work and you can help us continue our fantastic run of successes. If you’re bursting with original ideas and have the drive and experience to see them realized, this is the team for you. What We Offer: On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose. On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable principal - Design d'environnement de marque

jobs.description:
Location: Zurich, Switzerland

About On

Born in the Swiss Alps, On has disrupted the sportswear landscape through relentless exploration. Our journey began not with a standard shoe, but with a radical ambition to redefine movement. We are fueled by innovation, bold dreams, and a commitment to better ways forward. Our mission—igniting the human spirit through movement—is built on three core pillars: Performance, Design, and Impact . Our personality is defined by being Obsessive about our craft, Unconventional in our approach, and Fearless in shaping a premium future.

In short

As a Senior Design Lead, Brand Environment Design at On, you will be instrumental in shaping how our brand comes to life in the physical world outside of retail. You will lead the spatial design direction, translating On’s distinctive brand design language into consistent, immersive, and premium physical experiences globally. This role is about creating visionary concepts, guiding design teams and external partners, and developing the strategic frameworks that ensure every physical touchpoint feels unmistakably On: premium, coherent, and rooted in innovation.

Your Mission

Your core mission will be to define and elevate how On shows up in the physical world, driving creativity and consistency across all non-retail touchpoints. You will be responsible for:

• Leading Spatial Design Direction : Directing the creative path for non-retail environments to guarantee visual harmony and premium execution that reflects our core identity.

• Creating Concepts and Narratives : Translating brand priorities and overarching creative direction into tangible, immersive, and impactful physical concepts and compelling experience narratives.

• Guiding Designers and Agencies : Developing inspiring briefs that empower internal and external talent to transform high-level strategy into premium, aesthetically aligned outputs from concept to launch.

• Ensuring Creative Alignment and Fidelity : Acting as the guardian of On's design standards, ensuring all physical brand expressions maintain premiumness and coherence across diverse touchpoints. This includes publishing the first official "Brand Environment Design Guidelines/Principles" aligned with new premium retail standards.

• Developing Toolkits & Design Frameworks : Designing comprehensive physical brand systems and scalable toolkits that facilitate locally relevant yet globally unified brand expression across activations and strategic spaces.

• Fostering Cross-Functional Collaboration : Serving as a key connector across brand, retail, and regional experience teams, aligning physical executions to a unified omnichannel vision.

• Championing Innovation & Premiumness : Continuously evolving On's physical brand presence by infusing each activation with innovative thinking, high-end design standards, and an elevated aesthetic that redefines what premium means for a performance brand. This includes supporting immersive "LightSpray" technology showcases and ensuring athlete-centric environments reflect On's premium, performance-first identity.

Your Story

We are looking for a visionary design leader who bridges creative artistry with strategic frameworks and holds a deep-seated drive for crafting immersive brand worlds. To be successful in this role, you should bring:

• Proven Experience: A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in spatial design, environmental design, or experiential architecture, with a strong track record of leading design teams.

• The Right Profile: Experience working within a top-tier creative advertising/experiential agency , ideally coupled with in-house experience at a premium, global lifestyle or performance brand. You understand both the fast-paced creative rigor of agency life and the strategic long-term vision of an in-house brand.

• Proven Project Scale: Proven experience managing large-scale, complex physical design projects and activations from concept to execution, comfortably handling project budgets ranging from $250k to $1M+ .

• Portfolio of Immersive Environments: A portfolio showcasing high-impact physical spaces outside of standard retail, such as global brand activations, large-scale event summits, pop-ups, and premium athlete-centric environments.

• Strategic Toolkit Development: Extensive experience in developing global toolkits, design principles, and scalable frameworks that enable consistent and high-quality brand expression across various global markets.

• Creative Visionary & Advocate: The ability to materialize complex creative themes into premium, high-impact physical environments, maintaining an unwavering focus on quality, detail, and brand integrity.

• Collaborative Leadership: A demonstrated ability to steer internal design teams and external production agencies, aligning diverse cross-functional stakeholders and regional teams around a unified vision.

• Effective Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English are required; additional languages are a plus for global collaboration.

About the Team
We ensure that wherever the brand meets people in the real world—be it on a global stage, within an athlete environment, at a summit, or in a B2B setting—it feels unmistakably On: premium, coherent, and rooted in innovation. Translating brand intent into physical reality through guidelines, toolkits, and execution frameworks.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Zurigo, Svizzera

Informazioni su

Nato nelle Alpi svizzere, On ha sconvolto il paesaggio dello sportswear attraverso un'esplorazione incessante. Il nostro viaggio non ha cominciato con una scarpa standard, ma con un'ambizione radicale di ridefinire il movimento. Siamo alimentati da innovazione, sogni audaci, e un impegno per migliorare i modi in avanti. La nostra missione, accendendo lo spirito umano attraverso il movimento, è costruita su tre pilastri principali: Performance, Design e Impact . La nostra personalità è definita dall'essere ossessiva circa il nostro mestiere, Unconventional nel nostro approccio, e Fearless nella modellazione di un futuro premium.

In breve

Come Senior Design Lead, Brand Environment Design at On, sarete strumentali nella modellazione di come il nostro marchio viene alla vita nel mondo fisico al di fuori della vendita al dettaglio. Condurrai la direzione del design spaziale, traducendo il linguaggio distintivo del brand design di On in esperienze fisiche coerenti, immersive e premium a livello globale. Questo ruolo è quello di creare concetti visionari, guidare team di design e partner esterni, e sviluppare i quadri strategici che garantiscono che ogni punto di contatto fisico si senta inconfondibilmente On: premium, coerente e radicato nell'innovazione.

La tua missione

La vostra missione principale sarà quella di definire ed elevare come On si presenta nel mondo fisico, guidando la creatività e la coerenza in tutti i touchpoint non-retail. Sarete responsabili di:

• Direzione di progettazione spaziale: Dirigere il percorso creativo per ambienti non-retail per garantire l'armonia visiva e l'esecuzione premium che riflette la nostra identità di base.

• Creare Concepts and Narratives: Tradurre le priorità del marchio e sovrapporre la direzione creativa in concetti fisici tangibili, immersivi e impattanti e narrazioni di esperienze convincenti.

• Progettisti e Agenzie di guida: Sviluppare slip ispiranti che permettono al talento interno ed esterno di trasformare la strategia di alto livello in output premium e esteticamente allineati dal concetto al lancio.

• Garantire Creative Alignment e Fidelity: Agire come custode degli standard di progettazione di On, assicurando che tutte le espressioni del marchio fisico mantengano preminenza e coerenza tra diversi punti di contatto. Questo include la pubblicazione dei primi "Brand Environment Design Guidelines/Principles" ufficiali allineati con nuovi standard premium retail.

• Sviluppare Toolkits & Design Frameworks: Progettazione di sistemi di marca fisici completi e toolkit scalabili che facilitano l'espressione del marchio localmente rilevante ma globalmente unificata tra attivazioni e spazi strategici.

• Promuovere la collaborazione trasversale: servire come connettore chiave tra team di brand, retail e esperienza regionale, allineare le esecuzioni fisiche a una visione omnicanale unificata.

• Campione dell'innovazione & Premiumness: continua evoluzione della presenza del marchio fisico di On, infondendo ogni attivazione con un pensiero innovativo, standard di design di fascia alta, e un'estetica elevata che ridefinisce quali mezzi premium per un marchio di performance. Questo include il supporto di tecnologie "LightSpray" immersive e garantire gli ambienti atleta-centrici riflettono la prima identità di On.

La tua storia

Siamo alla ricerca di un leader visionario di design che collega l'arte creativa con le strutture strategiche e detiene un'unità profonda per la realizzazione di mondi di brand immersivi. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si dovrebbe portare:

• Esperienza dimostrata: un minimo di 5-7 anni di esperienza nel design spaziale, nel design ambientale o nell'architettura esperienziale, con un forte record di importanti team di design.

• Il profilo destro: Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un'agenzia di pubblicità/esperienziale creativa di alto livello, idealmente accoppiata con esperienza interna ad un marchio premium, globale di stile di vita o di performance. Capisci sia il rigore creativo veloce della vita dell'agenzia che la visione strategica a lungo termine di un marchio interno.

• Proven Project Scale: Esperienza comprovata che gestisce progetti di progettazione fisica su larga scala e complessi e attivazioni dal concetto all'esecuzione, gestire comodamente budget di progetto che vanno da $250k a $1M+ .

• Portfolio of Immersive Environments: Un portafoglio che mostra spazi fisici ad alto impatto al di fuori della vendita al dettaglio standard, come le attivazioni del marchio globale, i vertici degli eventi su larga scala, i pop-up e gli ambienti premium atleta-centrici.

• Strategic Toolkit Development: Ampia esperienza nello sviluppo di toolkit globali, principi di progettazione e framework scalabili che consentono un'espressione coerente e di alta qualità del marchio in vari mercati globali.

• Creative Visionary & Advocate: La capacità di materializzare temi creativi complessi in ambienti fisici di alto impatto premium, mantenendo un costante focus sulla qualità, i dettagli e l'integrità del marchio.

• Leadership collaborativa: una capacità dimostrata di guidare i team di progettazione interna e le agenzie di produzione esterne, allineando i diversi stakeholder interfunzionali e le squadre regionali intorno a una visione unificata.

• Comunicazione efficace: Sono richieste competenze di comunicazione verbali e scritte eccezionali in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio per la collaborazione globale.

Informazioni sulla squadra
Ci assicuriamo che ovunque il marchio incontri le persone nel mondo reale – sia in una fase globale, all'interno di un ambiente atleta, in un vertice, o in un ambiente B2B – si sente inconfondibilmente On: premium, coerente e radicato nell'innovazione. Tradurre l'intento del marchio nella realtà fisica attraverso linee guida, toolkit e framework di esecuzione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Zürich, Schweiz

Über On

Geboren in den Schweizer Alpen, hat On die Sportbekleidungslandschaft durch unermüdliche Erkundungen gestört. Unsere Reise begann nicht mit einem Standardschuh, sondern mit dem radikalen Ehrgeiz, Bewegung neu zu definieren. Wir werden von Innovationen, mutigen Träumen und der Verpflichtung zu besseren Wegen angetrieben. Unsere Mission – den menschlichen Geist durch Bewegung zu entzünden – basiert auf drei Kernsäulen: Performance, Design und Impact. Unsere Persönlichkeit wird dadurch definiert, dass wir besessen von unserem Handwerk sind, unkonventionell in unserem Ansatz und furchtlos in der Gestaltung einer Premium-Zukunft.

Kurz gesagt

Als Senior Design Lead, Brand Environment Design bei On, sind Sie maßgeblich daran beteiligt, wie unsere Marke in der physischen Welt außerhalb des Einzelhandels zum Leben erweckt wird. Sie werden die räumliche Designrichtung leiten und die unverwechselbare Markendesignsprache von On in konsistente, immersive und erstklassige physische Erfahrungen weltweit übersetzen. In dieser Rolle geht es darum, visionäre Konzepte zu entwickeln, Designteams und externe Partner zu leiten und die strategischen Rahmenbedingungen zu entwickeln, die sicherstellen, dass sich jeder physische Touchpoint unverkennbar anfühlt: Premium, kohärent und in Innovation verwurzelt.

Deine Mission

Ihre Kernaufgabe besteht darin, zu definieren und zu verbessern, wie sich On in der physischen Welt zeigt, und Kreativität und Konsistenz in allen Nicht-Einzelhandels-Touchpoints zu fördern. Sie sind verantwortlich für:

• Leading Spatial Design Direction: Den kreativen Weg für Nicht-Einzelhandelsumgebungen zu lenken, um visuelle Harmonie und Premium-Ausführung zu gewährleisten, die unsere Kernidentität widerspiegeln.

• Erstellen von Konzepten und Narrativen: Übersetzen von Markenprioritäten und übergreifender kreativer Ausrichtung in greifbare, immersive und wirkungsvolle physische Konzepte und überzeugende Erfahrungsnarrative.

• Führende Designer und Agenturen: Entwicklung inspirierender Briefings, die interne und externe Talente befähigen, hochrangige Strategien in erstklassige, ästhetisch ausgerichtete Outputs vom Konzept bis zum Launch umzuwandeln.

• Kreative Ausrichtung und Treue sicherstellen: Als Hüterin der Designstandards von On fungieren und sicherstellen, dass alle physischen Markenausdrücke Premiumität und Kohärenz über verschiedene Touchpoints hinweg bewahren. Dazu gehört auch die Veröffentlichung der ersten offiziellen "Brand Environment Design Guidelines / Principles", die auf neue Premium-Retail-Standards ausgerichtet sind.

• Entwicklung von Toolkits & Design Frameworks: Entwerfen umfassender physischer Markensysteme und skalierbarer Toolkits, die lokal relevante und global einheitliche Markenausdrücke über Aktivierungen und strategische Bereiche hinweg ermöglichen.

• Förderung der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit: Als wichtiger Bindeglied zwischen Marken-, Einzelhandels- und regionalen Erfahrungsteams dienen und physische Ausführungsvorgänge auf eine einheitliche Omnichannel-Vision ausrichten.

• Championing Innovation & Premiumness: Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der physischen Markenpräsenz von On, indem jede Aktivierung mit innovativem Denken, hochwertigen Designstandards und einer erhöhten Ästhetik versehen wird, die neu definiert, was Premium für eine Performance-Marke bedeutet. Dazu gehört die Unterstützung immersiver "LightSpray"-Technologie-Showcases und die Sicherstellung, dass sportorientierte Umgebungen die Premium-Performance-First-Identität von On widerspiegeln.

Deine Geschichte

Wir suchen einen visionären Design-Leader, der kreative Kunst mit strategischen Rahmenbedingungen verbindet und einen tiefen Antrieb für immersive Markenwelten hat. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:

• Bewährte Erfahrung: Mindestens 5-7 Jahre Erfahrung in Raumgestaltung, Umweltdesign oder Erlebnisarchitektur mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz führender Designteams.

• Das richtige Profil: Erfahrung in einer erstklassigen kreativen Werbe- / Erlebnisagentur, ideal gepaart mit interner Erfahrung bei einer Premium-, globalen Lifestyle- oder Performance-Marke. Sie verstehen sowohl die rasante kreative Strenge des Agenturlebens als auch die strategische langfristige Vision einer eigenen Marke.

• Bewährte Projektskala: Bewährte Erfahrung in der Verwaltung großer, komplexer physischer Designprojekte und Aktivierungen vom Konzept bis zur Ausführung, bequeme Abwicklung von Projektbudgets von $ 250k bis $ 1M + .

• Portfolio von immersiven Umgebungen: Ein Portfolio, das wirkungsvolle physische Räume außerhalb des Standard-Einzelhandels präsentiert, wie globale Markenaktivierungen, große Event-Gipfel, Pop-ups und Premium-Sportler-zentrierte Umgebungen.

• Strategische Toolkit-Entwicklung: Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Entwicklung globaler Toolkits, Designprinzipien und skalierbarer Frameworks, die einen konsistenten und qualitativ hochwertigen Markenausdruck in verschiedenen globalen Märkten ermöglichen.

• Creative Visionary & Advocate: Die Fähigkeit, komplexe kreative Themen in erstklassigen, wirkungsvollen physischen Umgebungen zu materialisieren, wobei ein unerschütterlicher Fokus auf Qualität, Details und Markenintegrität gewahrt bleibt.

• Collaborative Leadership: Eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, interne Designteams und externe Produktionsagenturen zu steuern und verschiedene funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder und regionale Teams auf eine einheitliche Vision auszurichten.

• Effektive Kommunikation: Außergewöhnliche verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch sind erforderlich; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Plus für die globale Zusammenarbeit.

Über das Team
Wir stellen sicher, dass sich die Marke überall dort, wo sie Menschen in der realen Welt trifft – sei es auf einer globalen Bühne, in einer Athletenumgebung, auf einem Gipfel oder in einer B2B-Umgebung – unverkennbar anfühlt: Premium, kohärent und in Innovation verwurzelt. Übersetzen von Markenabsichten in die physische Realität durch Richtlinien, Toolkits und Ausführungsframeworks.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Zurich, Suisse

À propos

Né dans les Alpes suisses, On a perturbé le paysage des vêtements de sport par une exploration incessante. Notre voyage a commencé non avec une chaussure standard, mais avec une ambition radicale de redéfinir le mouvement. Nous sommes alimentés par l'innovation, les rêves audacieux et l'engagement à améliorer les voies à suivre. Notre mission, qui est d'aligner l'esprit humain par le mouvement, repose sur trois piliers fondamentaux : la performance, le design et l'impact. Notre personnalité est définie en étant Obsessive au sujet de notre métier, non conventionnelle dans notre approche, et sans peur pour façonner un avenir premium.

Bref

En tant que Senior Design Lead, Brand Environment Design chez On, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la façon dont notre marque prend vie dans le monde physique en dehors du commerce de détail. Vous dirigerez la direction de la conception spatiale, traduisant le langage distinctif de la conception de la marque On. Ce rôle consiste à créer des concepts visionnaires, à guider les équipes de conception et les partenaires externes, et à élaborer des cadres stratégiques qui garantissent que chaque point de contact physique se sente incomparablement On: premium, cohérent et enraciné dans l'innovation.

Votre mission

Votre mission principale sera de définir et d'élever comment On se montre dans le monde physique, en conduisant la créativité et la cohérence sur tous les points de contact non-détail. Vous serez responsable :

• Direction du design spatial : Diriger la voie créative pour les environnements non-detail pour garantir l'harmonie visuelle et l'exécution haut de gamme qui reflète notre identité centrale.

• Création de concepts et de récits : Traduire des priorités de marque et une orientation créative globale en concepts physiques tangibles, immersifs et percutants et en récits d'expérience convaincants.

• Designers et agences de guidage : Développer des briefs inspirants qui permettent aux talents internes et externes de transformer une stratégie de haut niveau en sorties haut de gamme et esthétiquement alignées du concept au lancement.

• Assurer l'alignement créatif et la fidélité : agir en tant que gardienne des normes de conception d'On, en assurant que toutes les expressions de marque physique maintiennent la qualité et la cohérence sur différents points de contact. Il s'agit notamment de publier les premières lignes directrices/principes officiels de conception de l'environnement de marque, conformes aux nouvelles normes de vente au détail haut de gamme.

• Developing Toolkits & Design Frameworks : Concevoir des systèmes physiques complets de marque et des boîtes à outils évolutives qui facilitent l'expression de la marque localement pertinente mais globalement unifiée à travers les activations et les espaces stratégiques.

• Favoriser la collaboration transfrontalière : servir de connecteur clé pour les équipes d'expérience de marque, de détail et régionale, en alignant les exécutions physiques sur une vision omnicanale unifiée.

• Championing Innovation & Premiumness : Évolution continue de la présence de la marque physique On en infusant chaque activation avec une pensée innovante, des standards de design haut de gamme et une esthétique élevée qui redéfinit ce que signifie la prime pour une marque de performance. Cela inclut le soutien immersif de la technologie « LightSpray » et la garantie que les environnements centrés sur l'athlète reflètent l'identité premium et première performance d'On.

Votre histoire

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader du design visionnaire qui relie l'art créatif à des cadres stratégiques et qui possède une dynamique profonde pour créer des mondes de marque immersifs. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez apporter:

• Expérience éprouvée : Un minimum de 5 à 7 ans d'expérience dans la conception spatiale, la conception environnementale ou l'architecture expérientielle, avec une solide expérience des principales équipes de conception.

• The Right Profile: Expérience de travail au sein d'une agence de publicité/d'expérience créative de haut niveau, idéalement associée à une expérience en interne à une marque de luxe, de style de vie mondial ou de performance. Vous comprenez à la fois la rigueur créative rapide de la vie d'agence et la vision stratégique à long terme d'une marque interne.

• Échelle de projet éprouvée : Expérience éprouvée de gestion de projets de conception physique complexes à grande échelle et d'activations du concept à l'exécution, gestion confortable des budgets de projet allant de 250k$ à 1M$+.

• Portfolio of Immersive Environments: Un portfolio présentant des espaces physiques à impact élevé en dehors du commerce de détail standard, tels que les activations de marques mondiales, les sommets d'événements à grande échelle, les pop-ups et les environnements athlète de premier plan.

• Élaboration de trousses d'outils stratégiques: Expérience approfondie dans l'élaboration de trousses d'outils mondiales, de principes de conception et de cadres évolutifs qui permettent une expression cohérente et de haute qualité de la marque sur divers marchés mondiaux.

• Creative Visionary & Advocate: La capacité de matérialiser des thèmes créatifs complexes dans des environnements physiques haut de gamme et à impact élevé, en maintenant un accent indéfectible sur la qualité, le détail et l'intégrité de la marque.

• Leadership collaboratif : Capacité démontrée de diriger les équipes de conception internes et les organismes de production externes, en alignant les diverses parties prenantes interfonctionnelles et les équipes régionales autour d'une vision unifiée.

Nous nous assurons que partout où la marque rencontre des gens dans le monde réel, qu'il s'agisse d'une scène mondiale, d'un environnement sportif, d'un sommet ou d'un cadre B2B, elle se sent indiscutablement On: premium, cohérente et enracinée dans l'innovation. Traduire l'intention de la marque en réalité physique au moyen de lignes directrices, d'outils et de cadres d'exécution.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Art Director, Running
jobs.description:
In short

At On, we believe in the power of storytelling. Whether it's celebrating the achievements of our athletes, the passions of our communities, or the innovation behind our products – our stories captivate and inspire. Our Creative Studio is at the heart of it all, shaping campaigns that leave a lasting impact. We’re looking for a highly experienced visual storyteller to craft art direction and to concept industry-leading creative across our global campaigns. As Senior Lead Art Director - Running , you’ll work closely with Creative Directors and Copywriters to deliver impactful concepts and stories across channels. The ideal candidate is an expert conceptual thinker and visual artist with a deep understanding of channel best practices and leadership experience.

You strive for creative excellence in every brief, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You enter the creative process with foresight, identifying potential issues before they arise. You have a love of craft, and immerse yourself in global subcultures. You confidently navigate the creative journey from beginning to end: from strategic foundations, moving through significant conceptual development and production, and culminating in the final rollout.

The Senior Lead Art Director - Running will report to the Head of Creative - Running in the Creative Studio.

Your Mission

• Partner with Copywriters to concept and execute innovative campaigns across all channels, bringing big ideas to life from briefs big and small.

• Confidently and articulately present creative ideas based on strategy and insights.

• Deliver concepts, films, OOH, digital and 360 campaigns with obsessive craft on ambitious timelines.

• Uphold and evolve On's distinctive visual identity , ensuring it remains fearless and unconventional.

• Lead creative in the Run category to success, fostering a sense of bravery and dedication within your team, ensuring they are motivated, inspired, and consistently delivering bold, original and inventive concepts and distinctive visual languages for campaigns and projects.

• Manage multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously, making sound creative decisions independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Exemplify leadership in creative, championing the On Spirits, and actively contributing to company culture and events.

Your story

• A dynamic, experienced art director with 6+ years of experience as a creative championing big ideas on global advertising and/or marketing campaigns, brand side or at an agency.

• A passionate visual storyteller with a portfolio spanning film, digital/social, OOH , and disruptive activations.

• Deep understanding of global digital user journeys and how to leverage touchpoints to drive meaningful action.

• Experience challenging the status quo and navigating complex stakeholder environments to deliver creative and commercial results.

• Comfortable leading high-impact initiatives that significantly influence the business and brand trajectory.

• You know how to lead and inspire within your team, identify underlying issues and root causes, and seek solutions to problems.

• You have a deep love for, and experience in, culture, fashion, and performance sports.

On’s Brand Studio is an award-winning internal studio aiming to challenge world-leading creative agencies. At our core, we tell compelling stories and bring experiences to life. We channel the energy and global nature of the brand into our daily work and you can help us continue our fantastic run of successes. If you’re bursting with original ideas and have the drive and experience to see them realized, this is the team for you.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Creative Apparel Marketing

titleByLocale.it: Senior Direttore of Creative Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.en: Senior Director of Creative Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.de: Senior Direktor of Creative Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Directeur of Creative Apparel Marketing

jobs.description:
At a Glance

As the Senior Director of Creative Apparel Marketing , you will serve as the primary brand partner to the creative and product leadership team Your mission is to translate product design vision into a cohesive brand creative language, acting as a guardian of the apparel portfolio while ensuring all marketing efforts align with global priorities. This is an enterprise-level leadership role that demands a blend of strategic marketing expertise and visionary creative direction to deliver high-impact campaigns at the intersection of fashion, performance, and contemporary culture.

Your Mission

Architect Creative Strategy & Vision

• Define the long-term, multi-year architecture for the apparel creative function, ensuring a unified global identity across all brand platforms.

• Translate product creative direction into compelling brand platforms that resonate across diverse global communities.

• Direct high-impact campaigns and collaborations , partnering with globally relevant talent, designers, and cultural voices.

• Establish and mandate KPIs and metrics (e.g., brand health, cultural relevance, portfolio value) to measure the systemic success of creative initiatives.

Lead Organizational & Creative Excellence

• Lead and inspire multidisciplinary creative teams , including art directors, copywriters, and spatial designers, nurturing ambition and clarity across the studio.

• Architect the global operating model for apparel brand creative, defining clear roles and decision-making rights between product, marketing, and commercial teams.

• Act as the primary interface between the creative function and Executive Leadership , communicating strategy, performance, and talent needs.

• Coach and mentor the team to raise the bar on both strategic thinking and execution quality .

Drive Enterprise Impact

• Simplify and prioritize a complex portfolio of brand initiatives to focus resources on the highest-value growth opportunities.

• Ensure creative synergies across all product categories, marketing channels, and regions.

• Champion creative excellence across every consumer touchpoint, from film and imagery to retail and digital experiences.

Your Story

• Executive Leadership: You are a recognized leader with 15+ years of progressive experience in brand management and creative direction within premium sportswear, fashion, or luxury industries.

• Managerial Depth: You have at least 8+ years of experience managing Director-level leaders and overseeing complex, multi-category portfolios.

• Strategic Architect: You possess the ability to build 5-year strategic plans and align the C-suite, regional presidents, and cross-functional EVP leadership.

• Creative Intuition: You are a creative mind rooted in design and culture, fluent in how aesthetics and meaning drive brand desire beyond standard categories—exploring art, architecture, and sound.

• Operational Gravitas: You navigate ambiguity with ease, balancing creative vision with the "system builder" mindset required to deliver executable frameworks for global teams.

• Communication Mastery: You have an exceptional executive presence and are comfortable presenting vision and performance to large internal and external audiences.

What We Offer

• A challenging role at the forefront of global expansion with unparalleled influence on long-term brand architecture.

• A culture that values experimentation, well-being, and individuality , providing the freedom to create and design for the long run.

• A commitment to an inclusive work environment as an Equal Opportunity Employer .

titleByLocale.it: Senior Direttore of Brand Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.en: Senior Director of Brand Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.de: Senior Direktor of Brand Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Directeur of Brand Apparel Marketing

jobs.description:
At a Glance

You are the Senior Director of Apparel Marketing , reporting directly into the CMO. Your mission is to be the direct brand partner to the Creative Director of apparel, inspire teams across On, champion our culture, and be recognized as a guardian of the Apparel brand portfolio and strategic direction, ensuring all Marketing efforts in Apparel align with the main On priorities, influenced by the external global landscape.

• Work Focus: You will define and lead the function-wide brand strategy for Apparel, overseeing multiple complex and strategic initiatives with a core focus on Apparel. This role demands enterprise-level strategic expertise and has a critical, systemic impact throughout On.

• Decision-making: You are experienced at driving high-level decisions, acting as the decision maker for the Apparel Brand Management function and playing a key role in executive decision-making.

• Scope: Projects and initiatives under your direction have a strategic impact on On’s entire portfolio and long-term direction. You collaborate with the C-suite, senior leadership and are a key stakeholder to the Management Team.

• Autonomy: You own the Apparel Brand Management discipline globally, defining operating models and priorities. You are responsible for simplifying complex organizational situations and prioritizing critical work across the enterprise. You play a key role in ensuring synergies across all product categories, marketing channels, and regions.

Your Mission

Your core mission is to elevate the global On brand by architecting the structure, defining the strategy, and leading the talent required to execute our brand promise across all categories.

Set the Enterprise Brand Vision & Governance

• Define the long-term, multi-year architecture for the Apparel Brand Management function, dictating how all category brand leads (including the Head of Brand, Apparel) approach their business to ensure a unified global brand identity.

• Align and secure buy-in from the C-suite and all regional Managing Directors on the overarching brand strategy and resource allocation across major product verticals.

• Simplify and prioritize the complex portfolio of brand initiatives to focus resources on the highest-value opportunities for On’s sustainable growth.

Drive Organizational and Talent Excellence

• Serve as the senior organizational leader who coaches, mentors, and directs the Apparel Brand team to raise the bar on strategic thinking and execution quality. You will also influence and drive

• Architect the global operating model for Apparel Brand management, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making rights between product, marketing, and commercial teams globally.

• Act as the primary interface between the Apparel Brand function and Executive Leadership, communicating the brand strategy, performance, and talent needs.

Measure for Systemic Evolution

• Establish and mandate the key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics (e.g., brand health, cultural relevance, portfolio value) used across all apparel categories and regions to measure brand success.

• Drive a culture of measurement that informs strategic shifts in product investment, market entry, and commercial priorities at the executive level.

Your Story

You are a recognized executive leader with a track record of driving change and growth at a global scale. You possess the intellectual curiosity and gravitas necessary to challenge the status quo at the highest levels of the organization while fostering a culture of high performance and psychological safety within your team.

You see yourself as an enterprise-level strategist, capable of navigating ambiguity and complexity to deliver simple, high-impact organizational solutions. You are a Culture and Talent Catalyst who inspires senior leaders and develops the next generation of leadership.

We’d love to hear from people with:

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global brand management, brand strategy, or equivalent roles within premium sportswear, fashion, or consumer industries.

• A minimum of 8+ years in a senior managerial role , managing a team of Director-level or equivalent leaders and overseeing a complex, multi-category brand portfolio.

• Demonstrated ability to architect long-term strategic plans (5-year horizon) and successfully align C-suite, regional presidents, and cross-functional SVP/EVP leadership teams.

• Executive-level presence and exceptional presentation skills; comfortable presenting strategy, performance, and organizational recommendations in front of large internal and external audiences.

• A high level of intellectual curiosity and a strategic mind balanced with the ability to define simple, executable frameworks for global teams.

What We Offer

• A challenging role that puts you at the forefront of On's global expansion and brand architecture, offering unparalleled influence on the company's long-term success.

• A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles, and challenges.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Sample Maker
jobs.description:
Sample Maker Job Summary:
 We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Sample Maker with a passion for athletic and ready to wear apparel. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-quality prototypes, muslins and mockups in partnership with pattern engineers, product development and designers to bring product concepts to life. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in fabric handling (both cutting and sewing), garment construction and sewing techniques. This person should be self driven and eager to continuously grow their skills in apparel development. This is a 6 month contract with potential for permanent.

Key Responsibilities:

• Construct prototypes based on technical specifications, patterns, and alternative construction methods in collaboration with cross functional teams.

• Determine optimal fabrics, trims, and sewing techniques for high-performance apparel.

• Proactively identify and resolve construction challenges.

• Support prototype-to-production transitions at a premium level.

• Ensure samples meet strict quality standards for stitching, durability, and finish.

• Maintain an organized workspace and efficient workflow.

• Stay current on both athletic and ready to wear industry trends and advanced sewing techniques, specific to appearance and function.

Qualifications & Skills:

Experience:

• 8+ years of experience as a Sample Maker, Sample Sewer, or in a similar role within apparel manufacturing, including employment experience in a factory, sample room, or tailoring shop.

• Demonstrated technical proficiency in handling and sewing complex fabrications, spanning both stretch and non-stretch textiles.

• Advanced experience with sewing athletics and ready to wear garments.

• Understanding of garment construction and pattern interpretation.

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in using industrial sewing machines (single-needle, overlock, coverstitch, etc.).

• Ability to read and follow patterns, spec sheets, and technical sketches.

• Experience working with all fabrications

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with digital pattern-making software (e.g., Gerber, Lectra) is a plus.

• Basic knowledge of garment dyeing, washing, or textile printing techniques (DTF, DTG).

About the team:

We are focused, solutions-oriented, and able to take action upon imminent challenges. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously confronting the status quo and the industry standard. We are engineers that steer pinnacle sportswear design ideas into functional reality. We are able to convert innovative concepts and prototypes into commercialised products with stringent quality and engineering standards, bringing them into the hands of our discerning, global customer base. Product creation is a mindset and every team member is empowered to make decisions with the understanding that failure is part of the learning and growth process. As an integrated function in the design and development organisation; we are detail-minded problem solvers; guiding and executing apparel technical development within tight timelines and the highest possible product quality, both on the shelf and in use.
