• Basic knowledge of garment dyeing, washing, or textile printing techniques (DTF, DTG). About the team: We are focused, solutions-oriented, and able to take action upon imminent challenges. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously confronting the status quo and the industry standard. We are engineers that steer pinnacle sportswear design ideas into functional reality. We are able to convert innovative concepts and prototypes into commercialised products with stringent quality and engineering standards, bringing them into the hands of our discerning, global customer base. Product creation is a mindset and every team member is empowered to make decisions with the understanding that failure is part of the learning and growth process. As an integrated function in the design and development organisation; we are detail-minded problem solvers; guiding and executing apparel technical development within tight timelines and the highest possible product quality, both on the shelf and in use.

jobs.title: Lead - Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
In short

As Footwear Tooling Engineer you will create groundbreaking concepts and products for high-performance athletes while advancing On’s sustainability goals. Working in a collaborative environment, you’ll shape the future direction of our pinnacle performance product and technologies through Innovation and Design.

You will act as the owner of the bottom unit development for our pinnacle performance product and technologies. You will work in close collaboration with designers and developers here at On Labs in Zurich and our Tooling team in Vietnam to create the highest quality products. From concept creation through prototyping, you will guide the team on bottom unit materials, geometries, and construction from a critical manufacturing, biomechanical performance, and durability viewpoint. You will also be a key player in identifying and creating process improvements for all bottom unit development across the company.

Your mission

- Lead the bottom unit development for On’s performance products

- Provide solutions to design and construction constraints by using your demonstrated knowledge of materials, mold construction and manufacturing

- Evaluate and improve product designs for manufacturability and durability by reviewing 2D/3D CADs, prototypes, and feedback from the testing teams

- Ensure alignment with product specifications and manufacturing capabilities

- Use your understanding of plastics injection molding to advise cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components in the bottom unit

- Collaborate with our Asian counterparts and support mold shop teams on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Assist the development, product management, and design teams with any tooling related questions or issues

- Evaluate current workflows and create process improvements to maximize efficiencies and advance testing

Your story

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field

- Minimum of 5 years experience within a footwear engineering role working closely with development and production, ideally in a footwear tooling development

- Technical knowledge of various materials, mold construction, and manufacturing processes relevant to footwear; In-depth knowledge of plastics injection molding principles, including advising on cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components

- Experience working with 2D and 3D CADs (Rhino a bonus); proficiency in reviewing and evaluating 2D/3D CADs for manufacturability, durability, and alignment with product specifications

- Experience in 3D modelling and rapid prototyping tools

- Demonstrated experience in project management, costing, and the ability to provide solutions within complex constraints

- Experience working with biomechanical performance principles as they relate to footwear bottom unit design

- Experience working cross-functionally across designers, developers, product management, and testing teams

- Experience collaborating with international manufacturing partners on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Strong communication skills to provide clear guidance and technical support to various stakeholders.

- Excellent time management skills and ability to work with multiple deadlines

- Available to travel to Asia at least 2 times a year

The team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

jobs.title: Lead - Spatial Designer, EMEA
jobs.description:
In Short:

At On, we’re redefining the boundaries of design and storytelling in sportswear. We are looking for a senior designer to lead on strategically planning and overseeing the delivery of immersive physical experiences in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). These experiences will capture the essence of our brand - bringing our global campaigns to life in a wide range of retail environments across the region. Reporting to the Senior Creative Lead in our EMEA Creative Studio, you will help conceptualize, develop and deliver world-class spatial designs that express On’s identity through innovative use of form, material and narrative. Working with internal and external partners, you will translate On’s innovative spirit into memorable, locally relevant experiences for our fans across EMEA.

Your Mission:

• Adapt and localize global brand campaigns, tailoring their design and storytelling to create impactful, multi-door retail experiences across the region.

• Elevate the On retail environment by applying your expertise in 3D design, set design and scenography to translate concepts into locally relevant retail campaigns across all spatial touchpoints.

• Oversee the design of campaign activations for new store openings, pop-ups, and special events across our retail network.

• Drive the roadmap for the region, planning ahead and overseeing projects from strategic planning to creative execution.

• Work with external agencies, providing clear direction and managing feedback to ensure exceptional, scalable campaign executions.

• Collaborate with global and regional teams across Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing and Production to ensure a cohesive and impactful brand presence at every touchpoint.

• Champion creative problem-solving and challenge the status quo, using your design expertise to push boundaries and create dynamic, forward-thinking retail spaces.

Your Story:

• You’re likely to have 6+ years of experience in campaign or retail experience design for a premium, multi-door DTC brand.

• You have a portfolio that showcases your technical skills in 3D design, drawing and rendering - with a strong emphasis on retail environments and physical spaces, including windows, in-store spaces and pop-ups.

• Your expertise may span across 3D design, set design, spatial or scenographic design.

• You have experience with production drawings, material specification, and build processes.

• You’re an innovative and entrepreneurial thinker, consistently pushing creative boundaries and translating new ideas into tangible, executed designs that convey premium brand positioning.

• You’re an expert at managing multiple projects simultaneously, delivering high-quality work to tight deadlines without compromising on precision or excellence.

• You have a track record of successfully leading agencies or other partners to bring complex designs to life at scale through translating brand vision and design intent into actionable direction.

• You’re adept at navigating complex organizations, collaborating seamlessly across global and regional teams to achieve shared goals.

We’re more interested in the skills, mindset, and creative leadership you bring than in how many years you’ve spent in a specific role or industry. So if the above resonates with you, please feel empowered to apply.

Your Team:

This role can be based in either Zurich or London and you will sit at the intersection of several incredible teams packed with passionate people based primarily in those locations. The EMEA Brand Studio team tells compelling stories and brings experiences to life, all in pursuit of our mission to ignite the power of human spirit through movement. This work requires collaboration across the business. It is hybrid and flexible, 2-3 days per week in the office and some travel between Zurich, London, Paris, Berlin, Milan and other cities in the EMEA region. On is a Swiss company with a stunning local hub in Zurich and rapidly growing teams in London, Berlin and beyond.

What We Offer:

A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles and challenges.

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve:

A On, stiamo ridefinindo i confini del design e del racconto in abbigliamento sportivo. Siamo alla ricerca di un senior designer per condurre alla pianificazione strategica e supervisionare la consegna di esperienze fisiche immersive in Europa, Medio Oriente e Africa (EMEA). Queste esperienze cattureranno l'essenza del nostro marchio - portando a vita le nostre campagne globali in una vasta gamma di ambienti di vendita al dettaglio in tutta la regione. Segnalando al Senior Creative Lead nel nostro EMEA Creative Studio, aiuterete concettualizzare, sviluppare e fornire disegni spaziali di livello mondiale che esprimono L'identità di On attraverso l'uso innovativo di forma, materiale e narrativa. Lavorando con partner interni ed esterni, tradurrete lo spirito innovativo di On in esperienze memorabili e localmente rilevanti per i nostri fan attraverso EMEA.

La vostra missione:

• Adapt e localizzare le campagne di brand globali, adattando il loro design e storytelling per creare esperienze di vendita al dettaglio multi-porta in tutta la regione.

• Elevate l'ambiente di vendita al dettaglio applicando le vostre competenze in progettazione 3D, progettazione e scenografia per tradurre i concetti in campagne di vendita al dettaglio localmente rilevanti in tutti i punti di contatto spaziali.

• Superare la progettazione di attivazioni di campagna per nuove aperture di negozio, pop-up e eventi speciali attraverso la nostra rete di vendita al dettaglio.

• Guidare la roadmap per la regione, pianificare avanti e supervisionare i progetti dalla pianificazione strategica all'esecuzione creativa.

• Lavorare con agenzie esterne, fornire una chiara direzione e gestire i feedback per garantire esecuzioni di campagne eccezionali e scalabili.

• Collabora con i team globali e regionali di Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing e Produzione per garantire una presenza del marchio coesa e d'impatto ad ogni punto di contatto.

• Campione creativo problem-solving e sfidare lo status quo, utilizzando la vostra competenza progettuale per spingere i confini e creare spazi di vendita al dettaglio dinamici e avanzati.

La tua storia:

• È probabile che tu abbia 6+ anni di esperienza nella campagna o nel design di esperienza al dettaglio per un marchio DTC premium e multi-porta.

• Hai un portafoglio che mette in mostra le tue competenze tecniche nel design 3D, nel disegno e nel rendering - con una forte enfasi sugli ambienti retail e sugli spazi fisici, tra cui finestre, spazi in-store e pop-up.

• La vostra esperienza può abbracciare il design 3D, il design set, il design spaziale o scenografico.

• Hai esperienza con disegni di produzione, specifiche dei materiali e processi di costruzione.

• Sei un pensatore innovativo e imprenditoriale, spingendo costantemente i confini creativi e traducendo nuove idee in progetti tangibili e eseguiti che trasmettono il posizionamento premium del marchio.

• Sei un esperto nella gestione simultanea di più progetti, offrendo un lavoro di alta qualità a scadenze strette senza compromettere precisione o eccellenza.

• Hai un track record di agenzie leader con successo o altri partner per portare a vita progetti complessi in scala attraverso la traduzione della visione del marchio e l'intento di progettazione in direzione attuabile.

• Sei abile nella navigazione di organizzazioni complesse, collaborando senza soluzione di continuità tra team globali e regionali per raggiungere obiettivi condivisi.

Siamo più interessati alle competenze, alla mentalità e alla leadership creativa che porti che in quanti anni hai trascorso in un ruolo specifico o nell'industria. Quindi, se il sopra risuona con voi, si prega di sentirsi in grado di applicare.

Il vostro team:

Questo ruolo può essere basato sia a Zurigo che a Londra e vi siederà all'incrocio di diverse squadre incredibili con persone appassionate basate principalmente in quelle località. Il team di EMEA Brand Studio racconta storie convincenti e porta esperienze alla vita, il tutto inseguendo la nostra missione per accendere il potere dello spirito umano attraverso il movimento. Questo lavoro richiede collaborazione in tutto il business. È ibrido e flessibile, 2-3 giorni a settimana in ufficio e alcuni viaggi tra Zurigo, Londra, Parigi, Berlino, Milano e altre città della regione EMEA. On è un'azienda svizzera con uno splendido hub locale a Zurigo e team in rapida crescita a Londra, Berlino e oltre.

Cosa offriamo:

Un processo di reclutamento interno giusto ed equilibrato con l'opportunità di conoscere altre squadre, ruoli e sfide.

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurzum:

Bei On definieren wir die Grenzen von Design und Storytelling in Sportswear neu. Wir suchen einen leitenden Designer, der die strategische Planung und Überwachung der Bereitstellung immersiver physischer Erfahrungen in Europa, dem Nahen Osten und Afrika (EMEA) übernimmt. Diese Erfahrungen werden die Essenz unserer Marke erfassen und unsere globalen Kampagnen in einer Vielzahl von Einzelhandelsumgebungen in der Region zum Leben erwecken. Berichterstattung an den Senior Creative Lead in unserem EMEA Creative Studio, werden Sie helfen, zu konzipieren, zu entwickeln und liefern Weltklasse-Raum-Designs, die Ausdruck On’s Identität durch innovative Nutzung von Form, Material und Erzählung. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern werden Sie den Innovationsgeist von On in unvergessliche, lokal relevante Erlebnisse für unsere Fans in ganz EMEA umsetzen.

Ihre Mission:

• Passen Sie globale Markenkampagnen an und lokalisieren Sie deren Design und Storytelling, um wirkungsvolle, mehrtürige Einzelhandelserlebnisse in der gesamten Region zu schaffen.

• Erhöhen Sie die Einzelhandelsumgebung, indem Sie Ihre Expertise in 3D-Design, Set-Design und Szenografie anwenden, um Konzepte in lokal relevante Einzelhandelskampagnen über alle räumlichen Touchpoints hinweg zu übersetzen.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Gestaltung von Kampagnenaktivierungen für neue Ladeneröffnungen, Pop-ups und Sonderveranstaltungen in unserem Einzelhandelsnetzwerk.

• Führen Sie die Roadmap für die Region voran, planen Sie voraus und beaufsichtigen Sie Projekte von der strategischen Planung bis zur kreativen Umsetzung.

• Arbeiten Sie mit externen Agenturen zusammen, geben Sie eine klare Richtung und verwalten Sie Feedback, um außergewöhnliche, skalierbare Kampagnenausführungen zu gewährleisten.

• Arbeiten Sie mit globalen und regionalen Teams aus den Bereichen Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing und Produktion zusammen, um eine zusammenhängende und wirkungsvolle Markenpräsenz an jedem Touchpoint zu gewährleisten.

• Meistern Sie kreative Problemlösungen und fordern Sie den Status quo heraus, indem Sie Ihre Designkompetenz nutzen, um Grenzen zu überschreiten und dynamische, zukunftsweisende Einzelhandelsflächen zu schaffen.

Deine Geschichte:

• Sie haben wahrscheinlich mehr als 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Kampagnen- oder Einzelhandelserlebnisdesign für eine Premium-Mehrtürer-TC-Marke.

• Sie haben ein Portfolio, das Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten im 3D-Design, Zeichnen und Rendern zeigt - mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf Einzelhandelsumgebungen und physischen Räumen, einschließlich Fenstern, Ladenräumen und Pop-ups.

• Ihre Expertise kann sich über 3D-Design, Set-Design, räumliches oder szenografisches Design erstrecken.

• Sie haben Erfahrung mit Produktionszeichnungen, Materialspezifikationen und Bauprozessen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un concepteur principal pour diriger la planification stratégique et superviser la prestation d'expériences physiques immersives en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique (EMEA). Ces expériences permettront de saisir l'essence de notre marque - mettant en scène nos campagnes mondiales dans un large éventail d'environnements de vente au détail dans la région. Relevant du Senior Creative Lead dans notre Studio Creative EMEA, vous aiderez à conceptualiser, développer et fournir des designs spatiaux de classe mondiale qui expriment Sur l'identité par l'utilisation novatrice de la forme, du matériel et du narratif. En travaillant avec des partenaires internes et externes, vous traduirez l'esprit d'innovation d'On.

Votre mission :

• Adaptez et localisez des campagnes de marques mondiales, en adaptant leur conception et leur narration pour créer des expériences de vente au détail multiportes impactées dans toute la région.

• Augmentez l'environnement de vente au détail en appliquant votre expertise dans la conception 3D, la conception de set et la scénographie pour traduire des concepts en campagnes de vente au détail locales sur tous les points de contact spatiaux.

• Surveillez la conception des activations de campagne pour les ouvertures de nouveaux magasins, les pop-ups et les événements spéciaux sur notre réseau de détail.

• Diriger la feuille de route pour la région, planifier les projets à venir et superviser les projets, de la planification stratégique à l'exécution créative.

• Collaborer avec des organismes externes, fournir une orientation claire et gérer les réactions afin d'assurer des exécutions exceptionnelles et évolutives.

• Collaborer avec des équipes mondiales et régionales à travers l'expérience visuelle, le commerce de détail, le marketing et la production afin d'assurer une présence de marque cohérente et pertinente à chaque point de contact.

• Champion de résolution de problèmes créative et défier le statu quo, en utilisant votre expertise de conception pour repousser les frontières et créer des espaces de vente dynamiques et prospectifs.

Votre histoire :

• Vous aurez probablement plus de 6 ans d'expérience dans la conception d'expérience de campagne ou de vente au détail pour une marque DTC multiporte premium.

• Vous disposez d'un portfolio qui met en valeur vos compétences techniques en conception, dessin et rendu 3D - avec un accent particulier sur les environnements de détail et les espaces physiques, y compris les fenêtres, les espaces en magasin et les pop-ups.

• Votre expertise peut s'étendre sur la conception 3D, la conception de set, la conception spatiale ou scénographique.

• Vous avez de l'expérience avec les dessins de production, la spécification des matériaux et les processus de construction.

• Vous êtes un penseur innovant et entrepreneurial, repoussant constamment les frontières créatives et traduisant de nouvelles idées en designs tangibles et exécutés qui transmettent un positionnement de marque haut de gamme.

• Vous êtes un expert dans la gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets, fournissant un travail de haute qualité à des délais serrés sans compromettre la précision ou l'excellence.

• Vous avez des antécédents d'agences de pointe ou d'autres partenaires qui ont réussi à concrétiser des conceptions complexes à l'échelle en traduisant la vision de la marque et l'intention de la conception dans une direction réalisable.

• Vous êtes adepte de la navigation d'organisations complexes, collaborant de manière transparente entre les équipes mondiales et régionales pour atteindre des objectifs communs.

Nous sommes plus intéressés par les compétences, la mentalité et le leadership créatif que vous apportez que dans combien d'années vous avez passé dans un rôle ou une industrie spécifique. Donc si ce qui précède résonne avec vous, s'il vous plaît se sentir habilité à postuler.

Votre équipe :

Ce rôle peut être basé à Zurich ou à Londres et vous serez assis à l'intersection de plusieurs équipes incroyables avec des gens passionnés basés principalement dans ces endroits. L'équipe de Brand Studio de l'EMEA raconte des histoires convaincantes et apporte des expériences à la vie, tout en poursuivant notre mission d'allumer le pouvoir de l'esprit humain par le mouvement. Ce travail exige une collaboration dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Il est hybride et flexible, 2-3 jours par semaine dans le bureau et certains voyages entre Zurich, Londres, Paris, Berlin, Milan et d'autres villes de la région EMEA. On est une entreprise suisse avec un superbe hub local à Zurich et des équipes en croissance rapide à Londres, Berlin et au-delà.

Ce que nous offrons:

Un processus de recrutement interne juste et équilibré qui permet d'en apprendre davantage sur les autres équipes, les rôles et les défis.

Sur est un endroit qui est centré sur la croissance et le progrès. Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils pour se développer de manière holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche particulière combine une atmosphère de soutien et d'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par but.

Il y a un employeur à égalité de chances. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions relatives au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.description:
In Short…

As the Lead Developer for PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids), you will be responsible for inline Lifestyle products in our fastest-growing, largest product vertical, alongside specialized development engineered specifically for the young movers in our community.

Honing craft takes time. It requires patience, resilience, and a dedication to the complex integration of footwear construction and systems. In this role, you are an individual contributor operating at the intersection of high-performance design for all-day wear and disciplined Swiss Engineering.

Your Mission…

• Commit to the Craft: You will lead the technical development for new silhouettes across both Adult and Kids categories, ensuring that every product meets strict engineering standards for performance, aesthetic, and fit.

• Master Complex Integration: You will serve as the primary technical partner to Design, converting creative dreams into commercial reality without compromising on function.

• Bridge the Generations: You will translate adult performance concepts into kid-specific footwear, understanding the unique biomechanical and durability needs of younger, developing feet.

Your Day-to-Day…

• Execute the Technical Lifecycle: Manage the end-to-end development process from initial 2D/3D design concepts through tech-packing, prototyping, and final production-ready samples.

• Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner with material sourcing and tooling teams to test, validate, and implement new compounds, textiles, and manufacturing methods.

• Lead Fit & Wear Testing: Oversee rigorous fit and wear testing protocols for both adults and kids, analyzing feedback to iterate and optimize comfort, support, and durability.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Act as the central technical hub between Design, Product Management, Sourcing, and Tier 1 factory partners to ensure timelines and margin targets are met.

• Optimize for Scale: Ensure blueprints and construction methods are optimized for mass production while maintaining the pristine aesthetic integrity of the brand.

Your Story…

• The Technical Authority: You bring 7+ years of footwear development experience , with a proven track record of launching highly complex, performance-driven lifestyle or athletic products. Experience in kids' footwear development is a massive plus.

• Resilient Individual Contributor: You have the patience and persistence to navigate the long development road. You take full accountability for the technical lifecycle and thrive when managing independent projects.

• A Problem Solver by Nature: Ingenuity is at your core. You think differently, challenge the status quo, and find elegance in solving the most difficult construction puzzles while maintaining superior performance.

• Global Collaborator: You have extensive experience working directly with overseas commercialization centers and factories, understanding how to communicate technical nuances across cultures.

Your Keys to Success…

• Thrive in Ambiguity: You don't wait for a perfect roadmap. In a fast-scaling environment, parameters change quickly; you view shifting priorities as an opportunity to innovate rather than a roadblock.

• Biased for Action (With Guardrails): You possess a strong sense of urgency. You know when to move fast and trust your gut, and when to pause to ensure Swiss-engineered quality isn't compromised.

• The "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Despite your seniority as a Lead, you are a hands-on builder. You are just as excited to brainstorm high-level platform concepts with Design as you are to roll up your sleeves and fix a tech-pack error.

• Comfortable with Constructive Friction: Innovation doesn’t happen in a vacuum. You welcome diverse perspectives, lean into healthy debate with Design and Product management, and use pushback to sharpen the final product.

• Continuous Learner: The footwear landscape—especially in sustainable materials and circularity—is evolving daily. You are naturally curious, constantly scouting new methods, and eager to apply fresh learnings to the PAD and Kids lines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve...

Come Lead Sviluppatore per PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids), sarai responsabile per i prodotti Lifestyle in linea nella nostra più rapida crescita, più grande prodotto verticale, insieme allo sviluppo specializzato progettato specificamente per i giovani traslochi nella nostra comunità.

L'astronave richiede tempo. Richiede pazienza, resilienza e dedizione alla complessa integrazione della costruzione e dei sistemi di calzature. In questo ruolo, Lei è un contributore individuale che opera all'incrocio di design ad alte prestazioni per l'usura di tutti i giorni e l'ingegneria svizzera disciplinata.

La tua missione...

• Impegnati all'artigianato: guiderai lo sviluppo tecnico di nuove silhouette sia per le categorie Adulti che per bambini, garantendo che ogni prodotto soddisfi rigidi standard di ingegneria per prestazioni, estetica e vestibilità.

• Integrazione Master Complex: Servirai come principale partner tecnico di Design, convertendo i sogni creativi in realtà commerciale senza compromettere la funzione.

• Bridge the Generations: Tradurrete concetti di prestazioni per adulti in calzature specifiche per bambini, comprendendo le esigenze biomeccaniche e di durata uniche dei piedi più giovani e in via di sviluppo.

Il tuo giorno per giorno...

• Esegui il ciclo di vita tecnico: Gestisci il processo di sviluppo end-to-end dai concetti iniziali di progettazione 2D/3D attraverso i campioni tech-packing, prototipazione e produzione-ready finale.

• Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner con team di sourcing e tooling per testare, convalidare e implementare nuovi composti, tessuti e metodi di produzione.

• Lead Fit & Wear Testing: supervisiona i protocolli di prova di vestibilità e usura rigorosi per adulti e bambini, analizzando il feedback per iterare e ottimizzare il comfort, il supporto e la durata.

• Collaborare in modo trasversale: agire come hub tecnico centrale tra Design, Product Management, Sourcing e Tier 1 partner di fabbrica per garantire tempi e obiettivi di margine.

• Ottimizzazione per Scale: Assicurare le stampe e i metodi di costruzione sono ottimizzati per la produzione di massa mantenendo l'incontaminato integrità estetica del marchio.

La tua storia...

• L'Autorità Tecnica: Porti 7+ anni di esperienza di sviluppo calzaturiero, con una comprovata traccia di lancio di stili di vita altamente complessi, orientati alle prestazioni o prodotti atletici. L'esperienza nello sviluppo delle calzature per bambini è un vantaggio enorme.

• Contributor individuale resiliente: hai la pazienza e la persistenza di navigare lungo la strada di sviluppo. Prendere piena responsabilità per il ciclo di vita tecnico e prosperare quando si gestisce progetti indipendenti.

• Un Problem Solver della Natura: L'ingegno è al vostro centro. Pensi in modo diverso, sfida lo status quo, e trovare l'eleganza nel risolvere i puzzle di costruzione più difficili, mantenendo prestazioni superiori.

• Global Collaboratore: Hai una vasta esperienza di lavoro direttamente con centri di commercializzazione all'estero e fabbriche, comprendendo come comunicare sfumature tecniche in tutte le culture.

Le tue chiavi di successo...

• Thrive in Ambiguity: Non aspettate una roadmap perfetta. In un ambiente in rapida crescita, i parametri cambiano rapidamente; si osservano le priorità di spostamento come un'opportunità per innovare piuttosto che un blocco stradale.

• Biased for Action (Con Guardrails): Hai un forte senso di urgenza. Sai quando muoversi velocemente e fidarti del tuo istinto, e quando fermarti per garantire che la qualità ingegnerizzata svizzera non sia compromessa.

• The "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Nonostante la tua anzianità come Piombo, sei un costruttore di mani. Sei altrettanto entusiasta di brainstorming concetti di piattaforma di alto livello con Design come si sta per roll up le maniche e risolvere un errore tech-pack.

• Confortevole con la frizione costruttiva: l’innovazione non avviene in un vuoto. Si accolgono diverse prospettive, si appoggiano al dibattito sano con Design e Product Management, e utilizzare pushback per affinare il prodotto finale.

• Continuous Learner: Il paesaggio calzaturiero, soprattutto in materiali e circolarità sostenibili, si sta evolvendo ogni giorno. Siete naturalmente curiosi, costantemente esplorando nuovi metodi, e desiderosi di applicare nuove apprensioni alle linee PAD e Kids.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gesagt...

Als Lead Developer für PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids) sind Sie für Inline-Lifestyle-Produkte in unserer am schnellsten wachsenden, größten Produktvertikale verantwortlich, neben einer spezialisierten Entwicklung, die speziell für die jungen Mover in unserer Community entwickelt wurde.

Hon-Craft braucht Zeit. Es erfordert Geduld, Widerstandsfähigkeit und ein Engagement für die komplexe Integration von Schuhkonstruktion und -systemen. In dieser Funktion sind Sie ein individueller Mitwirkender, der an der Schnittstelle von Hochleistungsdesign für Ganztagsbekleidung und diszipliniertem Swiss Engineering arbeitet.

Deine Mission...

• Engagieren Sie sich für das Handwerk: Sie werden die technische Entwicklung für neue Silhouetten in den Kategorien Erwachsene und Kinder leiten und sicherstellen, dass jedes Produkt strenge technische Standards für Leistung, Ästhetik und Passform erfüllt.

• Master Complex Integration: Sie werden als primärer technischer Partner für Design dienen und kreative Träume in kommerzielle Realität verwandeln, ohne Kompromisse bei der Funktion einzugehen.

• Brücke der Generationen: Sie werden erwachsene Leistungskonzepte in kinderspezifische Schuhe übersetzen und die einzigartigen biomechanischen und Haltbarkeitsbedürfnisse jüngerer, sich entwickelnder Füße verstehen.

Dein Tag-zu-Tag...

• Führen Sie den technischen Lebenszyklus aus: Verwalten Sie den End-to-End-Entwicklungsprozess von anfänglichen 2D/3D-Designkonzepten durch Tech-Packing, Prototyping und endgültige produktionsfähige Muster.

• Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner mit Materialbeschaffungs- und Werkzeugteams, um neue Verbindungen, Textilien und Herstellungsmethoden zu testen, zu validieren und zu implementieren.

• Lead Fit & Wear Testing: Überwachen Sie strenge Pass- und Verschleißtestprotokolle für Erwachsene und Kinder und analysieren Sie Feedback, um Komfort, Unterstützung und Langlebigkeit zu iterieren und zu optimieren.

• Funktionell zusammenarbeiten: Handeln Sie als zentraler technischer Knotenpunkt zwischen Design, Produktmanagement, Beschaffung und Tier-1-Fabrikpartnern, um sicherzustellen, dass Zeitpläne und Margenziele erreicht werden.

• Optimieren Sie für den Maßstab: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Blaupausen und Konstruktionsmethoden für die Massenproduktion optimiert sind, während die ursprüngliche ästhetische Integrität der Marke erhalten bleibt.

Deine Geschichte...

• Die Technische Behörde: Sie bringen mehr als 7 Jahre Erfahrung in der Schuhentwicklung mit, mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Einführung hochkomplexer, leistungsorientierter Lifestyle- oder Sportprodukte. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Kinderschuhen ist ein großes Plus.

• Resilienter Individual Contributor: Sie haben die Geduld und Ausdauer, um den langen Entwicklungsweg zu gehen. Sie übernehmen die volle Verantwortung für den technischen Lebenszyklus und gedeihen bei der Verwaltung unabhängiger Projekte.

• Ein Problemlöser von Natur aus: Einfallsreichtum ist in Ihrem Kern. Sie denken anders, fordern den Status quo heraus und finden Eleganz bei der Lösung der schwierigsten Konstruktionsrätsel, während Sie eine überlegene Leistung beibehalten.

• Global Collaborator: Sie haben umfangreiche Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit ausländischen Vermarktungszentren und Fabriken und verstehen, wie Sie technische Nuancen über Kulturen hinweg kommunizieren können.

Ihre Schlüssel zum Erfolg...

• Gedeihen Sie in Mehrdeutigkeit: Sie warten nicht auf eine perfekte Roadmap. In einer schnell skalierenden Umgebung ändern sich die Parameter schnell; Sie betrachten wechselnde Prioritäten als Chance zur Innovation und nicht als Hindernis.

• Voreingenommen für Action (mit Guardrails): Sie besitzen ein starkes Gefühl der Dringlichkeit. Sie wissen, wann Sie sich schnell bewegen und Ihrem Bauch vertrauen müssen und wann Sie pausieren müssen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Qualität von Swiss Engineering nicht beeinträchtigt wird.

• Das "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Trotz Ihrer Seniorität als Lead sind Sie ein praktischer Builder. Sie sind genauso aufgeregt, High-Level-Plattformkonzepte mit Design zu brainstormen, wie Sie Ihre Ärmel hochkrempeln und einen Tech-Pack-Fehler beheben.

• Komfortabel mit konstruktiver Reibung: Innovation passiert nicht in einem Vakuum. Sie begrüßen vielfältige Perspektiven, lehnen sich in eine gesunde Debatte mit Design und Produktmanagement ein und verwenden Pushback, um das Endprodukt zu schärfen.

• Continuous Learner: Die Schuhlandschaft - insbesondere in nachhaltigen Materialien und Zirkularität - entwickelt sich täglich weiter. Sie sind natürlich neugierig, suchen ständig nach neuen Methoden und sind bestrebt, neue Erkenntnisse auf die PAD- und Kids-Linien anzuwenden.

Ton quotidien...

• The Technical Authority: Vous apportez 7+ années d'expérience de développement de chaussures, avec une expérience éprouvée de lancement de produits de style de vie ou d'athlétisme hautement complexes et axés sur la performance. L'expérience dans le développement de chaussures pour enfants est un plus massif.

• Contributeur individuel résilient : Vous avez la patience et la persévérance de naviguer sur la longue route de développement. Vous assumez l'entière responsabilité du cycle de vie technique et vous prospèrez dans la gestion de projets indépendants.

• Un problème résolu par la nature : l'ingéniosité est à votre cœur. Vous pensez différemment, défiez le statu quo, et trouvez l'élégance dans la résolution des puzzles de construction les plus difficiles tout en maintenant des performances supérieures.

• Global Collaborator: Vous avez une vaste expérience de travail directement avec les centres et les usines de commercialisation à l'étranger, comprenant comment communiquer des nuances techniques à travers les cultures.

Vos clés pour réussir...

• Thrive in Ambiguity: Vous n'attendez pas une feuille de route parfaite. Dans un environnement à l'échelle rapide, les paramètres changent rapidement; vous considérez l'évolution des priorités comme une occasion d'innover plutôt qu'un obstacle.

• Faux pour agir (avec garde-corps) : Vous avez un fort sentiment d'urgence. Vous savez quand se déplacer rapidement et faire confiance à votre instinct, et quand faire une pause pour s'assurer que la qualité suisse ne soit pas compromise.

• L'esprit "Pas de travail trop petit": Malgré votre ancienneté en tant que chef, vous êtes un constructeur pratique. Vous êtes tout aussi heureux de brainstorm de concepts de plate-forme de haut niveau avec Design que vous êtes de rouler vos manches et de corriger une erreur tech-pack.

• Confortable avec la friction constructive : l'innovation ne se produit pas dans le vide. Vous accueillez diverses perspectives, vous penchez dans un débat sain avec la conception et la gestion du produit, et utilisez le retour pour aiguiser le produit final.

• Apprentissage continu : Le paysage de la chaussure – surtout dans les matériaux durables et la circulaire – évolue quotidiennement. Vous êtes naturellement curieux, constamment à la recherche de nouvelles méthodes, et désireux d'appliquer de nouveaux apprentissages aux lignes PAD et Kids.

jobs.title: Lead - Commercialization Engineer
jobs.description:
In short:

As a Lead, Innovation commercialization engineer, you will be a driving force at the forefront of On's scale of product evolution. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy to lead complex projects, challenge conventions, and champion innovative approaches that define the future of footwear. This role requires you to master technical complexity, manage key stakeholder relationships, and translate visionary concepts into scalable, performance-driven products.

Your Mission:

• As a leader within the team, you will independently manage multiple high-impact footwear development projects from confirmation to production, defining methods and procedures for new assignments and potentially supervising other team members. As a senior contributor, you will leverage your expertise to guide and influence both management and your team.

• You will spearhead the end-to-end commercialization process, leveraging your expert knowledge of manufacturing processes, fit, material properties, mold and process manufacturing. Your strong root-cause analysis mindset will be crucial in troubleshooting significant and unique issues related to tooling, molding, assembly, fit, and wear.

• As the central hub for On’s key manufacturing regions, you will act as a critical liaison between On inline development and production teams, working closely with strategic vendors to ensure product intent is maintained while meeting commercial and operational requirements. You will engineer products for efficient manufacturability, lowest cost, and highest quality and performance.

• You will serve as a key influencer and central communication hub, managing expectations and negotiating effectively with diverse internal teams and major external T1/T2 partners and sourcing teams across regions.

• Collaborating with computational designers, you will work with upper patterns and tooling construction adjustments to enhance fit, durability, and ensure scalable manufacturing. You will be responsible for full size run grading, technical manufacturing operation manuals, initial production trial, ERP system update, scalability sign off, among others.

• You will own the documentation of complex tooling and upper-related issues, defining and communicating clear correction actions to all stakeholders for manufacturing guidelines.

Your Story:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in the footwear industry, with a significant focus on innovation and bringing new technologies to market.

• Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Engineering, Material Science, or another relevant technical field.

• 2D and 3D, computational design and algorithmic capabilities are a plus.

• Proven ability to not only lead the scaling of new technologies but also to assess their commercial viability and factory readiness.

• Expert-level knowledge of advanced footwear manufacturing processes, including robotics, automation, tooling, molding, injecting, welding, lasting, and assembly. You understand factory capabilities, tolerances, and limitations and know how to engineer for scalable replication.

• A natural technical curiosity and a robust, root-cause analysis approach to problem-solving.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to confidently present to senior management and external partners.

• A demonstrated ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, navigating ambiguity and making independent judgments on complex and significant issues.

• Experience in mentoring junior team members or supervising project activities is a strong plus.

• Ability to travel up to 15-20% of the time.

Your Team:

On's Innovation team is an agile, interdisciplinary group of footwear creation, advanced manufacturing, and future of sport experts, driving On's future innovations and athlete-informed technologies that set On footwear apart.

We challenge the status quo and push boundaries to pioneer footwear innovation. As a member of the On Innovation Team, you will think outside the box and bring new, innovative ideas to life.

jobs.title: Lead - Apparel Testing
jobs.description:
In short

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.

As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance.

Your mission

Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process.

Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.

Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders.

Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community.

Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies.

Your story

• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.

• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.

• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams

• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.

• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:

• Apparel Product Testing or Development

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanics or Kinesiology

• Materials Science or Textile Engineering

• Ergonomics or Human Factors

• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management

• High-Performance Coaching

• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.

• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written.

Your Team

You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight. As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance. Your mission Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process. Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations. Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders. Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena. Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community. Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies. Your story
• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.
• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.
• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams
• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.
• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:
• Apparel Product Testing or Development
• User Experience Research (UXR)
• Biomechanics or Kinesiology
• Materials Science or Textile Engineering
• Ergonomics or Human Factors
• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management
• High-Performance Coaching
• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.
• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written. Your Team You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

jobs.title: Lead - Apparel Material Development (Performance)

titleByLocale.fr: Plomb - Mise au point de matériaux pour vêtements (Performance)

jobs.description:
In Short

As Lead – Apparel Materials Development Performance, you will take responsibility for executing the global performance materials strategy and advancing textile technology in line with the company vision. The role includes overseeing fabric creation, advanced material development, and technical execution, as well as collaborating across functions to support performance, sustainability, and high-performance product objectives.

Reporting to the Apparel Materials Team Sr Lead, you will manage material development projects across multiple seasons, support the execution of the global materials strategy, and work closely with Design, Development, Product Management, and Sustainability teams. You will also mentor junior specialists depending on project scope, and guide cross-functional partners to deliver innovative material solutions from concept through to garment production.

Your Mission

• Strategic Sourcing & Creation: Define, develop, and lead the creation and strategic sourcing of technical, high-performance apparel materials (including knits, wovens, and applicable trims or embellishment) in accordance with design briefs, product roadmaps, timelines, sourcing policies, and sustainability requirements.

• Standards & Quality Control: Establish and manage fabric availability standards, sourcing policies, and quality assurance processes, supporting target prices and adherence to program timelines across the global supply chain.

• Multi-Season Management: Lead material development workstreams within assigned projects, coordinating across multiple apparel product seasons to ensure alignment with program objectives.

• Sustainability Leadership: Drive and report on material-specific targets in line with the company sustainability roadmap, ensuring compliance, circularity, and supporting continuous improvement in raw materials.

• Technical Specifications: Create and maintain material and trim specifications, print applications, and related documentation using PLM system, supporting the adoption of best practices within the team.

• Lifecycle & Testing: Manage the material lifecycle, ensuring all textiles and substrates are robustly tested for high-intensity sports applications, approved, and continuously improved, leveraging expertise in yarns, fabric structures, dyeing, finishing, & printing..

• Supplier Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with T2 material suppliers (textile mills, print vendors) and T1 factory teams (garment manufacturers) to support material development, quality, and process improvements.

• Library Innovation: Contribute to the development and maintenance of the digital and physical apparel material library and tools used across the product creation team, supporting both inline commercial lines and special innovation projects.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams — Design, Product Development, Product Management, Innovation, Sustainability, and Testing — across global regions (Eu & Asia Sourcing office) to ensure seamless alignment and successful execution of apparel material initiatives.

Your Profile

• Education: Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Apparel Science, or a related field; Master’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.

• Experience: 8+ years of experience in performance apparel material/fabric development, with a proven track record in technical textiles, innovative synthetics, or sports apparel execution, including extensive collaboration with Asia-based suppliers and factories.

• Global Mobility: Extensive global travel experience to T2 material mills/suppliers and T1 garment factories to troubleshoot, create, develop, and source materials at the source.

• Project Leadership: Proven experience managing cross-functional material development projects from initial concept to commercial production across a matrixed organization.

• Sport Tech Expertise: Deep affinity for apparel design and technology in the technical performance category, with strong knowledge of performance fabric, garment construction methods (e.g., bonding, seam-sealing, knitting), and industry manufacturing processes.

• Innovation Mindset: Demonstrated success in driving innovation in performance materials (such as moisture management, thermoregulation, and lightweight durability), with experience managing multiple overlapping seasons of product development.

• Analytical & Organized: Strong attention to detail, with the ability to organize complex material data and deliver well-structured presentations and long-term planning documents to leadership.

• Leadership & Mentorship: Deep understanding of apparel industry processes, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and mentoring junior colleagues.

• Communication & Negotiation: Strong collaborative skills and experience engaging with diverse global stakeholders, featuring excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities.

• Agility: Able to balance creative design intent with rigorous technical organization and discipline, thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Your Team

The Apparel Materials Development Performance team develops and delivers the company’s performance and sustainability strategy for all apparel textiles and raw materials. The team conducts cutting-edge research, defines global material strategies, and supports projects that advance more sustainable materials, products, and manufacturing processes.

We work closely with cross-functional partners to embed material sustainability and high-performance priorities into the core of garment creation, with a strong focus on effective communication and knowledge sharing. As a Lead, you will contribute your deep technical textile expertise, drive the execution of material strategy, and ensure world-class fabrics and components are successfully integrated across our global sports product lines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Come Lead – Apparel Materials Development Performance, ti assumerai la responsabilità di eseguire la strategia globale dei materiali da performance e avanzare la tecnologia tessile in linea con la visione aziendale. Il ruolo include la supervisione della creazione del tessuto, lo sviluppo avanzato del materiale e l'esecuzione tecnica, nonché la collaborazione tra le funzioni per supportare le prestazioni, la sostenibilità e gli obiettivi di prodotto ad alte prestazioni.

Segnalando all'Apparel Materials Team Sr Lead, gestirai progetti di sviluppo materiale in più stagioni, supporterai l'esecuzione della strategia globale dei materiali e lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team di Design, Sviluppo, Product Management e Sostenibilità. Potrai anche mentore specialisti junior a seconda della portata del progetto, e guidare partner interfunzionali per fornire soluzioni materiali innovative dal concept alla produzione di indumenti.

La tua missione

• Strategic Sourcing & Creation: Definire, sviluppare e condurre la creazione e la sourcing strategica di materiali tecnici, di abbigliamento ad alte prestazioni (compresi maglieria, tessuti, e finiture o abbellimenti applicabili) in conformità con i brief di progettazione, roadmap di prodotto, timeline, politiche di approvvigionamento e requisiti di sostenibilità.

• Standards & Quality Control: Stabilire e gestire gli standard di disponibilità del tessuto, le politiche di approvvigionamento e i processi di garanzia della qualità, sostenendo i prezzi target e l'adesione alle linee temporali del programma in tutta la catena di fornitura globale.

• Multi-Season Management: Lead material development workstreams all'interno di progetti assegnati, coordinando attraverso più stagioni di prodotti di abbigliamento per garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi del programma.

• Leadership della sostenibilità: Guidare e riferire gli obiettivi specifici del materiale in linea con la roadmap della società per la sostenibilità, garantire la conformità, la circolarità e sostenere il miglioramento continuo delle materie prime.

• Specifiche tecniche: Creare e mantenere specifiche di materiale e trim, applicazioni di stampa e relativa documentazione utilizzando il sistema PLM, supportando l'adozione delle migliori pratiche all'interno del team.

• Lifecycle & Testing: Gestisci il ciclo di vita del materiale, assicurando che tutti i tessuti e i substrati siano testati robustamente per applicazioni sportive ad alta intensità, approvati e continuamente migliorati, sfruttando competenze in filati, strutture in tessuto, tintura, finitura e stampa.

• Partenariati dei fornitori: costruire e mantenere relazioni strategiche con i fornitori di materiali T2 (tili, fornitori di stampa) e le squadre di fabbrica T1 (produttori di articoli) per supportare lo sviluppo dei materiali, la qualità e i miglioramenti dei processi.

• Library Innovation: Contribuisci allo sviluppo e alla manutenzione della libreria e degli strumenti materiali di abbigliamento digitale e fisico utilizzati in tutto il team di creazione del prodotto, supportando sia linee commerciali in linea che progetti di innovazione speciali.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborare trasversalmente con i team interni — Design, Sviluppo del Prodotto, Gestione del Prodotto, Innovazione, Sostenibilità e Testing — in tutte le regioni globali (Eu & Asia Sourcing office) per garantire un allineamento senza soluzione di continuità e l'esecuzione di iniziative materiali di abbigliamento.

Il tuo profilo

• Istruzione: Corso di laurea (minimo) in Ingegneria Tessile, Tecnologia Tessile, Scienza Apparel, o un campo correlato; Laurea di laurea o esperienza equivalente preferito.

• Esperienza: 8+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del materiale/fabrico dell'abbigliamento prestazionale, con una comprovata esperienza nel settore tessile tecnico, nella realizzazione di materiali sintetici innovativi o di abbigliamento sportivo, tra cui una vasta collaborazione con fornitori e fabbriche asiatiche.

• Mobilità globale: Ampia esperienza di viaggio globale a mulini/fornitori di materiali T2 e fabbriche di indumenti T1 per risolvere, creare, sviluppare e produrre materiali alla fonte.

• Leadership del progetto: Esperienza comprovata che gestisce i progetti di sviluppo materiale interfunzionale dal concetto iniziale alla produzione commerciale attraverso un'organizzazione matrice.

• Sport Tech Expertise: Profonda affinità per la progettazione e la tecnologia dell'abbigliamento nella categoria delle prestazioni tecniche, con una forte conoscenza del tessuto delle prestazioni, dei metodi di costruzione di indumenti (ad esempio, incollaggio, cucitura, maglia) e dei processi di produzione industriale.

• Innovation Mindset: successo dimostrato nella guida dell'innovazione nei materiali performanti (come la gestione dell'umidità, la termoregolazione e la durata leggera), con esperienza nella gestione di più stagioni sovrapposte di sviluppo del prodotto.

• Analitico & Organizzato: forte attenzione ai dettagli, con la capacità di organizzare dati materiali complessi e fornire presentazioni ben strutturate e documenti di pianificazione a lungo termine alla leadership.

• Leadership & Mentorship: profonda comprensione dei processi dell'industria dell'abbigliamento, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, collaborando efficacemente tra team e mentoring colleghi junior.

• Comunicazione & Negotiation: Forte capacità collaborative ed esperienza coinvolgente con diversi stakeholder globali, con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta e di negoziazione.

• Agility: In grado di bilanciare l'intento creativo del design con rigorosa organizzazione tecnica e disciplina, prosperando in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.

Il tuo team

Il team Apparel Materials Development Performance sviluppa e offre la strategia di performance e sostenibilità dell’azienda per tutti i tessuti di abbigliamento e materie prime. Il team conduce una ricerca all'avanguardia, definisce strategie materiali globali e supporta progetti che progrediscono materiali, prodotti e processi produttivi più sostenibili.

Lavoriamo a stretto contatto con partner interfunzionali per incorporare la sostenibilità dei materiali e le priorità ad alte prestazioni nel cuore della creazione di indumenti, con un forte focus sulla comunicazione efficace e la condivisione delle conoscenze. In qualità di Lead, contribuirai alla tua profonda esperienza tecnica tessile, guiderai l'esecuzione della strategia dei materiali e garantirai che tessuti e componenti di livello mondiale siano integrati con successo nelle nostre linee di prodotti sportivi globali.
