descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz

Als Lead – Apparel Materials Development Performance übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung der globalen Performance-Materialien-Strategie und die Weiterentwicklung der Textiltechnologie im Einklang mit der Unternehmensvision. Die Rolle umfasst die Überwachung der Gewebeerstellung, der fortgeschrittenen Materialentwicklung und der technischen Ausführung sowie die Zusammenarbeit über Funktionen hinweg, um Leistung, Nachhaltigkeit und leistungsstarke Produktziele zu unterstützen.

Unter der Leitung des Bekleidungsmaterialteams leiten Sie Materialentwicklungsprojekte über mehrere Saisons hinweg, unterstützen die Umsetzung der globalen Materialstrategie und arbeiten eng mit Design-, Entwicklungs-, Produktmanagement- und Nachhaltigkeitsteams zusammen. Sie betreuen auch Junior-Spezialisten je nach Projektumfang und führen funktionsübergreifende Partner, um innovative Materiallösungen vom Konzept bis zur Bekleidungsproduktion zu liefern.

Deine Mission

• Strategic Sourcing & Creation: Definieren, entwickeln und leiten Sie die Erstellung und strategische Beschaffung von technischen, leistungsstarken Bekleidungsmaterialien (einschließlich Stricken, Geweben und anwendbaren Zierleisten oder Verzierungen) in Übereinstimmung mit Design-Briefs, Produkt-Roadmaps, Zeitplänen, Sourcing-Richtlinien und Nachhaltigkeitsanforderungen.

• Standards & Qualitätskontrolle: Etablierung und Verwaltung von Stoffverfügbarkeitsstandards, Beschaffungsrichtlinien und Qualitätssicherungsprozessen, Unterstützung der Zielpreise und Einhaltung der Programmzeitpläne in der globalen Lieferkette.

• Multi-Season Management: Führen Sie Materialentwicklungs-Workstreams innerhalb zugewiesener Projekte und koordinieren Sie sie über mehrere Saisons hinweg, um die Ausrichtung auf die Programmziele sicherzustellen.

• Nachhaltigkeitsführerschaft: Leiten und berichten Sie über materialspezifische Ziele im Einklang mit der Nachhaltigkeits-Roadmap des Unternehmens, stellen Sie Compliance, Zirkularität sicher und unterstützen Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Rohstoffen.

• Technische Spezifikationen: Erstellen und Pflegen von Material- und Verkleidungsspezifikationen, Druckanwendungen und zugehörigen Dokumentationen unter Verwendung des PLM-Systems, um die Übernahme von Best Practices im Team zu unterstützen.

• Lifecycle & Testing: Verwalten Sie den Materiallebenszyklus und stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Textilien und Substrate robust für hochintensive Sportanwendungen getestet, genehmigt und kontinuierlich verbessert werden, indem Sie Fachwissen in Garnen, Gewebestrukturen, Färben, Veredeln und Drucken nutzen.

• Lieferantenpartnerschaften: Aufbau und Pflege strategischer Beziehungen zu T2-Materiallieferanten (Textilfabriken, Druckereien) und T1-Fabrikteams (Garmenthersteller), um Materialentwicklung, Qualität und Prozessverbesserungen zu unterstützen.

• Bibliotheksinnovation: Tragen Sie zur Entwicklung und Wartung der digitalen und physischen Bekleidungsmaterialbibliothek und der Werkzeuge bei, die im gesamten Produkterstellungsteam verwendet werden, und unterstützen Sie sowohl Inline-Geschäftslinien als auch spezielle Innovationsprojekte.

• Funktionale Ausrichtung: Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend mit internen Teams zusammen – Design, Produktentwicklung, Produktmanagement, Innovation, Nachhaltigkeit und Testen – in allen globalen Regionen (Büro in Eu und Asien), um eine nahtlose Ausrichtung und erfolgreiche Durchführung von Bekleidungsmaterialinitiativen zu gewährleisten.

Ihr Profil

• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss (Minimum) in Textiltechnik, Textiltechnologie, Bekleidungswissenschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich; Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Erfahrung bevorzugt.

• Erfahrung: 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Leistungsbekleidungsmaterialien / -geweben, mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz in der Ausführung von technischen Textilien, innovativen Kunststoffen oder Sportbekleidung, einschließlich einer umfassenden Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferanten und Fabriken in Asien.

• Globale Mobilität: Umfangreiches globales Reiseerlebnis für T2-Materialmühlen/Lieferanten und T1-Bekleidungsfabriken zur Fehlersuche, Erstellung, Entwicklung und Beschaffung von Materialien an der Quelle.

• Projektleitung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Management funktionsübergreifender Materialentwicklungsprojekte vom ersten Konzept bis zur kommerziellen Produktion in einer matrixförmigen Organisation.

• Sport Tech Expertise: Tiefe Affinität für Bekleidungsdesign und -technologie in der Kategorie technische Leistung, mit fundiertem Wissen über Leistungsgewebe, Bekleidungskonstruktionsmethoden (z. B. Kleben, Nahtsiegeln, Stricken) und industrielle Herstellungsprozesse.

• Innovation Mindset: Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Förderung von Innovationen bei Leistungsmaterialien (wie Feuchtigkeitsmanagement, Thermoregulation und leichte Haltbarkeit) mit Erfahrung in der Verwaltung mehrerer überlappender Jahreszeiten der Produktentwicklung.

• Analytisch & organisiert: Starke Liebe zum Detail, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Materialdaten zu organisieren und gut strukturierte Präsentationen und langfristige Planungsdokumente an die Führung zu liefern.

• Leadership & Mentorship: Tiefes Verständnis der Prozesse in der Bekleidungsindustrie mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig teamübergreifend effektiv zusammenzuarbeiten und Juniorkollegen zu betreuen.

• Kommunikation & Verhandlung: Starke kollaborative Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit verschiedenen globalen Stakeholdern, mit hervorragenden verbalen und schriftlichen Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.

• Agilität: In der Lage, kreative Designabsichten mit strenger technischer Organisation und Disziplin in Einklang zu bringen und in einer schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umgebung zu gedeihen.

Dein Team

Das Team von Apparel Materials Development Performance entwickelt und liefert die Performance- und Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie des Unternehmens für alle Bekleidungstextilien und Rohstoffe. Das Team führt Spitzenforschung durch, definiert globale Materialstrategien und unterstützt Projekte, die nachhaltigere Materialien, Produkte und Herstellungsprozesse voranbringen.

Wir arbeiten eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zusammen, um Materialnachhaltigkeit und Hochleistungsprioritäten in den Kern der Bekleidungsherstellung einzubetten, mit einem starken Fokus auf effektiver Kommunikation und Wissensaustausch. Als Lead bringen Sie Ihre umfassende technische Textilexpertise ein, treiben die Umsetzung der Materialstrategie voran und stellen sicher, dass erstklassige Stoffe und Komponenten erfolgreich in unsere globalen Sportproduktlinien integriert werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
En bref

Lead – Apparel Materials Development Performance, vous assumerez la responsabilité de l'exécution de la stratégie globale en matière de matériaux de performance et de l'avancement de la technologie textile conformément à la vision de l'entreprise. Le rôle consiste à superviser la création de tissus, le développement de matériaux de pointe et l'exécution technique, ainsi qu'à collaborer à l'ensemble des fonctions pour soutenir les objectifs de rendement, de durabilité et de produits à haute performance.

Sous l'autorité de l'équipe des matériaux d'habillement, vous gérerez des projets de développement matériel sur plusieurs saisons, supporterez l'exécution de la stratégie globale des matériaux et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de conception, de développement, de gestion des produits et de développement durable. Vous encadrerez également les jeunes spécialistes en fonction de la portée du projet et guiderez les partenaires interfonctionnels pour offrir des solutions matérielles innovantes, du concept à la production de vêtements.

Votre mission

• Sourcing et création stratégiques : Définir, développer et diriger la création et l'approvisionnement stratégique de matériaux techniques et de haute performance (y compris les tricots, les tresses et les garnitures ou embellissements applicables) conformément aux mémoires de conception, aux feuilles de route des produits, aux calendriers, aux politiques d'approvisionnement et aux exigences de durabilité.

• Normes et contrôle de la qualité : Établir et gérer des normes de disponibilité des tissus, des politiques d'approvisionnement et des processus d'assurance de la qualité, appuyer les prix cibles et respecter les échéanciers des programmes dans toute la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale.

• Gestion multi-saisons : Secteurs d'activité du développement du matériel principal dans le cadre des projets assignés, coordination entre plusieurs saisons de fabrication de vêtements pour assurer l'harmonisation avec les objectifs du programme.

• Leadership en matière de durabilité: Conduire et faire rapport sur des objectifs spécifiques en fonction de la feuille de route pour la durabilité de l'entreprise, assurer la conformité, la circulaire et soutenir l'amélioration continue des matières premières.

• Spécifications techniques : Créez et maintenez les spécifications de matériaux et de garnitures, les applications d'impression et la documentation connexe en utilisant le système PLM, en appuyant l'adoption des meilleures pratiques au sein de l'équipe.

• Cycle de vie et essais : Gérer le cycle de vie du matériau, en veillant à ce que tous les textiles et substrats soient testés avec robustesse pour des applications sportives de haute intensité, approuvées et continuellement améliorées, en tirant parti de l'expertise dans les fils, les structures de tissu, la teinture, la finition et l'impression.

• Partenariats avec les fournisseurs : Établir et maintenir des relations stratégiques avec les fournisseurs de matériaux T2 (usines de textiles, fournisseurs d'impression) et les équipes d'usines T1 (fabricants de vêtements) pour appuyer le développement des matériaux, la qualité et l'amélioration des procédés.

• Innovation dans la bibliothèque : Contribuer au développement et à l'entretien de la bibliothèque numérique et matérielle du matériel vestimentaire et des outils utilisés dans l'équipe de création de produits, en appuyant à la fois les lignes commerciales en ligne et les projets spéciaux d'innovation.

• Harmonisation interfonctionnelle : Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle avec des équipes internes – conception, développement de produits, gestion de produits, innovation, durabilité et essais – dans les régions du monde (bureau d'approvisionnement d'Eu et d'Asie) afin d'assurer un alignement sans faille et une exécution réussie des initiatives relatives au matériel vestimentaire.

Votre profil

• Études: Baccalauréat (minimum) en ingénierie textile, technologie textile, Apparel Science, ou un domaine connexe; Master ou expérience équivalente préférée.

• Expérience : 8+ ans d'expérience dans le développement de vêtements de performance et de tissus, avec une expérience éprouvée dans les textiles techniques, les synthétiques innovants ou l'exécution de vêtements de sport, y compris une collaboration étendue avec des fournisseurs et des usines basés en Asie.

• Mobilité mondiale : Une vaste expérience de voyage à l'échelle mondiale jusqu'aux usines de fabrication/fournisseurs de matériaux T2 et aux usines de confection T1 pour dépanner, créer, développer et fournir des matériaux à la source.

• Leadership du projet : Expérience éprouvée de gestion de projets de développement de matériaux transfonctionnels, du concept initial à la production commerciale dans une organisation matricielle.

• Expertise en technologie du sport: affinité profonde pour la conception et la technologie de vêtements dans la catégorie de performance technique, avec une solide connaissance du tissu de performance, des méthodes de construction de vêtements (p. ex., collage, couture, tricot) et des procédés de fabrication de l'industrie.

• Innovation Mindset: Un succès démontré dans la conduite de l'innovation dans les matériaux de performance (comme la gestion de l'humidité, la thermorégulation et la durabilité légère), avec l'expérience de gérer plusieurs saisons de chevauchement de développement de produits.

• Analyse et organisation : Une grande attention aux détails, avec la capacité d'organiser des données matérielles complexes et de fournir des présentations bien structurées et des documents de planification à long terme au leadership.

• Leadership & Mentorship: Compréhension approfondie des processus de l'industrie du vêtement, avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en collaborant efficacement entre les équipes et en mentorant les jeunes collègues.

• Communication et négociation : Fortes compétences et expérience en collaboration avec divers intervenants mondiaux, offrant d'excellentes capacités de communication et de négociation verbales et écrites.

• Agilité : Capable d'équilibrer l'esprit créatif avec une organisation technique et une discipline rigoureuses, prospère dans un environnement dynamique et rapide.

Votre équipe

L'équipe de développement des matériaux de l'habillement développe et met en œuvre la stratégie de performance et de durabilité de l'entreprise pour tous les textiles et matières premières. L'équipe mène des recherches de pointe, définit des stratégies mondiales en matière de matériaux et appuie des projets qui font progresser des matériaux, des produits et des procédés de fabrication plus durables.

Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires interfonctionnels pour intégrer la durabilité matérielle et les priorités de haute performance au cœur de la création de vêtements, en mettant l'accent sur une communication efficace et le partage des connaissances. En tant que chef de file, vous apporterez votre expertise textile technique profonde, piloterez l'exécution de la stratégie matérielle et assurerez l'intégration de tissus et de composants de classe mondiale dans nos gammes de produits sportifs mondiaux.

jobs.title: Intern - Group Reporting
jobs.description:
In short

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Your team

We are a small, action-oriented Finance team with big responsibilities and impact across the organization. We evolve best practices by being forward-thinking, working cross-functionally, and leveraging the latest technology to uphold the integrity, accuracy, and transparency of On’s externally published financial reports. The Group Reporting team is responsible for On’s external financial reporting, consolidated financial statements, accounting policies, and technical accounting matters, in compliance with regulations.

Your mission

• Support with the preparation of quarterly, semi-annual, and annual financial reports filed with the SEC (U.S Securities and Exchange Commission) and published externally, in accordance with IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) and SEC regulations. You will help ensure our externally published financial information is accurate and in compliance.

• Partner and collaborate with Accounting, Finance, Legal, Controlling, Treasury, Investor Relations and other teams to gather critical data and qualitative insights for our reporting.

• Assist in developing and implementing process improvements by leveraging AI and technology to streamline and automate group reporting processes.

• Assist with ad-hoc analysis, cross-functional projects, monthly consolidation tasks, accounting policies, and technical accounting memos.

Your story

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Basic understanding of accounting (IFRS considered a plus)

• Curious to learn more about the role of AI and automation in a Finance department

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Highly self-motivated individual with a positive and “can-do” mindset.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

jobs.title: Intern - EMEA Sales Planning
jobs.description:
In short

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Meet the team

The Sales Planning team within the EMEA Wholesale department plays a key role in driving the business from long-range financial forecasting to monthly sales planning. The team manages in-season performance to ensure targets are met and supports pre-season assortment planning to optimize product and Accounts strategies. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Controlling, Demand Planning, and Operations, the team ensures alignment between commercial goals and operational execution. It is an innovative and constantly evolving function, continuously improving processes and tools to enhance business performance and agility.

Your mission

• Perform weekly business analyses and generate actionable insights to support the Sales and Management teams in decision-making.

• Contribute to sales planning activities, including financial forecasting, in-season tracking, and pre-season assortment planning.

• Enhance and develop analytical tools and files (e.g., sell-out dashboards, forecast roll-ups, invoice trackers, G2N by region/sub-region) to enable more data-driven sales decisions.

• Support and drive sales-related projects aimed at improving processes, tools, and overall department efficiency.

• Support on developing AI capabilities within the commercial function.

Your story

• Demonstrate a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, taking initiative and ownership of tasks with a “can-do” attitude.

• You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to support decision-making and identify business opportunities.

• A natural problem solver, able to navigate ambiguity and find creative, practical solutions.

• Curious and eager to learn, showing genuine interest in understanding sales processes and business dynamics.

• You think outside the box and embrace challenges beyond your comfort zone to drive innovation and continuous improvement.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

titleByLocale.en: Head of Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation
titleByLocale.de: Leiter Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation

jobs.description:
In short

As the Head of Strategy & Operations, you are the architect of Footwear Creation's operating model. You will translate On's 2030 Long Range Plan into executable transformation- driving the strategic initiatives, processes, and systems that enable our team to deliver breakthrough footwear with Swiss-engineered precision. Sitting at the intersection of Development, Engineering, Materials, and Sustainability, you will influence leaders across functions, build organizational excitement for new ways of working, and make decisive calls on initiative prioritization and execution. Your mission: own the LRP initiative portfolio, orchestrate the leadership operating rhythm, and deliver measurable transformation that elevates how we create.

Your mission

Strategic Leadership & Vision (LRP to Action)

• Architect the Roadmap: Translate On’s 2030 LRP and annual goals into a multi-year strategic roadmap for Footwear Product Creation

• Strategic Prioritization: Act as the Creation gatekeeper for the footwear portfolio, ensuring technical breakthroughs are sequenced and resourced for maximum commercial impact.

Portfolio Strategy & Operating Rhythm

• Own seasonal range portfolio planning: capacity modeling, resource allocation, project prioritization

• Design and manage the Footwear Creation operating rhythm: weekly leadership standups, monthly business reviews, quarterly strategic planning

• Facilitate high-stakes leadership discussions; Own the agendas, pre-reads, drive decisions and follow-through for all leadership forums

• Serve as the primary coordination point between Creation and cross-functional partners (Innovation, Sourcing, Brand, Supply Chain)

• Build portfolio dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity, progress, risks, and trade-offs.

Process Excellence & Transformation

• Lead strategic initiatives to improve creation velocity: stage-gate optimization, systems integration, capacity planning frameworks

• Identify and eliminate process inefficiencies; challenge any workflow that doesn't add value

• Drive adoption of new ways of working through clear metrics, change management, and feedback loops

• Build a high-accountability, fast-decision culture within the Creation leadership team.

Change Management & Adoption Excellence

• Drive adoption of new initiatives through comprehensive change management: communication strategies, training programs, adoption metrics, feedback mechanisms

• Build organizational excitement and understanding of the strategic rationale behind transformational changes

• Navigate politics and complexity to drive decisions and unblock progress

• Hold partners accountable to commitments- even when they don't report to you

• Monitor leading indicators of adoption; implement course corrections when resistance or confusion emerges

• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within Footwear Creation.

Your Story

• Experience: 10+ years of leadership in Product Strategy, Program Management, or Footwear Creation, with a proven track record of translating corporate strategy into actionable cross-functional initiatives

• Operational Rigor: Exceptional executive facilitation skills; you are comfortable holding senior stakeholders accountable and running high-stakes leadership rhythms

• Influence without authority: You've led initiatives where success required getting leaders who don't report to you to change how they work. You have low self orientation

• Footwear Acumen: Deep understanding of the end-to-end product creation lifecycle- from innovation and engineering to global manufacturing

• Data-Driven Mindset: Exceptional analytical and visualization skills; you can turn complex project data into clear insights for executive decision-making

• Transformation Leader: Experience leading organizational change, including "Future State" org design and the implementation of new operating models

• Communication: A natural storyteller, capable of inspiring large teams on stage and navigating complex cross-functional partnerships

• Passion: An undeniable drive for sports, footwear technology, and Swiss-engineered innovation.

Why This Matters

On is scaling fast. Footwear Creation needs to evolve- not just work harder, but work smarter. We need new systems, new processes, new ways of collaborating. We need someone who can drive that transformation across a complex, cross-functional organization.

You won't build the products. But you'll build the operating model, the systems, and the culture that enable products and brand initiatives to be adopted and built with excellence, at speed, at scale.

If you're the kind of transformation leader who thrives on complexity, who knows how to influence without authority, who can make tough calls and drive change that sticks- this is your role.

Meet The Team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Head of Product Development | Accessories
jobs.description:
In short

We are looking for a visionary and technically proficient Head of Product Development | to lead our accessories product engine. This is a critical leadership role where you will be responsible for translating creative concepts into highly functional, durable, and commercially viable (technical) performance and lifestyle accessories. You will lead a high-performing team, drive product innovation, and own the development process from initial prototyping to final production, ensuring the highest standards of quality, performance, and sustainability. This role will report into the Global Senior Director of Product Creation + Sourcing.

Your mission

Your mission is to execute the accessories development strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall brand, product, and financial goals. You will oversee development and successful commercialization from ideation to launch, including engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final specifications. You will deliver against gross margin targets, manage department budgets while optimising costs. You will also provide collaborative leadership to align teams and foster an innovative work environment that encourages creativity, risk-taking and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute overall accessories development strategy and map out a roadmap which aligns with the overall brand, product, and financial goals

• Oversee all development and ensure commercialization of the product range from ideation to launch, including development engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final product specifications

• Work as a partner to Design, Materials, Innovation, Product Management, and Sourcing teams to ensure successful delivery of seasonal products and execute strategic vision for the business

• Deliver against gross margin targets and manage department budgets while optimizing on costs

• Conduct comprehensive market research to identify emerging trends, competitive threats, and new market opportunities

• Support and partner with our Sourcing teams in Asia & Europe on building a robust global sourcing strategy that emphasises high-quality products, world-class partnerships, service, ethical sourcing and sustainability

• Implement supply chain initiatives, in partnership with our ESG team, that reduce environmental impact, such as using recycled and preferred materials, advanced water treatment and color dyeing technologies and optimising logistics with initiatives like localisation

• Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and market trends to identify and oversee the development of innovative accessories that meet performance, durability, and sustainability requirements, which will instigate new ways of thinking about products

• Establish and enforce rigorous product testing and quality control protocols to ensure compliance with industry standards and brand requirements

• Spearhead and streamline product development and manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce complexity and time to market

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, engage with industry stakeholders, including athletes and sports professionals and work with the cross-functional stakeholders to gather customer feedback and incorporate it into future product designs.

Your story

• 15+ years of experience in accessories (hard and soft goods), including at least 7 years in a senior leadership role.

• Hold a deep understanding of sports accessory trends and competitor landscapes, with a proven ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities, to drive growth and innovation within the accessories category

• Proven track record of successful team leadership and the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse group of professionals, ability to influence stakeholders, and to translate technical complexities for non-technical audiences

• Expert knowledge of technical textiles, manufacturing processes, and "design for manufacturing" principles, alongside proficiency in the latest creation software.

• A strong commitment to sustainability and a history of implementing sustainability initiatives in product development and sourcing

• Experienced in global supply chain management, optimising processes for efficiency, cost reduction, and quality

• Familiarity with the latest creation software and technologies relevant to accessory design, development and production.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically- to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

We are looking for a visionary and technically proficient Head of Product Development | to lead our accessories product engine. This is a critical leadership role where you will be responsible for translating creative concepts into highly functional, durable, and commercially viable (technical) performance and lifestyle accessories. You will lead a high-performing team, drive product innovation, and own the development process from initial prototyping to final production, ensuring the highest standards of quality, performance, and sustainability. This role will report into the Global Senior Director of Product Creation + Sourcing.

Your mission

Your mission is to execute the accessories development strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall brand, product, and financial goals. You will oversee development and successful commercialization from ideation to launch, including engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final specifications. You will deliver against gross margin targets, manage department budgets while optimising costs. You will also provide collaborative leadership to align teams and foster an innovative work environment that encourages creativity, risk-taking and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute overall accessories development strategy and map out a roadmap which aligns with the overall brand, product, and financial goals

• Oversee all development and ensure commercialization of the product range from ideation to launch, including development engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final product specifications

• Work as a partner to Design, Materials, Innovation, Product Management, and Sourcing teams to ensure successful delivery of seasonal products and execute strategic vision for the business

• Deliver against gross margin targets and manage department budgets while optimizing on costs

• Conduct comprehensive market research to identify emerging trends, competitive threats, and new market opportunities

• Support and partner with our Sourcing teams in Asia & Europe on building a robust global sourcing strategy that emphasises high-quality products, world-class partnerships, service, ethical sourcing and sustainability

• Implement supply chain initiatives, in partnership with our ESG team, that reduce environmental impact, such as using recycled and preferred materials, advanced water treatment and color dyeing technologies and optimising logistics with initiatives like localisation

• Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and market trends to identify and oversee the development of innovative accessories that meet performance, durability, and sustainability requirements, which will instigate new ways of thinking about products

• Establish and enforce rigorous product testing and quality control protocols to ensure compliance with industry standards and brand requirements

• Spearhead and streamline product development and manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce complexity and time to market

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, engage with industry stakeholders, including athletes and sports professionals and work with the cross-functional stakeholders to gather customer feedback and incorporate it into future product designs.

Your story

• 15+ years of experience in accessories (hard and soft goods), including at least 7 years in a senior leadership role.

• Hold a deep understanding of sports accessory trends and competitor landscapes, with a proven ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities, to drive growth and innovation within the accessories category

• Proven track record of successful team leadership and the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse group of professionals, ability to influence stakeholders, and to translate technical complexities for non-technical audiences

• Expert knowledge of technical textiles, manufacturing processes, and "design for manufacturing" principles, alongside proficiency in the latest creation software.

• A strong commitment to sustainability and a history of implementing sustainability initiatives in product development and sourcing

• Experienced in global supply chain management, optimising processes for efficiency, cost reduction, and quality

• Familiarity with the latest creation software and technologies relevant to accessory design, development and production.

jobs.title: Head of Merchandising Planning, EMEA
jobs.description:
In short

As the Head of Merchandising Planning EMEA, you will be the strategic visionary leading our merchandising planning function across the region. You will architect the planning strategy that powers our commercial success, ensuring our product vision translates seamlessly into data-driven, highly accurate, and scalable financial and inventory plans.
By building cutting-edge frameworks and leveraging advanced technologies, you will empower your team—including the Merchandising Planning Leads—to drive operational excellence. You are a key leadership partner, integrating planning insights into the broader Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy bridging the gap between global product intent and regional market reality, and aligning our multi-channel execution across Wholesale, Digital, and Retail.

Your mission

• Cross- Channel Stakeholder Leadership: Lead and manage cross-functional stakeholder relationships, acting as the key strategic partner to channel leaders and Sales Planning leaders across Wholesale, DtC-Ecom, and DtC-Retail to ensure unified commercial execution and end-2-end planning.

• Strategic Frameworks: Set the overarching framework and define the ways of working for product level planning in Long Range Plan (LRP), pre-season planning, and in-season management & IBP cycle, ensuring robust real-time forecasts at the vertical, collection, and product franchise levels.

• Forecasting Optimization: Increase forecast accuracy metrics and minimize missed sales opportunities. You will achieve this by smartly and swiftly translating sell-through trends and market insights into dynamic adjustments of plans and open-to-buy forecasts.

• AI-Enabled Smart Planning: Champion the adoption and integration of AI and advanced data analytics into our planning processes to enable smart planning, optimize inventory flow, and enhance predictive decision-making capabilities across the region.

• Team Leadership & Upskilling: Directly manage, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of Merchandising Planning Leads, fostering a culture of data-driven accountability and operational excellence.

Your story

• 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in merchandise planning, forecasting, or commercial strategy, preferably within the footwear, sportswear, or fashion industries.

• Strong technical acumen, with a deep understanding of data architecture and hands-on experience leveraging AI planning tools and advanced forecasting models to drive business results.

• Proven track record of setting complex merchandising financial targets, managing multi-channel forecasting processes, and balancing financial, consumer, and operational considerations at a regional scale.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and executive presence, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership globally and regionally.

• An entrepreneurial mindset - you are comfortable navigating structured and unstructured planning challenges, leading teams through ambiguity, and acting autonomously to drive the business forward.

• A positive attitude with outstanding interpersonal and leadership skills. Fluent in English (written and verbal), with additional languages considered a plus.

Meet the team

You will lead the EMEA Merchandising Planning team and work alongside key leadership functions across B2B sales, eCom and Retail, and demand planning with a clear focus on product lifecycle and profitability. In particular, you will partner with the Planning leaders across regional and global teams - Demand Planning, Sales Planning, DtC Buying & Planning, and Controlling teams. As your work is highly strategic and cross-functional, you will also partner closely with our Global Product, Merchandising, and Operations teams. Your team will consist of planning leads and specialists focussed on both footwear and apparel.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

In qualità di Responsabile della Pianificazione Merchandising EMEA, sarete il visionario strategico che guida la nostra funzione di pianificazione merchandising in tutta la regione. Potrai progettare la strategia di pianificazione che alimenta il nostro successo commerciale, assicurando che la nostra visione del prodotto si traduce senza soluzione di continuità in data-driven, altamente preciso, e piani finanziari e di inventario scalabili.
Con la costruzione di strutture all'avanguardia e la leva di tecnologie avanzate, potrai potenziare il tuo team, tra cui i Lead di Merchandising Planning, per guidare l'eccellenza operativa. Sei un partner di leadership chiave, integrando idee di pianificazione nella più ampia strategia Go-To-Market (GTM) che corrode il divario tra l'intento globale del prodotto e la realtà del mercato regionale, e allineando la nostra esecuzione multi-canale in commercio, digitale e vendita al dettaglio.

La tua missione

• Leadership degli Stakeholder di Cross- Channel: Leader e gestisci le relazioni tra le parti interessate, agendo come partner strategico chiave per canalizzare i leader e i leader di pianificazione delle vendite all'ingrosso, DtC-Ecom e DtC-Retail per garantire l'esecuzione commerciale unificata e la pianificazione end-2-end.

• Strategic Frameworks: Impostare il quadro di sovra-archiviazione e definire i modi di lavorare per la pianificazione del livello di prodotto in Long Range Plan (LRP), pianificazione pre-stagione, e in-season management & IBP ciclo, assicurando robuste previsioni in tempo reale ai livelli verticali, di raccolta e di franchising prodotto.

• Ottimizzazione di previsione: aumentare le metriche di precisione di previsione e ridurre al minimo le opportunità di vendita mancate. Lo raggiungerete traducendo in modo intelligente e rapido le tendenze di vendita e le intuizioni di mercato in regolazioni dinamiche di piani e previsioni aperte.

• AI-Enabled Smart Planning: Campioni l'adozione e l'integrazione di AI e analisi dei dati avanzate nei nostri processi di pianificazione per consentire la pianificazione intelligente, ottimizzare il flusso di inventario e migliorare le capacità decisionali predittive in tutta la regione.

• Team Leadership & Upskilling: Direttamente gestire, mentore e ispirare un team altamente performante di Merchandising Planning Leads, promuovendo una cultura della responsabilità basata sui dati e dell'eccellenza operativa.

La tua storia

• 8+ anni di progressiva esperienza di leadership nella pianificazione della merce, previsione o strategia commerciale, preferibilmente all'interno delle industrie di calzature, abbigliamento sportivo o moda.

• Forte acume tecnico, con una profonda comprensione dell'architettura dei dati e esperienza pratica sfruttando strumenti di pianificazione AI e modelli di previsione avanzati per guidare i risultati aziendali.

• Rilevato tracciato di impostazione di obiettivi finanziari complessi merchandising, gestione di processi di previsione multicanale, e bilanciamento delle considerazioni finanziarie, di consumo e operative su scala regionale.

• Eccezionale gestione delle parti interessate e presenza esecutiva, con la capacità di influenzare team interfunzionali e leadership senior a livello globale e regionale.

• Una mentalità imprenditoriale - si sono confortevoli navigare strutturato e sfide di pianificazione non strutturate, leader team attraverso l'ambiguità, e agire autonomamente per guidare il business avanti.

• Un atteggiamento positivo con eccezionali capacità interpersonali e di leadership. Fluente in inglese (scritto e verbale), con lingue aggiuntive considerate un plus.

Incontra la squadra

Condurrai il team di EMEA Merchandising Planning e lavorerai a fianco delle principali funzioni di leadership tra le vendite di B2B, eCom e Retail e la pianificazione della domanda con una chiara attenzione al ciclo di vita e alla redditività del prodotto. In particolare, sarete partner con i leader di pianificazione tra le squadre regionali e globali - Pianificazione della domanda, Pianificazione delle vendite, DtC Buy & Planning e Controlling team. Poiché il vostro lavoro è altamente strategico e interfunzionale, sarete anche partner a stretto contatto con i nostri team Global Product, Merchandising e Operations. Il vostro team sarà composto da lead di pianificazione e specialisti focalizzati sia sulle calzature che sull'abbigliamento.

Cosa offriamo

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gesagt

Als Head of Merchandising Planning EMEA werden Sie der strategische Visionär sein, der unsere Merchandising-Planungsfunktion in der gesamten Region leitet. Sie werden die Planungsstrategie entwerfen, die unseren kommerziellen Erfolg unterstützt und sicherstellen, dass unsere Produktvision nahtlos in datengesteuerte, hochgenaue und skalierbare Finanz- und Inventarpläne umgesetzt wird.
Durch den Aufbau modernster Frameworks und die Nutzung fortschrittlicher Technologien befähigen Sie Ihr Team - einschließlich der Merchandising Planning Leads -, operative Exzellenz zu fördern. Sie sind ein wichtiger Führungspartner, der Planungserkenntnisse in die breitere Go-To-Market (GTM)-Strategie integriert, die die Lücke zwischen globaler Produktabsicht und regionaler Marktrealität schließt und unsere Multi-Channel-Ausführung auf Wholesale, Digital und Retail ausrichtet.

Deine Mission

• Cross-Channel Stakeholder Leadership: Führen und verwalten Sie funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder-Beziehungen und fungieren Sie als wichtiger strategischer Partner für Channel Leader und Sales Planning Leader in Wholesale, DtC-Ecom und DtC-Retail, um eine einheitliche kommerzielle Ausführung und End-2-End-Planung zu gewährleisten.

• Strategische Rahmenbedingungen: Legen Sie den übergreifenden Rahmen fest und definieren Sie die Arbeitsweise für die Produktebenenplanung in Long Range Plan (LRP), Vorsaisonplanung und In-Saison-Management & IBP-Zyklus, um robuste Echtzeitprognosen auf vertikaler, Sammlungs- und Produkt-Franchise-Ebene zu gewährleisten.

• Prognoseoptimierung: Steigern Sie die Genauigkeit von Prognosen und minimieren Sie verpasste Verkaufschancen. Dies erreichen Sie, indem Sie Sell-Through-Trends und Markteinblicke intelligent und schnell in dynamische Anpassungen von Plänen und Open-to-Buy-Prognosen übersetzen.

• AI-Enabled Smart Planning: Setzen Sie sich für die Einführung und Integration von KI und fortschrittlicher Datenanalyse in unsere Planungsprozesse ein, um eine intelligente Planung zu ermöglichen, den Bestandsfluss zu optimieren und die Fähigkeit zur vorausschauenden Entscheidungsfindung in der gesamten Region zu verbessern.

• Team Leadership & Upskilling: Verwalten, beraten und inspirieren Sie direkt ein leistungsstarkes Team von Merchandising Planning Leads und fördern Sie eine Kultur der datengesteuerten Rechenschaftspflicht und operativen Exzellenz.

Deine Geschichte

• 8+ Jahre fortschrittliche Führungserfahrung in der Warenplanung, -prognose oder -strategie, vorzugsweise in der Schuh-, Sportbekleidungs- oder Modebranche.

• Starker technischer Scharfsinn mit einem tiefen Verständnis der Datenarchitektur und praktischer Erfahrung durch die Nutzung von KI-Planungstools und fortschrittlichen Prognosemodellen, um die Geschäftsergebnisse zu steigern.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Festlegung komplexer Merchandising-Finanzziele, der Verwaltung von Multi-Channel-Prognoseprozessen und dem Ausgleich von Finanz-, Verbraucher- und operativen Überlegungen auf regionaler Ebene.

• Außergewöhnliches Stakeholder-Management und Executive-Präsenz mit der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams und leitende Führungskräfte global und regional zu beeinflussen.

• Eine unternehmerische Denkweise - Sie navigieren gerne strukturierte und unstrukturierte Planungsherausforderungen, führen Teams durch Mehrdeutigkeiten und handeln autonom, um das Geschäft voranzutreiben.

• Eine positive Einstellung mit herausragenden zwischenmenschlichen und Führungsqualitäten. Fließend in englisch (schriftlich und verbal), mit zusätzlichen sprachen als plus.

Treffen Sie das Team

Sie werden das EMEA Merchandising Planning Team leiten und neben wichtigen Führungsfunktionen in den Bereichen B2B-Vertrieb, eCom und Einzelhandel sowie Nachfrageplanung mit einem klaren Fokus auf Produktlebenszyklus und Rentabilität arbeiten. Insbesondere werden Sie mit den Planungsleitern in regionalen und globalen Teams zusammenarbeiten - Demand Planning, Sales Planning, DtC Buying & Planning und Controlling Teams. Da Ihre Arbeit sehr strategisch und funktionsübergreifend ist, werden Sie auch eng mit unseren globalen Produkt-, Merchandising- und Operations-Teams zusammenarbeiten. Ihr Team besteht aus Planungsleitern und Spezialisten, die sich sowohl auf Schuhe als auch auf Bekleidung konzentrieren.

Was wir anbieten

On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten eine Umgebung, die den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln - aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovieren. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz kombiniert eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zu persönlicher Selbstfürsorge für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jede Person von ihrem Zweck geleitet wird.

On ist ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber. Wir sind bestrebt, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Rekrutierung, Förderung und Bindung frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

En tant que responsable de la planification du commerce EMEA, vous serez le visionnaire stratégique qui dirigera notre fonction de planification du commerce dans toute la région. Vous allez concevoir la stratégie de planification qui alimente notre succès commercial, en assurant que notre vision produit se traduit de façon transparente en plans financiers et d'inventaire axés sur les données, hautement précis et évolutives.
En établissant des cadres de pointe et en tirant parti des technologies de pointe, vous donnerez à votre équipe, y compris les responsables de la planification des marchandises, les moyens de stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle. Vous êtes un partenaire de leadership clé, intégrant des idées de planification dans la stratégie plus large de Go-To-Market (GTM) pour combler l'écart entre l'intention de produit mondial et la réalité du marché régional, et pour aligner notre exécution multicanal sur le commerce de gros, le numérique et le commerce de détail.

Votre mission

• Leadership intersectoriel des intervenants : Diriger et gérer les relations interfonctionnelles des intervenants, en tant que partenaire stratégique clé pour canaliser les dirigeants et les chefs de la planification des ventes dans l'ensemble du commerce de gros, du DtC-Ecom et du DtC-Retail afin d'assurer une exécution commerciale unifiée et une planification de bout en bout.

• Cadres stratégiques : Établir le cadre général et définir les façons de travailler pour la planification du niveau de produit dans le plan à longue distance (PRL), la planification avant la saison et la gestion en saison et le cycle PCI, en assurant des prévisions robustes en temps réel aux niveaux vertical, de collecte et de franchise de produits.

• Optimisation des prévisions : Augmenter la précision des prévisions et minimiser les occasions de vente manquées. Vous y arriverez en traduisant intelligemment et rapidement les tendances de vente et les perspectives du marché en ajustements dynamiques des plans et des prévisions ouvertes à l'achat.

• Planification intelligente adaptée à l'IA : Championne de l'adoption et de l'intégration de l'IA et de l'analyse avancée des données dans nos processus de planification afin de permettre une planification intelligente, d'optimiser le flux d'inventaire et d'améliorer les capacités de prise de décisions prédictives dans toute la région.

• Leadership et perfectionnement de l'équipe : Dirigez, mentorez et inspirez directement une équipe hautement performante de responsables de la planification des marchandises, favorisant une culture de responsabilité axée sur les données et d'excellence opérationnelle.

Votre histoire

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience de leadership progressif dans la planification, la prévision ou la stratégie commerciale des marchandises, de préférence dans les industries de la chaussure, du sport ou de la mode.

• Forte acuité technique, avec une compréhension approfondie de l'architecture des données et de l'expérience pratique en tirant parti des outils de planification de l'IA et des modèles avancés de prévision pour produire des résultats commerciaux.

• Expérience éprouvée de la définition d'objectifs financiers complexes de merchandising, de la gestion de processus de prévision multicanaux et de l'équilibre des considérations financières, de consommation et opérationnelles à l'échelle régionale.

• Une présence exceptionnelle de la direction et des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d'influencer les équipes interfonctionnelles et les cadres supérieurs aux niveaux mondial et régional.

• Un état d'esprit entrepreneurial - vous êtes à l'aise de naviguer des défis de planification structurés et non structurés, de diriger des équipes par l'ambiguïté et d'agir de manière autonome pour faire avancer l'entreprise.

• Une attitude positive avec des compétences interpersonnelles et de leadership exceptionnelles. Fluent en anglais (écrit et verbal), avec d'autres langues considérées comme un plus.

Rencontrez l'équipe

Vous dirigerez l'équipe de planification des marchandises de l'EMEA et travaillerez aux côtés des principales fonctions de direction dans les domaines des ventes, du commerce électronique et du commerce de détail, et de la planification de la demande, en mettant clairement l'accent sur le cycle de vie et la rentabilité des produits. En particulier, vous travaillerez en partenariat avec les responsables de la planification des équipes régionales et mondiales - planification de la demande, planification des ventes, achats et planification DtC, et équipes de contrôle. Comme votre travail est hautement stratégique et interfonctionnel, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Global Product, Merchandising et Operations. Votre équipe sera composée de chefs de file et de spécialistes de la planification axés sur les chaussures et les vêtements.

Ce que nous offrons

Sur est un endroit qui est centré sur la croissance et le progrès. Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils pour se développer de manière holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche particulière combine une atmosphère de soutien et d'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par but.

Il y a un employeur à égalité de chances. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions relatives au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.title: Head of Functional Communications
jobs.description:
In short:

We are looking for a seasoned internal comms expert with direct experience in leading strategic communications and standing up business partnership models to serve internal functions - including deskless audiences.

Reporting to the Global Head of Internal Communications, the Head of Functional Communications will partner with regional and functional leaders across the business to build team culture and disseminate important information. Whether capturing stories about our culture or helping teams navigate change, this leader will drive impactful communication strategies from start to finish.

This role will be highly embedded in On’s unique and entrepreneurial culture; collaborating with multiple teams to optimize information flow and bring great messages to life.

Your mission:

• Writing messages for global audiences on key topics related to our strategy and culture.

• Co-leading On’s approach to change and crisis management, and how big messages make their way into teams’ daily activities.

• Developing a sub-audience approach that uniquely serves the needs of our store population, regional teams, and leadership layers.

• Leading executive communications for key leaders at On across business functions, including live speaking moments and written messages.

Your story:

In addition to a specific passion for internal communication and culture, we hope you’ll also bring:

• 10+ years of experience working in creative and multi-disciplinary roles across Communications, Change Management, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.

• Strong writing skills. No matter the subject, you are able to easily identify a story and bring it to life in a clear and compelling way – through talking points, slides, videos, and other mediums.

• Thought leadership. You bring big ideas - and the strategic acumen to actually make them happen. You are skilled at translating your vision into words; bringing peers and stakeholders on board.Executive experience. You have extensive experience working with senior leaders and have played a central role in building executive personas.

• Team leadership. You are a passionate people leader, accustomed with charting growth paths and strategic vision for the team members you support.

• Creativity. Ideally, you bring expertise in at least one relevant audiovisual format (video, audio, graphic design, animation) and find energy in a brainstorming session.

• Collaborative mindset. You enjoy leading large, cross-functional projects and tackling ambiguity with organization.

• Tons of motivation. You are a self-starter; skilled at proactively pitching ideas and getting them off the ground. You’re always picking up new skills and happy to operate in the weeds.

• Industry knowledge. You regularly follow media trends and are highly analytical; able to learn systems easily; identify gaps; and problem solve accordingly. Experience using Slack and G-Suite apps is a plus.

• English fluency. Additional languages are a plus.

Your Team:

This role sits within Internal Communications – a team focused on driving connection and clarity across our global team at On. We’re big thinkers and change-makers, constantly looking for new ways to inform and inspire. If you’re passionate about impacting culture and applying your creativity in various areas of the business, you’ll be in great company.
